	end

	function behaviour:dispose()
		self.start_pos = nil
		self.waypoint_infos = nil

		self.data = nil

		self.super:dispose()
	end

	function behaviour:on_start(data)
		self.data = data

		local character = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_character(self.data.name)

		self.start_pos = self.systems.utilities:get_fo_position(character)

		local waypoint_infos = {}

		local prev_pos = self.start_pos

		local total_dist = 0

		for i = 1, #self.data.waypoints do
			local position_name = self.data.waypoints[i]
			local position = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_marker_pos(position_name)
			local dist = (position - prev_pos).magnitude

			total_dist = total_dist + dist

			waypoint_infos[i] = {
				prev_pos = prev_pos,
				position = position,
				dist_from_start = total_dist
			}

			prev_pos = position
		end

		self.waypoint_infos = {}

		local prev_progress = 0

		for i = 1, #waypoint_infos do
			local info = waypoint_infos[i]

			self.waypoint_infos[i] = {
				start_pos = info.prev_pos,
				end_pos = info.position,
				start_progress = prev_progress,
				end_progress = info.dist_from_start / total_dist
			}
		end

		if self.data.use_walk then
			self.systems.utilities:set_anim(character, 'walk')
		end
	end

	function behaviour:on_end()
		local character = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_character(self.data.name)

		self.systems.utilities:set_position(character, self.waypoint_infos[#self.waypoint_infos].end_pos)

		if self.data.use_walk then
			self.systems.utilities:remove_anim(character)
		end

		self.start_pos = nil
		self.waypoint_infos = nil

		self.data = nil
	end

	function behaviour:update_progress(progress)
		local character = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_character(self.data.name)

		-- FIXME : 되돌아가는 것을 상정해서 이렇게 짜긴 했는데, WaypointWalker를 하나 세팅하는 게 나을지도
		for i = 1, #self.waypoint_infos do
			local info = self.waypoint_infos[i]

			if info.start_progress <= progress and progress <= info.end_progress then
				local local_progress = (progress - info.start_progress) / (info.end_progress - info.start_progress)
				local cur_pos = info.start_pos * (1 - local_progress) + info.end_pos * local_progress

				self.systems.utilities:set_position(character, cur_pos)

				break
			end
		end
	end

		self.super:dispose()

		self.data = data
		self.waypoint_infos = {}

		-- 마지막 waypoint는 스폰 위치랑 같다는 가정 하에 사용한다.
		local prev_pos = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_marker_pos(self.data.waypoints[#self.data.waypoints])
		local prev_end_bit = 0

		for i = 1, #self.data.waypoints do
			local position_name = self.data.waypoints[i]
			local position = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_marker_pos(position_name)
			local dist = (position - prev_pos).magnitude
			local bit_duration = dist / self.data.speed

			self.waypoint_infos[i] = {
				start_pos = prev_pos,
				end_pos = position,
				start_bit = prev_end_bit,
				end_bit = prev_end_bit + bit_duration
			}

			prev_end_bit = self.waypoint_infos[i].end_bit
			prev_pos = position
		end
	end

	function behaviour:on_end()
		-- 얘는 어차피 루프니까 암것도 하지 않는다.

		self.waypoint_infos = nil
		self.data = nil
	end

	function behaviour:update_progress(progress, world_bit_passed)
		local character = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_character(self.data.name)

		-- 죽었으면 캔슬
		if not self.systems.entity_manager:is_valid_entity(character) then
			return false
		end

		-- 나머지만 사용함
		local local_bit_passed = (world_bit_passed - self.start_bit) % self.waypoint_infos[#self.waypoint_infos].end_bit

		for i = 1, #self.waypoint_infos do
			local info = self.waypoint_infos[i]

			if info.start_bit <= local_bit_passed and local_bit_passed <= info.end_bit then
				local local_progress = (local_bit_passed - info.start_bit) / (info.end_bit - info.start_bit)
				local cur_pos = info.start_pos * (1 - local_progress) + info.end_pos * local_progress

				self.systems.utilities:set_position(character, cur_pos)

				break
			end
		end
	end
end

	if getmetatable(container) ~= nil then

		behaviour_creators[saved_namespace] = container

		return
	end

	for self_namespace, item in pairs(container) do
		local namespace

		if saved_namespace ~= nil then
			namespace = saved_namespace .. '.' .. self_namespace
		else
			namespace = self_namespace
		end

		namespace_merger(item, namespace)
	end
end

---@class PixyWorldGrandMarchGameLevelConstantsUtil
local util = {}

---@class PixyWorldGrandMarchGameTypeConst
local type_const = {
	remove_anim_type = {
		none = 1,
		normal = 2,
		upper = 3,
		both = 4,
	},
	attack_range_shape = {
		circle = 1,
	},
	entity_type = {
		npc = 1,
		enemy = 2,
		player = 3,
	},
}

util.type_const = type_const

function util.need_unpack(table)
	for i = 1, #table do
		local value = table[i]

		if value.need_unpack then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function util.create_clip(start_bit, end_bit, type, args)
	return {
		start_bit = start_bit,
		end_bit = end_bit,
		type = type,
		args = args,
	}
end

function util.create_sub_clip(type, args)
	return {
		type = type,
		args = args,
	}
end

function util.create_clip_bundle(start_bit, end_bit, bundle)
	local values = {}

	for i = 1, #bundle do
		local sub_pattern = bundle[i]

		if sub_pattern.need_unpack then
			for j = 1, #sub_pattern.values do
				local sub_inner = sub_pattern.values[j]

				sub_inner.start_bit = start_bit
				sub_inner.end_bit = end_bit

				values[#values + 1] = sub_inner
			end
		else
			sub_pattern.start_bit = start_bit
			sub_pattern.end_bit = end_bit

			values[#values + 1] = sub_pattern
		end
	end

	-- 원래는 table.unpack을 반환했는데, 첫 값만 리턴으로 인식해서 나머지는 테이블에 저장이 안되는 문제가 있어서 변경
	return {
		need_unpack = true,
		values = values
	}
end

---@param args_generator "function(key, value) return {} end"
function util.generate_sub_clip_by_function(type, replace_values, args_generator)
	local values = {}

	for k, v in pairs(replace_values) do
		local args = args_generator(k, v)

		values[#values + 1] = util.create_sub_clip(type, args)
	end

	return {
		need_unpack = true,
		values = values
	}
end

function util.pack_sub_clips(sub_clips)
	local result = {
		need_unpack = true,
		values = {}
	}

	for i = 1, #sub_clips do
		local clip = sub_clips[i]

		if clip.need_unpack then
			for _, inner_clip in pairs(clip.values) do
				result.values[#result.values + 1] = inner_clip
			end
		else
			result.values[#result.values + 1] = clip
		end
	end

	return result
end

function util.unpack_bundles_in_group(clip_group)
	local need_rebuild = util.need_unpack(clip_group)

	if need_rebuild then
		local unpacked_group = {}

		for i = 1, #clip_group do
			local clip = clip_group[i]

			if clip.need_unpack then
				for j = 1, #clip.values do
					local clip_inner = clip.values[j]

					unpacked_group[#unpacked_group + 1] = clip_inner
				end
			else
				unpacked_group[#unpacked_group + 1] = clip
			end
		end

		return unpacked_group
	end

	return clip_group
end

function util.unpack_bundles_in_pattern(pattern)
	local result = {}

	for pattern_type, group in pairs(pattern) do
		result[pattern_type] = util.unpack_bundles_in_group(group)
	end

	return result
end

---이건 항상 제일 마지막에 사용해야 함. unpack되지 않은 상태에서는 사용이 불가능함
function util.add_delay_to_group(clip_group, delayed_bit)
	for _, clip in pairs(clip_group) do
		clip.start_bit = clip.start_bit + delayed_bit

		if clip.end_bit ~= nil then
			clip.end_bit = clip.end_bit + delayed_bit
		end
	end
end

local group_types = {
	'init',
	'dispose',
	'game'
}

--- 각 그룹의 동작은 서로 간섭하지 않기 때문에, 적당히 쪼갠 후 머지하는 것이 동작 구성에 도움이 될 것임
function util.merge_groups(groups)
	local result = {}
	local clip_walkers = {}

	for key, group in pairs(groups) do
		clip_walkers[key] = 1

		groups[key] = util.unpack_bundles_in_group(group)
	end

	while true do
		local min_group_key

		for key, walker in pairs(clip_walkers) do
			if walker <= #groups[key] then
				if min_group_key == nil or (groups[key][walker].start_bit <
						groups[min_group_key][clip_walkers[min_group_key]].start_bit) then
					min_group_key = key
				end
			end
		end

		if min_group_key == nil then
			break
		end

		result[#result + 1] = groups[min_group_key][clip_walkers[min_group_key]]
		clip_walkers[min_group_key] = clip_walkers[min_group_key] + 1
	end

	return result
end

function util.merge_patterns(patterns)
	local result = {}

	for _, group_type in pairs(group_types) do
		local groups = {}

		for _, group in pairs(patterns) do
			groups[#groups + 1] = group[group_type]
		end

		result[group_type] = util.merge_groups(groups)
	end

	return result
end

return util

		normal = {},
		hard = {},
	}

	self.center_flowers = {
		prefix = 'center_flower_',

		count = 3,

		states = {
			on_start = {
				priority = 1,
				direction = {
					'down',
					'right',
					'up'
				}
			},
			before_normal_cleared = {
				priority = 2,
				one_line_keys = {
					'pw_grand_march_s1_25',
					'pw_grand_march_s1_26',
					'pw_grand_march_s1_27',
				}
			},
			after_normal_cleared = {
				priority = 3,
				one_line_keys = {
					'pw_grand_march_post_1',
					'pw_grand_march_post_2',
					'pw_grand_march_post_3',
				}
			},
			after_hard_cleared = {
				priority = 4,
				one_line_keys = {
					'pw_grand_march_hard_post_1',
					'pw_grand_march_hard_post_2',
					'pw_grand_march_hard_post_3',
				}
			},
		},

		current_state = nil,

		---@param this self
		get = function(this, index)
			return get_character(this.prefix .. index)
		end,

		---@param this self
		---@param action "function(index, npc) end"
		foreach = function(this, action)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				action(i, this:get(i))
			end
		end,

		---@param this self
		change_state = function(this, state)
			local next_state = this.states[state]

			if this.current_state ~= nil and this.current_state.priority >= next_state.priority then
				return
			end

			--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀 NPC 1 ~ 3은 자신의 마지막 대사로 원라인 배치된 상태.
			this:foreach(function(index, npc)
				if next_state.one_line_keys ~= nil then
					npc.Interactable.Talk = next_state.one_line_keys[index]
				end

				if next_state.directions ~= nil then
					character_util.set_direction(npc, next_state.directions[index])
				else
					character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
				end

				-- 첫 세팅 시에만 동작
				if this.current_state == nil then
					scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'smile')
					scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'sing')
				end
			end)

			this.current_state = next_state
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	for key, subscribers in pairs(self.interacting_flower_subscribers) do
		if #subscribers > 0 then
			logger_util.error('[PixyWorldGrandMarchGameManager] Subscribers Remained.')
		end
	end

	self:destroy()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return self:on_interact_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for key, subscribers in pairs(self.interacting_flower_subscribers) do
		if self.levels[key].flowers:contains(e.Target) then
			for i = 1, #subscribers do
				local consumed = subscribers[i]:on_interact_flower()

				if consumed then
					return true
				end
			end

			break
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event()
	if self.system_manager ~= nil then
		self.system_manager:force_cancel()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:pre_load()
	if self.system_manager ~= nil then
		return
	end

	local directory = 'Quest/Main/PixyWorld/GrandMarch/Game/'

	local manager_creator = get_or_create_global_variable(directory .. 'SystemManager')
	local behaviour_creators = get_or_create_global_variable(directory .. 'Behaviours')
	local constants = get_or_create_global_variable(directory .. 'Constants')

	self.system_manager = manager_creator(constants, behaviour_creators)
end

function local_class:destroy()
	if self.system_manager == nil then
		return
	end

	self.system_manager:on_destroy()
	self.system_manager = nil
end

function local_class:subscribe_interacting_flower(level_key, target)
	local subscribers = self.interacting_flower_subscribers[level_key]

	subscribers[#subscribers + 1] = target

	if #subscribers == 1 then
		self.levels[level_key].flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
			character_util.add_lua_listener(npc, self)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_interacting_flower(level_key, target)
	local subscribers = self.interacting_flower_subscribers[level_key]

	for index, subscriber in pairs(subscribers) do
		if target == subscriber then
			subscribers[index] = nil

			break
		end
	end

	if #subscribers == 0 then
		self.levels[level_key].flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
			character_util.remove_lua_listener(npc, self)
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:set_game_flowers(level_key)
	self.levels[level_key].flowers:foreach(function(index, npc)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'sing')
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'sing')
	end)
end

---@param state "'on_start'"|"'before_normal_cleared'"|"'after_normal_cleared'"|"'after_hard_cleared'"
function local_class:set_center_flowers(state)
	self.center_flowers:change_state(state)
end

function local_class:try_play_routine(level_key, is_cleared, callbacks)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local play_game = self:talk_with_flower_scene(level_key, is_cleared)

	if play_game then
		callbacks.on_game_start()

		local result = nil

		self.system_manager:initialize(level_key)

		self.system_manager:game_routine(function(game_result)
			result = game_result
		end)

		self.system_manager:dispose()

		-- 강종된 상황일 것임
		if result.force_canceled then
			return
		end

		if result.succeed then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({
				state = 'field',
				mix = 1,
			})

			callbacks.on_succeed()
		else
			self:return_on_failed_scene(level_key)

			callbacks.on_failed()

			sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
		end
	else
		callbacks.on_escape()

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)
	end
end

function local_class:talk_with_flower_scene(level_key, is_cleared)
	local flowers = self.levels[level_key].flowers
	local string_type = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_cleared, 'after_clear', 'before_clear')
	local string_keys = self.levels[level_key].string_keys[string_type]

	--컨트롤 뻇길 떄 BGM 볼륨 0.6으로 조절 ,믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	--NPC 4 ~ 7 인터렉트 시 지정된 위치에 정렬 후 이벤트 실행
	do
		local align_pivot = flowers:get_center_pos()

		for i = 1, user_party.Count do
			local member = user_party[i - 1]
			local target_pos = align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left * i
			local move_dist = (target_pos - member.Position).magnitude
			local duration = 1
			local speed = math.max(move_dist / duration, 1)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos, speed, nil, self, nil, {
				last_direction = 'right'
			})
		end

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	local flower = flowers:get(3)

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(flower, string_keys.ask_to_play)

	local play_game = false

	--플레이어 선택지 출력.
	--행렬에 참여한다.(초록)
	--그만둔다.(흰색)
	choose_util.play_async({
		{
			'pw_grand_march_common_9',
			'mercy',
			function()
				play_game = true
			end
		},
		{
			'pw_grand_march_common_10',
			'normal'
		},
	})

	--그만둔다 선택할 시.
	if not play_game then
		--NPC 6 (left, smile, sing) : 축제는 언제든 열려있다고! 언제든 찾아와!!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(flower, string_keys.react_to_give_up)

		--그만둔다 선택 시 컨트롤 복귀에 BGM 볼륨 1로 조절, 믹스 디폴트
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

		--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
		return false
	end

	--행렬에 참여한다 선택할 시.
	--NPC 6 (left, smile, sing) : 좋아! 그 말을 기다리고 있었어!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(flower, 'pw_grand_march_common_11')

	--대사 종료하면 NPC 5, 6 지정된 위치로 walk(속도 4)로 이동한 후
	local origin_poses = {
		[2] = flowers:get(2).Position,
		[3] = flowers:get(3).Position,
	}

	do
		local speed = 4
		local execute_move = function(index, near_index)
			local npc = flowers:get(index)
			local target_pos = flowers:get(near_index).Position + unity_class.vector3.right
			local waypoints = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(npc, target_pos, true)

			character_util.remove_anim(npc)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, waypoints, speed, nil, self, nil, {
				last_direction = 'left',
				end_callback = function()
					--left, sing, sing 실행.
					scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'sing')
				end
			})
		end

		execute_move(2, 1)
		execute_move(3, 4)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	--NPC 6 (left, sing, sing) : 친구! 제대로 흔들 준비 됐어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(flower, 'pw_grand_march_common_12')

	--플레이어 right, awesome, victory_get 실행.

	do
		local anim_name = 'victory_get'
		local victory_get_data = {
			name = anim_name,
			one_shot_sfx = false,
		}

		--플레이어 right, awesome, victory_get 실행.
		party_util.for_each(function(num, member)
			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'awesome')

			local anim_data = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
					num == 1, anim_name, victory_get_data)

			scene_util.set_anim(member, self, anim_data)
		end)

		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(get_party_leader(), anim_name)

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()
	end

	local jump_tile = self.levels[level_key].get_jump_tile()
	local current_camera_grid = field_util.get_camera_grid_contains_point(jump_tile.Position)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--종료되면 right, attack, run(속도 7)을 실행하여
	--점프대까지 달려가고,
	do
		local target_pos = field_object_util.get_center_pivot(jump_tile)

		party_util.foreach_member(function(index, member)
			local offset = member.Position - leader.Position

			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'attack')

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(member, target_pos + offset,
					7, nil, self, nil, {
						run = true,
						play_sfx = true,
					})
		end)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')
	animator_util.play(jump_tile, 'on')

	--right, awesome, jump로 우측으로 날아가며 화면 이탈.
	do
		local offsets = {}

		party_util.foreach_member(function(index, member)
			offsets[index + 1] = member.Position - leader.Position
		end)

		local max_x_offset = offsets[#offsets].x
		local start_xz = leader.Position
		local target_xz = vector(current_camera_grid.bounds.max.x + 2 - max_x_offset, 0, start_xz.z)

		-- 카메라 스탑
		camera_util.move(leader.Position, 0.01)

		party_util.foreach_member(function(index, member)
			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'awesome')
			scene_util.set_anim(member, self, 'get')
		end)

		local height = 4

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1, function(progress)
			local cur_height = math.sin(math.pi / 2 * progress) * height
			local cur_xz = start_xz * (1 - progress) + target_xz * progress

			for i = 1, user_party.Count do
				local member = user_party[i - 1]

				character_util.set_position(member,
						vector_util.get_x0z(cur_xz, cur_height) + offsets[i], true)
			end
		end)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'muted',
		mix = 1,
	})

	--화면 페이드 아웃하며. 플레이어 일반 난이도 대행진 액티비티로 진입.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	animator_util.play(jump_tile, 'off')

	for index, origin_pos in pairs(origin_poses) do
		local npc = flowers:get(index)

		character_util.set_position(npc, origin_pos)
	end

	party_util.remove_anim_and_emotion()

	return true
end

function local_class:return_on_failed_scene(level_key)
	local align_pivot = self.levels[level_key].flowers:get_center_pos()

	--페이드 인 시 대행진 시작 인터렉트 위치로 복귀
	local target_pos = align_pivot + unity_class.vector3.left

	party_util.position_party(target_pos, 'right', 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field',
		mix = 1
	})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
end

function local_class:return_on_succeed_scene()
	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('default_start')

	party_util.position_party(target_pos, 'right', 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'field',
		mix = 1
	})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemManager
local local_class = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemManager')

---@class PixyWorldGrandMarchGameBehaviourPool
local behaviour_pool = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameBehaviourPool')

local tile_map_accessor = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameTileMapAccessor')
local utilities = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameUtility')
local evaluator = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemEvaluator')
local entity_manager = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemEntityManager')
local bomb_manager = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemBombPool')
local attack_range_pool = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemAttachRangePool')
local fx_manager = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemFxManager')
local dynamic_pattern_manager = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemDynamicPatternManager')
local player_blocker = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemPlayerBlocker')

local entity_partition = newclass('PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemEntityPartition')

local use_debug = false
local ignore_crash_for_test = false

local clear_table = function(target)
	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	for key in pairs(target) do
		target[key] = nil
	end
end

local append_line = function(text, member_name, value)
	return text .. member_name .. ' : ' .. tostring(value) .. '\n'
end

local print_clip = function(type, index, clip)
	local text = append_line('', 'type', type)

	text = append_line(text, 'index', index)

	text = append_line(text, 'start_bit', clip.start_bit)
	text = append_line(text, 'end_bit', clip.end_bit)
	text = append_line(text, 'type', clip.type)

	logger_util.log(text .. '\n' .. table_util.to_string(clip))
end

local system_access_type = {
	all = 1,
	only_setting = 2,
	none = 3,
}

local game_end_state = {
	none = 1,
	player_enter_finish_line = 2,
	player_crashed_npc = 3,
	player_exploded = 4,
	npc_crashed_enemy = 5,
}

---@class PixyWorldGrandMarchGameGlobalSystems
local system_creators = {
	tile_map_accessor = tile_map_accessor,
	utilities = utilities,
	evaluator = evaluator,
	entity_manager = entity_manager,
	bomb_manager = bomb_manager,
	attack_range_pool = attack_range_pool,
	fx_manager = fx_manager,
	dynamic_pattern_manager = dynamic_pattern_manager,
	player_blocker = player_blocker
}

local system_dependency = {
	utilities = {
		'entity_manager',
		'tile_map_accessor',
	},
	evaluator = {
		'entity_manager',
	},
	player_blocker = {
		'entity_manager',
		'utilities'
	}
}

function local_class:init(all_constants, behaviour_creators)
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		loading = 2,
		intro = 3,
		in_game = 4,
		game_overed = 5,
		game_done = 6,
		disposing = 7,
		force_canceled = 8,
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none

	---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameConstants
	self.constants = all_constants

	---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameLevelConstants
	self.level_constants = nil

	-- Behaviour Pool은 Behaviour들이 접근하지 않아도 되므로(외부에서 제어), 예외사항으로 남겨둠
	---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameBehaviourPool
	self.behaviour_pool = behaviour_pool(behaviour_creators)

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameGlobalSystems
	self.systems = {}

	-- 시스템끼리의 단방향 의존은 허용, 사이클이 생기면 안됨
	-- utilities -> tile_map_accessor, utilities -> crash_manager, evaluator -> crash_manager
	-- 편의성 때문에 이렇게 했지만, 원래는 System끼리의 의존성을 허용하지 않아야 함.
	local get_or_create_system
	local max_system_create_count = 0

	if use_debug then
		max_system_create_count = table_util.get_size(system_creators)
	end

	-- FIXME : 위상정렬을 사용해 생성 순서 데이터를 미리 구워두기?
	get_or_create_system = function(system_name)
		if self.systems[system_name] == nil then
			if use_debug then
				-- 사이클 감지용
				-- 만약 예상보다 많은 시스템들이 생성되려고 한다면 뱉어버림
				if max_system_create_count == 0 then
					logger_util.error('GrandMarchSystem Dependency Cycle detected!!')

					return
				end

				max_system_create_count = max_system_create_count - 1
			end

			local accessible_systems = {}

			if system_dependency[system_name] ~= nil then
				for _, accessible_system_name in pairs(system_dependency[system_name]) do
					accessible_systems[accessible_system_name] = get_or_create_system(accessible_system_name)
				end
			end

			self.systems[system_name] = system_creators[system_name](accessible_systems, self.constants.common.type_const)
		end

		return self.systems[system_name]
	end

	for system_name in pairs(system_creators) do
		get_or_create_system(system_name)
	end

	self.running_behaviours = {}

	self.pattern_walker = 1

	self:print_patterns()
end

function local_class:on_destroy()
	self:dispose()

	self.running_behaviours = nil

	if self.behaviour_pool ~= nil then
		self.behaviour_pool:print()

		self.behaviour_pool:dispose()

		self.behaviour_pool = nil
	end

	if self.systems ~= nil then
		for _, system in pairs(self.systems) do
			system:on_destroy()
		end

		self.systems = nil
	end
end

function local_class:initialize(constants_key)
	self.level_constants = self.constants.levels[constants_key]

	-- FIXME : 위상 정렬 데이터를 사용해 initialize 정렬도 자동화
	self.systems.tile_map_accessor:initialize(self.level_constants.system.key_prefix,
			self.level_constants.system.camera_grid_name, self.level_constants.system.entity_specs)
	self.systems.utilities:initialize(self.level_constants.system.scene_version, self.level_constants.system.one_shot_sfx_volume)
	self.systems.evaluator:initialize(get_party_leader(), self.level_constants.system.key_prefix .. self.level_constants.system.target_zone)
	self.systems.entity_manager:initialize(self.level_constants.system.entity_specs)
	self.systems.bomb_manager:initialize()
	self.systems.attack_range_pool:initialize(self.level_constants.system.key_prefix)
	self.systems.fx_manager:initialize(self.level_constants.system.key_prefix)
	self.systems.dynamic_pattern_manager:initialize()
	self.systems.player_blocker:initialize()
end

function local_class:load_async()
	-- 로드하다가 싱크가 밀리지 않게 미리 로드해둠
	yield_return_func(music_player.PreloadMusic, music_player, self.level_constants.system.music_name)

	local need_load_bomb = false

	-- bomb을 사용하는지 확인
	-- FIXME : Preload 클립을 하나 만들어 두는 게?
	for i = 1, #self.level_constants.pattern.game do
		local pattern = self.level_constants.pattern.game[i]

		if string_helper.start_with(pattern.type, 'field_object.bomb') then
			need_load_bomb = true
		end
	end

	if need_load_bomb then
		self.systems.bomb_manager:load_async()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.systems ~= nil then
		for _, system in pairs(self.systems) do
			system:dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:game_routine(send_result_callback)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local result_data = {
		end_state = game_end_state.none,
		crashed_pair = nil,
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.loading

	do
		self:load_async()

		-- 카메라 타겟 변경 이후에 스테이트 전환이 일어나는 것을 대기해야 함.
		-- FIXME : 더 좋은 방법이 없을까?
		stage_camera:SetTarget(nil)
		coroutine.yield()

		-- 초기 세팅
		self:execute_patterns(self.level_constants.pattern.init)

		self.systems.fx_manager:wait_all()
	end

	self.current_state = self.state.intro

	self:intro_scene()

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, leader)

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	local start_time = unity_class.time.time

	self.pattern_walker = 1
	self.current_state = self.state.in_game

	self.systems.entity_manager:register_entity('player', leader)
	self.systems.entity_manager:add_to_field(leader)
	-- 일단 파티션에서 빼주자
	self.systems.entity_manager:on_before_move(leader)

	self.systems.utilities:change_access_type(system_access_type.all)

	while self.current_state == self.state.in_game do
		self.systems.entity_manager:on_after_move(leader)

		local time_passed = unity_class.time.time - start_time
		-- BPM 기준으로 어디쯤 카운트가 도달했는지를 확인하는 용도. 정수가 아닌 실수 형태이므로 주의할 것!!
		local bit_passed = time_passed * self.level_constants.system.bpm / 60

		self:update(bit_passed)

		self.systems.player_blocker:update()

		self:draw_bit_count(bit_passed)

		self.systems.utilities:clear_played_sfx_this_frame()

		result_data.end_state = self.systems.evaluator:get_evaluated_state()

		if result_data.end_state == game_end_state.none then
			self.systems.entity_manager:update()

			local crashed_fos = self.systems.entity_manager.crashed_fos

			if not table_util.is_empty(crashed_fos.enemy_to_npc) then
				result_data.end_state = game_end_state.npc_crashed_enemy

				local to, from = next(crashed_fos.enemy_to_npc)

				result_data.crashed_pair = {
					from = from,
					to = to,
				}

				self.current_state = self.state.game_overed

			elseif not table_util.is_empty(crashed_fos.player_to_npc) then
				result_data.end_state = game_end_state.player_crashed_npc

				local to, from = next(crashed_fos.player_to_npc)

				result_data.crashed_pair = {
					from = from,
					to = to,
				}

				self.current_state = self.state.game_overed
			end

			self.systems.entity_manager:clear_crash_data()
		else
			if result_data.end_state == game_end_state.player_enter_finish_line then
				self.current_state = self.state.game_done

			elseif result_data.end_state == game_end_state.player_exploded then
				self.current_state = self.state.game_overed
			end
		end

		self.systems.entity_manager:on_before_move(leader)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.systems.utilities:change_access_type(system_access_type.only_setting)

	local execute_dispose = function(need_call_dispose_pattern)
		-- end_bit 기준으로 job 정렬. 동작 해제 순서가 존재하므로, 그거에 맞추기 위함
		-- FIXME : sort 내부 동작을 모르는 상황인데, 이러면 같은 시점에 종료되는 job들끼리 순서가 꼬일 수도 있음.
		-- 커스텀 버블소트를 진행해야 할 수도
		do
			local comparer = function(clip_a, clip_b)
				return clip_a.end_bit < clip_b.end_bit
			end

			table.sort(self.running_behaviours, comparer)
		end

		for _, clip in pairs(self.running_behaviours) do
			clip:on_end()
			self.behaviour_pool:return_item(clip)
		end

		clear_table(self.running_behaviours)

		if need_call_dispose_pattern then
			self:execute_patterns(self.level_constants.pattern.dispose)

			while true do
				local next_clip_data = self.systems.dynamic_pattern_manager:move_dispose_clip()

				if next_clip_data == nil then
					break
				end

				local behaviour = self.behaviour_pool:get_or_create(next_clip_data.type, self.systems)

				behaviour:on_start(next_clip_data.args)
				behaviour:on_end()

				self.behaviour_pool:return_item(behaviour)
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.force_canceled then
		self.current_state = self.state.disposing

		execute_dispose(false)

		send_result_callback({
			succeed = false,
			force_canceled = true,
		})

		return
	end

	local succeed = self.current_state == self.state.game_done

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()

	--모든 섹션의 대행진 도어 오픈 이벤트가 종료된 후, 플레이어 컨트롤이 풀린 시점부터 진행.
	--플레이어 자유롭게 이동 가능하며, 배치되어 있던 플라워들은 벽이 되어, 이탈할 수 없도록 설정.
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	if succeed then
		self:succeed_scene()
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({
			state = 'muted',
			mix = 0,
		})

		self:failed_scene(result_data)
	end

	self.current_state = self.state.disposing

	do
		execute_dispose(true)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.01)
	end

	send_result_callback({
		succeed = succeed
	})

	self.systems.utilities:change_access_type(system_access_type.none)

	self.current_state = self.state.none
end

function local_class:execute_patterns(pattern_data)
	for i = 1, #pattern_data do
		local pattern = pattern_data[i]
		local behaviour = self.behaviour_pool:get_or_create(pattern.type, self.systems)

		behaviour:on_start(pattern.args)
		behaviour:on_end()

		self.behaviour_pool:return_item(behaviour)
	end
end

function local_class:update(bit_passed)
	do
		local walker = 1

		while walker <= #self.running_behaviours do
			local behaviour = self.running_behaviours[walker]

			if self:progress_behaviour(behaviour, bit_passed) then
				behaviour:on_end()
				self.behaviour_pool:return_item(behaviour)

				table.remove(self.running_behaviours, walker)
			else
				walker = walker + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- FIXME : 프레임이 튀어서 N개의 Behaviour를 처리할 떄, 먼저 들어온게 무조건 먼저 끝나는 문제가 생길 수 있음.
	-- Buffer를 하나 만들어서 순서대로 처리해야 함

	while self.pattern_walker <= #self.level_constants.pattern.game do
		local pattern = self.level_constants.pattern.game[self.pattern_walker]

		-- 정렬되어있음을 가정하고 있음
		if pattern.start_bit <= bit_passed then
			local behaviour = self.behaviour_pool:get_or_create(pattern.type, self.systems)

			behaviour.start_bit = pattern.start_bit
			behaviour.end_bit = pattern.end_bit or pattern.start_bit

			behaviour:on_start(pattern.args)

			if self:progress_behaviour(behaviour, bit_passed) then
				behaviour:on_end()
				self.behaviour_pool:return_item(behaviour)
			else
				-- 해당 업데이트로 종료되지 않았으면 running에 넣음
				self.running_behaviours[#self.running_behaviours + 1] = behaviour
			end

			self.pattern_walker = self.pattern_walker + 1
		else
			break
		end
	end

	while true do
		local next_clip_data = self.systems.dynamic_pattern_manager:move_game_clip(bit_passed)

		if next_clip_data == nil then
			break
		end

		local behaviour = self.behaviour_pool:get_or_create(next_clip_data.type, self.systems)

		behaviour.start_bit = next_clip_data.start_bit
		behaviour.end_bit = next_clip_data.end_bit or next_clip_data.start_bit

		behaviour:on_start(next_clip_data.args)

		if self:progress_behaviour(behaviour, bit_passed) then
			behaviour:on_end()
			self.behaviour_pool:return_item(behaviour)
		else
			-- 해당 업데이트로 종료되지 않았으면 running에 넣음
			self.running_behaviours[#self.running_behaviours + 1] = behaviour
		end
	end
end

---@return boolean 해당 Job이 완료되었으면 true, 아니면 false
function local_class:progress_behaviour(behaviour, bit_passed)
	-- duration이 0에 가깝거나 duration이 0보다 작으면 프로그레싱 없이 뱉음
	if (behaviour.end_bit - behaviour.start_bit) < constants.epsilon then
		return true
	end

	local local_bit_passed = bit_passed - behaviour.start_bit
	local progress = local_bit_passed / (behaviour.end_bit - behaviour.start_bit)
	local is_done = behaviour.end_bit <= bit_passed

	if progress >= 1 then
		progress = 1
	end

	local keep = behaviour:update_progress(progress, bit_passed)

	if keep == false then
		is_done = true
	end

	return is_done
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.current_state = self.state.force_canceled
end

function local_class:print_patterns()
	if not use_debug then
		return
	end

	for level_name, level in pairs(self.constants.levels) do
		local pattern = level.pattern

		local prev_bit = -100

		for i = 1, #pattern.init do
			local clip = pattern.init[i]

			print_clip(level_name .. '_' .. 'init', i, clip)
		end

		for i = 1, #pattern.game do
			local clip = pattern.game[i]

			-- 혹시라도 특정 패턴이 start_bit 정렬 기준에 맞지 않는다면 에러로그 출력
			-- 정렬을 해주는 방법도 있지만, 클립끼리 세팅 순서가 명확하게 적용되어야 하는 경우에
			-- 잘못 정렬하는 케이스를 막기 위해 일부러 에러로그만 띄운다.
			if clip.start_bit < prev_bit then
				logger_util.error(string.format(
						'Clip [index : %d / type : %s / start_bit : %d / end_bit : %d] is not Sorted by StartBit Order.',
						i, clip.type, clip.start_bit, clip.end_bit or clip.start_bit))
			end

			print_clip(level_name .. '_' .. 'game', i, clip)

			prev_bit = clip.start_bit
		end

		for i = 1, #pattern.dispose do
			local clip = pattern.dispose[i]

			print_clip(level_name .. '_' .. 'dispose', i, clip)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:draw_bit_count(bit_passed)
	if not use_debug then
		return
	end

	-- 0.2비트(0.1초) 가량만 빨갛게 출력
	local color = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(math.floor(bit_passed + 0.8) < bit_passed,
			unity_class.color.red, unity_class.color.green)

	CS.Oak.DebugDrawer.Instance:DrawText(self.systems.utilities:get_camera_position(),
			string.format('%.2f', bit_passed), 50, color)
end

function local_class:intro_scene()
	--모든 섹션의 대행진 입장 전 페이드 아웃 시점에서부터 시작.
	--페이드 인 시,
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	--플레이어 화면 좌측에서부터 right, awesome, jump로 좌측에서부터 날아와 지정 지점에 착지.
	--이때 꼬마 공주가 파티 합류상태하면, 플레이어 1타일 좌측 지점에서 right, awesome, jump 상태로 같이 날아와 착지.
	do
		local target_pivot = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_marker_pos(self.level_constants.system.start_marker)
		local start_pivot = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', target_pivot, -1.5)
		local speed = 12
		local max_height = 4
		local look_direction = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(start_pivot.x < target_pivot.x,
				direction_constants.right, direction_constants.left)

		local duration = (target_pivot - start_pivot).magnitude / speed
		local offset = unity_class.vector3.left

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local member = user_party[i]
			local member_offset = i * offset

			character_util.set_position(member, start_pivot + member_offset, true)
			character_util.set_direction(member, look_direction)
			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'awesome')
			scene_util.set_anim(member, self, 'get')
		end

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
			local cur_pivot_xz = start_pivot * (1 - progress) + target_pivot * progress
			local cur_height = math.cos(math.pi / 2 * progress) * max_height
			local cur_pivot = vector_util.get_x0z(cur_pivot_xz, cur_height)

			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				local member = user_party[i]
				local member_offset = i * offset

				character_util.set_position(member, cur_pivot + member_offset, true)
			end
		end)

		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	end

	--착지한 후 1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--각 난이도 시작 시, 나레이션 출력
	--나레이션 : 소리를 듣고 움직이기를 권장드립니다!
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({
		key = 'pw_grand_march_common_13'
	})

	--대기 종료되면 대행진 액티비티 시작.
end

		--폭탄 피격 시 아래의 연출 순서대로 실행.
		--플레이어 폭탄에 피격되면 right, damaged, dead를 실행.
		character_util.set_side_direction(leader)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')

		--분열 벌레
		--가까운 플라워 (벌레 방향, surprise, jump 1회) : 꺄아아악! 여기 불청객이 있어요!!
		--지정된 타겟을 향해, idle, jump(없을테니 공중으로 2타일 뜨며)를 실행하며 해당 스파인 우상단에 도착한다.
		--이후 하단의 연출 동시에 실행.
		--플라워 현재 방향, damaged, embarrassed, jump(0.5초 단위로 반복) 실행.
		--플레이어 플라워 방향, damaged, frustration 실행.
		--플레이어 동작 완료되면 화면 페이드 아웃.
		--페이드 인 시 대행진 시작 인터렉트 위치로 복귀. 섹션 유지.

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc, true)

		--가까운 플라워 (벌레 방향, surprise, jump 1회) : 꺄아아악! 여기 불청객이 있어요!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(npc, true)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(enemy, { look_target = npc, look_mode = 'side' })
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, { look_target = npc, look_mode = 'side' })
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc, self, { look_target = enemy, look_mode = 'side' },
				nil, { name = 'surprise', keep = true }, 'pw_grand_march_game_fail_enemy')

		--지정된 타겟을 향해, idle, jump(없을테니 공중으로 2타일 뜨며)를 실행하며 해당 스파인 우상단에 도착한다.
		do
			local is_looking_left = npc.Direction == direction_constants.left
			local x_offset = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_looking_left, -1, 1) * 0.3
			local target_pos = npc.Position + vector(x_offset, 0.5, 0)
			local start_pos = enemy.Position
			local enemy_angle = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_looking_left, 1, -1) * 60
			local duration = 0.3
			local max_height_adder = 0.7

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')

			character_util.spine_rotate(enemy, enemy_angle, duration)
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
				local cur_pivot = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
				local cur_y_adder = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * max_height_adder

				character_util.set_position(enemy, cur_pivot + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_y_adder, true)
			end)
		end

		--플라워 현재 방향, damaged, embarrassed,
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'damaged')
		character_util.shake(npc, 0.1, 999)

		--플레이어 플라워 방향, damaged, frustration 실행.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'frustration', keep_anim = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

		--플레이어 동작 완료되면 화면 페이드 아웃.
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

		character_util.stop_shake(npc)

		character_util.spine_rotate(enemy, 0, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	end
end

function local_class:succeed_scene()
	--플레이어 점프대 실행 시 화면 우측으로 사라지고, 화면 페이드 아웃.
	local jump_tile = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_field_object(self.level_constants.system.end_jump_tile_name)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')
	animator_util.play(jump_tile, 'on')

	do
		local start_pivot = get_party_leader().Position
		local target_pivot = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', start_pivot, 1.5)
		local speed = 12
		local max_height = 4
		local look_direction = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(start_pivot.x < target_pivot.x,
				direction_constants.right, direction_constants.left)

		local duration = (target_pivot - start_pivot).magnitude / speed
		local offset = unity_class.vector3.left

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local member = user_party[i]
			local member_offset = i * offset

			character_util.set_position(member, start_pivot + member_offset, true)
			character_util.set_direction(member, look_direction)
			scene_util.set_emotion(member, self, 'awesome')
			scene_util.set_anim(member, self, 'get')
		end

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
			local cur_pivot_xz = start_pivot * (1 - progress) + target_pivot * progress
			local cur_height = math.sin(math.pi / 2 * progress) * max_height
			local cur_pivot = vector_util.get_x0z(cur_pivot_xz, cur_height)

			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				local member = user_party[i]
				local member_offset = i * offset

				character_util.set_position(member, cur_pivot + member_offset, true)
			end
		end)

		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()
	end

	--꼬마 공주 합류 스펙이라면, 꼬마 공주도 같이 이탈하여 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	animator_util.play(jump_tile, 'off')
end

--region Behaviour Pool
do
	function behaviour_pool:init(behaviour_creators)
		self.behaviour_creators = behaviour_creators

		self.pools = {}

		-- 미리 생성해줌
		for type, _ in pairs(self.behaviour_creators) do
			self.pools[type] = {}
		end

		--region Debug
		if use_debug then
			self.created_counts = {}

			for type, _ in pairs(self.behaviour_creators) do
				self.created_counts[type] = 0
			end
		end
		--endregion Debug
	end

	function behaviour_pool:dispose()
		for type, pool in pairs(self.pools) do
			if use_debug then
				local not_returned_item_count = self.created_counts[type] - #pool

				if not_returned_item_count ~= 0 then
					logger_util.warning(
							'PixyWorldGrandMarchGameBehaviourPool : Behaviour[type : ' ..
									type .. ', count : ' .. not_returned_item_count .. '] is not returned to pool.')
				end
			end

			for _, item in pairs(pool) do
				item:dispose()
			end

			clear_table(pool)
		end
	end

	function behaviour_pool:get_or_create(type, global_systems)
		local pool = self.pools[type]

		if pool == nil then
			if use_debug then
				logger_util.error(string.format('Has no pool type named [%s]', type))
			end

			type = 'null'
			pool = self.pools[type]
		end

		if #pool == 0 then
			if use_debug then
				self.created_counts[type] = self.created_counts[type] + 1
			end

			return self.behaviour_creators[type](global_systems)
		else
			local item = pool[#pool]

			pool[#pool] = nil

			return item
		end
	end

	function behaviour_pool:return_item(item)
		local type = item.type
		local pool = self.pools[type]

		pool[#pool + 1] = item
	end

	function behaviour_pool:print()
		if not use_debug then
			return
		end

		local text = 'PixyWorldGrandMarchGameBehaviourPool\n'

		for type, pool in pairs(self.pools) do
			local sub_text = string.format('[Type : %s] Created : %d, Contained : %d\n',
					type, self.created_counts[type], #pool)

			text = text .. sub_text
		end

		logger_util.log(text)
	end
end
--endregion Behaviour Pool

do
	function tile_map_accessor:init(systems)
		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameGlobalSystems
		self.systems = systems
		self.key_prefix = nil

		-- string 합성을 자주 진행하므로, 별도의 캐시 시스템을 구성
		self.cached_characters = {}
		self.cached_fos = {}
		self.cached_markers = {}

		self.camera_grid = nil

		---@type table<string, { prefix:string, using_count:number }>
		self.character_pools = {}
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:on_destroy()
		self.key_prefix = nil

		self.cached_characters = nil
		self.cached_fos = nil
		self.cached_markers = nil

		self.camera_grid = nil
		self.systems = nil
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:initialize(key_prefix, camera_grid_name, entity_specs)
		self.key_prefix = key_prefix

		self.camera_grid = nil

		camera_grid_name = key_prefix .. camera_grid_name

		for i = 1, field.CameraGrids.Count do
			local grid = field.CameraGrids[i - 1]

			if grid.name == camera_grid_name then
				self.camera_grid = grid

				break
			end
		end

		if use_debug then
			-- 카메라 그리드를 찾지 못했다면 에러 뱉음
			if self.camera_grid == nil then
				logger_util.error('Cannot found game CameraGrid [Name : ' .. camera_grid_name .. ']')
			end
		end

		for spec_name, spec in pairs(entity_specs) do
			if spec.prefix ~= nil then
				self.character_pools[spec_name] = {
					prefix = spec.prefix,
					spine_scale = spec.spine_scale,
					using_count = 0,
				}
			end
		end

		--대행진 진행과정 중에 배치된 [GIMMICK]trap_cliff 은 충돌하지 않고, 지나다닐 수 있는 스펙입니다.
		-- FIXME : 급하니까 대충 떼웠는데... 이걸 어디다가 넣어야 하는가?
		do
			local bounds = self:get_camera_grid().bounds
			local check_height = 1
			local check_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(vector_util.get_x0z(bounds.center, check_height / 2),
					vector_util.get_x0z(bounds.size, check_height))

			---@type IFieldObject[]
			local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(check_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			for i = 1, fo_list.Count do
				local fo = fo_list[i - 1]

				if fo.Name == '[gimmick]pixy_trap_cliff' then
					field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.visible)
				elseif lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BombFieldObjectBehaviour) then
					field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
				end
			end

			fo_list:Dispose()
		end
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:dispose()
		clear_table(self.cached_characters)
		clear_table(self.character_pools)
		clear_table(self.cached_fos)
		clear_table(self.cached_markers)

		self.camera_grid = nil

		self.key_prefix = nil
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:create_character(spec_name, character_name)
		if self.cached_characters[character_name] ~= nil then
			if use_debug then
				logger_util.warning('Trying to Register Npc [Name : ' .. character_name .. ' ] twice or more.')
			end

			return
		end

		local pool = self.character_pools[spec_name]

		pool.using_count = pool.using_count + 1

		local handle_name = pool.prefix .. pool.using_count
		local character = get_character(handle_name)

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		if pool.spine_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.spine_scale(character, pool.spine_scale * unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
			character.SpineController.ShadowScale = pool.spine_scale

			character.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.01)
		end

		self.cached_characters[character_name] = character

		return character
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:get_character(name)
		return self.cached_characters[name]
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:get_field_object(name)
		if self.cached_fos[name] == nil then
			self.cached_fos[name] = get_field_object(self.key_prefix .. name)
		end

		return self.cached_fos[name]
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:get_marker(name)
		if self.cached_markers[name] == nil then
			self.cached_markers[name] = field_util.get_marker(self.key_prefix .. name)
		end

		return self.cached_markers[name]
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:get_marker_pos(name)
		return self:get_marker(name).position
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:get_marker_dir(name)
		return self:get_marker(name).direction
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:get_door_name(door_name)
		return self.key_prefix .. door_name
	end

	function tile_map_accessor:get_camera_grid()
		return self.camera_grid
	end
end

do
	---@private
	function utilities:init(systems, type_const)
		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameGlobalSystems
		self.systems = systems

		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameTypeConst
		self.type_const = type_const

		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		self.camera_pos = nil

		self.access_type = system_access_type.none

		self.fo_offsets = nil

		self.one_shot_sfx_volume = nil

		self.played_sfx_this_frame = {}
	end

	function utilities:on_destroy()
		self.access_type = system_access_type.none

		self.type_const = nil

		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		self.camera_pos = nil

		self.fo_offsets = nil

		self.systems = nil

		self.played_sfx_this_frame = nil
	end

	function utilities:initialize(scene_version, one_shot_sfx_volume)
		self.scene_version = scene_version

		self.camera_pos = nil

		self.fo_offsets = {}

		self.access_type = system_access_type.only_setting

		self.one_shot_sfx_volume = one_shot_sfx_volume
	end

	function utilities:dispose()
		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		self.camera_pos = nil

		self.fo_offsets = nil

		self.access_type = system_access_type.none

		self.one_shot_sfx_volume = nil

		clear_table(self.played_sfx_this_frame)
	end

	function utilities:change_access_type(type)
		self.access_type = type
	end

	function utilities:set_fo_offset_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local offset = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'offset', common_data, nil)

		-- false여도 실행 안시킴
		if offset then
			self:set_fo_offset(character, offset)
		end
	end

	function utilities:reset_fo_offset_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local reset_offset = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'reset_offset', common_data, nil)

		-- false여도 실행 안시킴
		if reset_offset then
			self:set_fo_offset(character, nil)
		end
	end

	function utilities:set_anim_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local anim_data = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'anim', common_data, nil)

		-- false여도 실행 안시킴
		if anim_data then
			self:set_anim(character, anim_data)
		end
	end

	function utilities:set_emotion_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local emotion_data = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'emotion', common_data, nil)

		-- false여도 실행 안시킴
		if emotion_data then
			self:set_emotion(character, emotion_data)
		end
	end

	function utilities:set_direction_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local direction = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'direction', common_data, nil)

		if direction then
			self:set_direction(character, direction)
		end
	end

	function utilities:set_position_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local position_name = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'position', common_data, nil)
		local world_pos = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'world_pos', common_data, nil)

		if position_name then
			self:set_position(character, self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_marker_pos(position_name))
		elseif world_pos then
			self:set_position(character, world_pos)
		end
	end

	function utilities:remove_anim_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local remove_anim_type = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'remove_anim_type',
				common_data, self.type_const.remove_anim_type.none)

		if remove_anim_type == self.type_const.remove_anim_type.normal or
				remove_anim_type == self.type_const.remove_anim_type.both then
			self:remove_anim(character)
		end

		if remove_anim_type == self.type_const.remove_anim_type.upper or
				remove_anim_type == self.type_const.remove_anim_type.both then
			self:remove_anim(character, true)
		end
	end

	function utilities:remove_emotion_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local remove_emotion = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'remove_emotion', common_data, nil)

		if remove_emotion then
			self:remove_emotion(character)
		end
	end

	function utilities:set_spine_scale_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local scale = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'spine_scale', common_data, nil)

		if scale then
			self:set_spine_scale(character, scale)
		end
	end

	function utilities:force_update_spine_by_data(character, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local force_update_spine = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'force_update_spine', common_data, nil)

		if force_update_spine then
			self:force_update_spine(character)
		end
	end

	function utilities:set_active_state_by_data(fo, data, common_data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local active_state = self:get_override_or_common(data, 'active_state', common_data, nil)

		if active_state then
			self:set_active_state(fo, active_state)
		end
	end

	function utilities:set_fo_offset(fo, offset)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		self.fo_offsets[fo] = offset
	end

	function utilities:get_fo_position(fo)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return unity_class.vector3.zero
		end

		local offset = self.fo_offsets[fo]
		local world_pos = fo.Position

		if offset ~= nil then
			world_pos = world_pos - offset
		end

		return world_pos
	end

	function utilities:set_position(character, position, is_flying)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local offset = self.fo_offsets[character]

		if offset ~= nil then
			position = position + offset
		end

		self.systems.entity_manager:on_before_move(character)

		character_util.set_position(character, position, is_flying)

		self.systems.entity_manager:on_after_move(character)
	end

	function utilities:set_direction(character, direction)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		character_util.set_direction(character, direction)
	end

	function utilities:set_anim(character, args)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		scene_util.set_anim(character, self, args)
	end

	function utilities:set_emotion(character, args)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, args)
	end

	function utilities:remove_anim(character, upper)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(character, upper)
	end

	function utilities:remove_emotion(character)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		character_util.remove_emotion(character)
	end

	function utilities:set_spine_scale(character, scale)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		-- FIXME
		-- Coroutine 업데이트가 SpineController 업데이트보다 늦어, Scale 업데이트가 바로는 안되어있을 것이다.
		-- 일단 제일 빠른 방법은 첫 세팅 시점에 set_scale 클립을 하나 더 넣어두는 것
		character_util.spine_scale(character, scale * unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

		self.systems.entity_manager:change_scale(character, scale)
	end

	function utilities:force_update_spine(character)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		character.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.001)
	end

	function utilities:set_spine_alpha(character, alpha)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, alpha, 0)
	end

	function utilities:set_spine_y_offset(character, y_offset)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		character.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.up * y_offset

		--self.systems.entity_manager:change_y_offset(character, y_offset)
	end

	function utilities:jump(character, height, duration)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		character_util.jump(character, height, duration)
	end

	function utilities:play_fo_anim(fo, anim_name)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		animator_util.play(fo, anim_name)
	end

	function utilities:set_active_state(fo, active_state)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state)
	end

	function utilities:open_door(door_name, immediately)
		door_name = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_door_name(door_name)
		immediately = lua_helper.get_or_default(immediately, false)

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name, immediately))
	end

	function utilities:close_door(door_name, immediately)
		door_name = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_door_name(door_name)
		immediately = lua_helper.get_or_default(immediately, false)

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door_name, immediately))
	end

	function utilities:set_camera_by_data(data)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local min_size_info = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'min_size_info', nil)
		local position_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'position', nil)

		if min_size_info then
			local size_fit_to_height = min_size_info.height * 0.5
			local size_fit_to_width = min_size_info.width * 0.5 / stage_camera.Camera.aspect

			-- 연출처럼 적당히 비율로 계산하는 게 아니기에 orthographicSize를 세팅
			camera_util.resize_to(math.max(size_fit_to_height, size_fit_to_width), 0)
		else
			camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
		end

		if position_name then
			local position = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_marker_pos(position_name)
			local grid = self.systems.tile_map_accessor:get_camera_grid()

			self:set_camera_position(position, grid)
		end
	end

	function utilities:set_camera_position(target_pos, camera_grid)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		local pos_in_grid = camera_grid:GetCameraPosInGrid(target_pos, stage_camera.HalfWidth, stage_camera.Size)
		local pivot = stage_camera.Transform.parent

		pivot.position = pos_in_grid

		self.camera_pos = pos_in_grid
	end

	function utilities:get_camera_position()
		if self.camera_pos == nil then
			return stage_camera.LookAtPosition
		end

		return self.camera_pos
	end

	function utilities:play_bgm(bgm_name, mix)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none or self.access_type == system_access_type.only_setting then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = bgm_name, mix = mix })
	end

	function utilities:mute_bgm(mix)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = mix })
	end

	function utilities:play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_name, volume)
		if self.access_type == system_access_type.none or self.access_type == system_access_type.only_setting then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, #self.played_sfx_this_frame do
			if self.played_sfx_this_frame[i] == sfx_name then
				return
			end
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_name, volume or self.one_shot_sfx_volume)

		self.played_sfx_this_frame[#self.played_sfx_this_frame + 1] = sfx_name
	end

	function utilities:clear_played_sfx_this_frame()
		if #self.played_sfx_this_frame == 0 then
			return
		end

		clear_table(self.played_sfx_this_frame)
	end

	---@private
	function utilities:get_override_or_common(data, key, common_data, default)
		if data ~= nil then
			local result = data[key]

			if result ~= nil then
				return result
			end
		end

		if common_data ~= nil then
			local result = common_data[key]

			if result ~= nil then
				return result
			end
		end

		return default
	end
end

do
	function evaluator:init(systems)
		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameGlobalSystems
		self.systems = systems

		self.target_zone_name = nil
		self.entered_target_zone = false

		---@type ICharacter
		self.player = nil

		self.exploded_by_bomb = false
	end

	function evaluator:on_destroy()
		self.player = nil
		self.systems = nil
		self.crashed_fo = nil
	end

	function evaluator:initialize(player, target_zone)
		self.player = player
		self.target_zone_name = target_zone

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	end

	function evaluator:dispose()
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

		self.entered_target_zone = false
		self.target_zone_name = nil
		self.exploded_by_bomb = false
	end

	function evaluator:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		if not self.entered_target_zone and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.player, self.target_zone_name) then
			self.entered_target_zone = true

			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	function evaluator:evaluate_exploded(bomb_position, explode_radius)
		if ignore_crash_for_test then
			return
		end

		if self.exploded_by_bomb then
			return
		end

		-- FIXME : 최적화를 위해서 적당히 거리만 계산하는데, 더 좋은 방법이 있을까?
		explode_radius = explode_radius + 0.2

		if vector_util.get_x0z(bomb_position - self.player.Position).sqrMagnitude < explode_radius * explode_radius then
			self.exploded_by_bomb = true
		end
	end

	function evaluator:get_evaluated_state()
		if self.entered_target_zone then
			return game_end_state.player_enter_finish_line
		elseif self.exploded_by_bomb then
			return game_end_state.player_exploded
		end

		return game_end_state.none
	end
end

do
	function entity_manager:init(systems, type_const)
		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameGlobalSystems
		self.systems = systems

		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameTypeConst
		self.type_const = type_const

		---@type table<IFieldObject, { type:number, extents:number,  y_offset:number, in_field:boolean }>
		self.entities = nil

		---@type table<string, { type:number, extents:number, spine_scale:number, split_spec:{ spec_name:string, offset:Vector3}[] }>
		self.entity_specs = nil

		---@type table<number, LuaHashSet>
		self.type_to_entities = {}

		for _, type in pairs(self.type_const.entity_type) do
			self.type_to_entities[type] = create_lua_hashset()
		end

		self.crashed_fos = {
			enemy_to_npc = {},
			player_to_npc = {},
			player_to_enemy = {},
		}

		self.partition = entity_partition:new()

		-- 엑셀 타일 타는 도중에는 판정을 좀 널널하게 주기 위함
		self.player_extents_ratio_on_accel_dash = 0.5
	end

	function entity_manager:on_destroy()
		if self.partition ~= nil then
			self.partition:dispose()
			self.partition = nil
		end

		self.entities = nil

		self.systems = nil
	end

	function entity_manager:initialize(entity_specs)
		self.entities = {}

		self.entity_specs = entity_specs
	end

	function entity_manager:dispose()
		clear_table(self.entities)

		for _, container in pairs(self.type_to_entities) do
			container:clear()
		end

		for _, container in pairs(self.crashed_fos) do
			clear_table(container)
		end

		self.entity_specs = nil

		self.partition:log_remain()
	end

	function entity_manager:register_entity(spec_name, character)
		local spec = self.entity_specs[spec_name]

		self.entities[character] = {
			type = spec.type,
			extents = spec.extents,
			override_extents = spec.override_extents,
			y_offset = 0,
			in_field = false,
		}

		self.type_to_entities[spec.type]:add(character)
	end

	function entity_manager:unregister(fo)
		self:remove_from_field(fo)

		self.type_to_entities[self.entities[fo].type]:remove(fo)

		self.entities[fo] = nil
	end

	function entity_manager:kill_enemy(fo)
		local info = self.entities[fo]

		if info.type ~= self.type_const.entity_type.enemy then
			if use_debug then
				logger_util.warning('Cannot kill Non-Hostile Entity [Name : ' .. fo.Name .. ']')
			end

			return
		end

		self:unregister(fo)
	end

	function entity_manager:add_to_field(fo)
		if not self:is_valid_entity(fo) then
			return
		end

		if not self.entities[fo].in_field then
			self.entities[fo].in_field = true

			self.partition:add(fo, self.entities[fo].extents)
		end
	end

	function entity_manager:remove_from_field(fo)
		if not self:is_valid_entity(fo) then
			return
		end

		if self.entities[fo].in_field then
			self.entities[fo].in_field = false

			self.partition:remove(fo, self.entities[fo].extents)
		end
	end

	function entity_manager:on_before_move(fo)
		if not self:is_valid_entity(fo) then
			return
		end

		if self.entities[fo] ~= nil and self.entities[fo].in_field then
			self.partition:remove(fo, self.entities[fo].extents)
		end
	end

	function entity_manager:on_after_move(fo)
		if not self:is_valid_entity(fo) then
			return
		end

		if self.entities[fo] ~= nil and self.entities[fo].in_field then
			self.partition:add(fo, self.entities[fo].extents)
		end
	end

	function entity_manager:change_scale(fo, bounds_scale)
		if not self:is_valid_entity(fo) then
			return
		end

		self.entities[fo].extents = bounds_scale * 0.5
	end

	function entity_manager:change_y_offset(fo, y_offset)
		if not self:is_valid_entity(fo) then
			return
		end

		self.entities[fo].y_offset = y_offset
	end

	function entity_manager:is_valid_entity(fo)
		return self.entities[fo] ~= nil
	end

	function entity_manager:update()
		for player in pairs(self.type_to_entities[self.type_const.entity_type.player]) do
			self:calculate_entity_crash(player, self.type_const.entity_type.enemy, self.crashed_fos.player_to_enemy,
					true, false)
		end

		if not table_util.is_empty(self.crashed_fos.player_to_enemy) then
			for to, from in pairs(self.crashed_fos.player_to_enemy) do
				self:kill_enemy(to)
			end
		end

		if not ignore_crash_for_test then
			for player in pairs(self.type_to_entities[self.type_const.entity_type.player]) do
				local origin_extents

				if lua_helper.type_compare(player.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterForcedDashState) then
					origin_extents = self.entities[player].extents

					self.entities[player].extents = origin_extents * self.player_extents_ratio_on_accel_dash
				end

				self:calculate_entity_crash(player, self.type_const.entity_type.npc, self.crashed_fos.player_to_npc)

				if origin_extents ~= nil then
					self.entities[player].extents = origin_extents
				end
			end

			for killable in pairs(self.type_to_entities[self.type_const.entity_type.enemy]) do
				self:calculate_entity_crash(killable, self.type_const.entity_type.npc, self.crashed_fos.enemy_to_npc)
			end
		end

		if use_debug then
			for fo, info in pairs(self.entities) do
				if info.in_field then
					local color

					if info.type == self.type_const.entity_type.player then
						color = unity_class.color.cyan
					elseif info.type == self.type_const.entity_type.enemy then
						color = unity_class.color.red
					elseif info.type == self.type_const.entity_type.npc then
						color = unity_class.color.blue
					end

					local min, max = self:get_bounds_min_max(fo)

					self:draw_debug_cube(min, max, color)

					if info.override_extents ~= nil then
						min, max = self:get_bounds_min_max(fo, true)

						self:draw_debug_cube(min, max, unity_class.color.black)
					end
				end
			end

			for _, container in pairs(self.crashed_fos) do
				for to, from in pairs(container) do
					CS.Oak.DebugDrawer.Instance:DrawLineSegment(
							from.Bounds.center,
							to.Bounds.center,
							unity_class.color.magenta
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function entity_manager:clear_crash_data()
		for _, container in pairs(self.crashed_fos) do
			clear_table(container)
		end
	end

	function entity_manager:calculate_entity_crash(fo, target_type, out_table, use_from_override_extents, use_to_override_extents)
		local info = self.entities[fo]

		if not info.in_field then
			return
		end

		local fo_min, fo_max = self:get_bounds_min_max(fo, use_from_override_extents)
		local min_id, max_id = self.partition:get_partition_ids_by_min_max(fo_min.x, fo_max.x)

		for id = min_id, max_id do
			local sector = self.partition:get(id)

			if sector == nil then
				goto continue_sector
			end

			for other in pairs(sector) do
				if out_table[other] ~= nil then
					goto continue_entity
				end

				local other_info = self.entities[other]

				if other_info.in_field and other_info.type == target_type then
					local other_min, other_max = self:get_bounds_min_max(other, use_to_override_extents)

					if self:is_overlapping(fo_min, fo_max, other_min, other_max) then
						out_table[other] = fo
					end
				end

				:: continue_entity ::
			end

			:: continue_sector ::
		end
	end

	function entity_manager:calculate_custom_crash_player_and_enemy(enemy, crash_calculator)
		for player in pairs(self.type_to_entities[self.type_const.entity_type.player]) do
			local player_info = self.entities[player]
			local enemy_info = self.entities[enemy]

			if player_info.in_field and enemy_info.in_field then
				if crash_calculator(enemy, enemy_info, player, player_info) then
					self.crashed_fos.player_to_enemy[enemy] = player

					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	function entity_manager:get_bounds_min_max(fo, use_override)
		local info = self.entities[fo]
		local extents = info.extents

		if use_override and info.override_extents ~= nil then
			extents = info.override_extents
		end

		local center_pivot = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center, fo.Position.y + info.y_offset)
		local fo_min = center_pivot + extents * vector(-1, 0, -1)
		local fo_max = center_pivot + extents * vector(1, 2, 1)

		return fo_min, fo_max
	end

	function entity_manager:draw_debug_cube(bounds_min, bounds_max, color)
		if not use_debug then
			return
		end

		local center = (bounds_min + bounds_max) * 0.5
		local size = (bounds_max - bounds_min)

		CS.Oak.DebugDrawer.Instance:DrawCube(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size), color)
	end

	---@private
	function entity_manager:is_overlapping(src_min, src_max, dest_min, dest_max)
		return dest_min.x <= src_max.x and src_min.x <= dest_max.x and
				--dest_min.y <= src_max.y and src_min.y <= dest_max.y and
				dest_min.z <= src_max.z and src_min.z <= dest_max.z
	end
end

do
	function entity_partition:init()
		self.x_size = 3
		self.container = {}
	end

	function entity_partition:dispose()
		self:log_remain()

		clear_table(self.container)
	end

	function entity_partition:log_remain()
		if not use_debug then
			return
		end

		for _, targets in pairs(self.container) do
			if #targets > 0 then
				local text = '[ '

				for target in pairs(targets) do
					text = text .. target.Name .. ' '
				end

				text = text .. ']'

				logger_util.warning(
						'[PixyWorldGrandMarchGameSystemCrashManager] ' .. text .. ' remained in Partition.')
			end
		end
	end

	function entity_partition:get(partition_id)
		return self.container[partition_id]
	end

	function entity_partition:add(target, x_extents)
		local min_id, max_id = self:get_partition_ids(target.Position, x_extents)

		for i = min_id, max_id do
			if self.container[i] == nil then
				self.container[i] = create_lua_hashset()
			end

			self.container[i]:add(target)
		end
	end

	function entity_partition:remove(target, x_extents)
		-- 지울 때에는 살짝 더 늘려서 부동소수점 이슈로 지워지지 않는 케이스를 방지한다.
		x_extents = x_extents + constants.epsilon

		local min_id, max_id = self:get_partition_ids(target.Position, x_extents)

		for i = min_id, max_id do
			if self.container[i] ~= nil then
				self.container[i]:remove(target)
			end
		end
	end

	function entity_partition:get_partition_ids(position, x_extents)
		local min_x = position.x - x_extents
		local max_x = position.x + x_extents

		return self:get_partition_ids_by_min_max(min_x, max_x)
	end

	function entity_partition:get_partition_ids_by_min_max(min_x, max_x)
		local min_id = math.floor(min_x / self.x_size)
		local max_id = math.floor(max_x / self.x_size)

		return min_id, max_id
	end

	function entity_partition:draw_sectors(partition_id)
		if not use_debug then
			return
		end

		local x = partition_id * self.x_size
		local z_center = stage_camera.LookAtPosition.z
		local extents = 10

		CS.Oak.DebugDrawer.Instance:DrawLineSegment(
				vector(x, 0, z_center + extents),
				vector(x, 0, z_center - extents),
				unity_class.color.red
		)
	end
end

do
	function bomb_manager:init(systems)
		self.systems = systems

		self.object_to_clone = nil

		self.pool = {}

		self.created_count = 0

		self.using_bomb_map = {}
	end

	function bomb_manager:load_async()
		if not is_unity_null(self.object_to_clone) then
			return
		end

		self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		local tileset = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resource_holder,
				'tilesets/gimmick', 'gimmick.tileset')
		local bomb = tileset.transform:Find('[GIMMICK]bomb1')

		self.object_to_clone = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(bomb.gameObject)
		self.object_to_clone.transform:Find('mesh/bomb1/root_wick/wick/FX_BombSpark_mesh').gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.object_to_clone.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		-- 원하는 거는 복사했으니 삭제
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(tileset)
	end

	function bomb_manager:on_destroy()
		if self.pool ~= nil then
			for _, item in pairs(self.pool) do
				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(item)
			end

			self.pool = nil
		end

		if not is_unity_null(self.object_to_clone) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.object_to_clone)
		end

		self.object_to_clone = nil

		if self.resource_holder ~= nil then
			self.resource_holder:Dispose()
			self.resource_holder = nil
		end

		self.systems = nil
	end

	function bomb_manager:initialize()
	end

	function bomb_manager:dispose()
		if use_debug then
			local not_returned_item_count = self.created_count - #self.pool

			if not_returned_item_count > 0 then
				logger_util.error('[PixyWorldGrandMarchGameBombPool] ' ..
						not_returned_item_count .. ' items were not returned to pool.')
			end
		end

		clear_table(self.using_bomb_map)
	end

	function bomb_manager:preload(min_count)
		for _ = #self.pool + 1, min_count do
			self.pool[#self.pool + 1] = self:create(false)
		end
	end

	---@private
	function bomb_manager:create(active_self)
		local new_item = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(self.object_to_clone)

		if use_debug then
			self.created_count = self.created_count + 1
		end

		new_item:SetActive(active_self)

		return new_item
	end

	---@return GameObject
	function bomb_manager:instantiate(name, position)
		local item

		if #self.pool == 0 then
			item = self:create(true)
		else
			item = self.pool[#self.pool]

			self.pool[#self.pool] = nil

			item:SetActive(true)
		end

		item.transform.position = position

		if self.using_bomb_map[name] == nil then
			self.using_bomb_map[name] = item
		elseif use_debug then
			logger_util.error('[PixyWorldGrandMarchGameBombPool] [Item Name : ' .. name .. '] is already using!')
		end

		return item
	end

	---@return GameObject
	function bomb_manager:get_instance(name)
		return self.using_bomb_map[name]
	end

	function bomb_manager:dispose_instance(name)
		local item = self:get_instance(name)

		if item == nil then
			return
		end

		if use_debug then
			for _, other in pairs(self.pool) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(item, other) then
					logger_util.error('[PixyWorldGrandMarchGameBombPool] Item is already contained to Bomb Pool!!')

					return
				end
			end
		end

		item:SetActive(false)

		self.pool[#self.pool + 1] = item
		self.using_bomb_map[name] = nil
	end
end

do
	attack_range_pool.default_offset = unity_class.vector3.up * 0.1

	function attack_range_pool:init(systems, type_const)
		self.systems = systems

		---@type table<string, table> PresetKey to Pool
		self.pools = {}

		self.created_counts = {}

		self.preset_storage = {}

		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameTypeConst
		self.type_const = type_const

		self.data_prefix = nil
	end

	function attack_range_pool:on_destroy()
		if self.pools ~= nil then
			for _, pool in pairs(self.pools) do
				for _, item in pairs(pool) do
					attack_range_util.destroy(item)
				end
			end

			self.pools = nil
		end

		self.preset_storage = nil

		self.created_counts = nil

		self.systems = nil

		self.type_const = nil
	end

	function attack_range_pool:initialize(data_prefix)
		self.data_prefix = data_prefix
	end

	function attack_range_pool:dispose()
		if use_debug then
			for preset_key, pool in pairs(self.pools) do
				if self.created_counts[preset_key] ~= nil then
					local not_returned_item_count = self.created_counts[preset_key] - #pool

					if not_returned_item_count > 0 then
						logger_util.error('[PixyWorldGrandMarchGameAttackRangePool] [Preset Key : ' ..
								preset_key .. '] : ' .. not_returned_item_count .. ' items were not returned to pool.')
					end
				end
			end
		end

		self.data_prefix = nil
	end

	function attack_range_pool:preload(preset_key, preset_data, min_count)
		preset_key = self.data_prefix .. preset_key

		self.preset_storage[preset_key] = preset_data

		if self.pools[preset_key] == nil then
			self.pools[preset_key] = {}
		end

		if use_debug and self.created_counts[preset_key] == nil then
			self.created_counts[preset_key] = 0
		end

		if self.preset_storage[preset_key] ~= nil then
			local pool = self.pools[preset_key]

			for _ = #pool + 1, min_count do
				local item = self:create(preset_key)

				attack_range_util.hide(item)

				pool[#pool + 1] = item
			end
		else
			if use_debug then
				logger_util.warning('[PixyWorldGrandMarchGameAttackRangePool] Cannot find [Preset Key : ' ..
						preset_key .. '] on Preset Data List.')
			end
		end
	end

	---@private
	function attack_range_pool:create(preset_key, position)
		local preset_data = self.preset_storage[preset_key]

		if use_debug then
			self.created_counts[preset_key] = self.created_counts[preset_key] + 1
		end

		if position == nil then
			position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		else
			position = position + self.default_offset
		end

		if preset_data.shape == self.type_const.attack_range_shape.circle then
			return attack_range_util.create_circle_by_color_key(preset_data.color_key,
					position, preset_data.radius, preset_data.show_type)
		else
			-- TODO : 타입 추가
			return nil
		end
	end

	function attack_range_pool:get_or_create(preset_key, position)
		preset_key = self.data_prefix .. preset_key

		local pool = self.pools[preset_key]

		if #pool == 0 then
			local new_item = self:create(preset_key, position)

			return new_item
		else
			local item = pool[#pool]

			pool[#pool] = nil

			if position ~= nil then
				item.CacheTransform.position = position + self.default_offset
			end

			attack_range_util.show(item)

			return item
		end
	end

	function attack_range_pool:return_item(preset_key, item)
		local pool = self.pools[self.data_prefix .. preset_key]

		attack_range_util.hide(item)

		pool[#pool + 1] = item
	end
end

		self.pools = nil
