		self.is_dirty = false
	end

	function fx_manager:dispose()
		self.data_prefix = nil
	end

	function fx_manager:add_preset_with_preload(preset_key, spec)
		if self.pools[preset_key] == nil then
			self.pools[preset_key] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(spec.name)
			self.preset_map[preset_key] = spec

			self.is_dirty = true
		end
	end

	function fx_manager:wait_all()
		if not self.is_dirty then
			return
		end

		yield_return_func(unity_object_pool.WaitAll)

		self.is_dirty = false
	end

	function fx_manager:get_or_create(preset_key, position)
		local effect = self.pools[preset_key]:Instantiate(position)
		local preset = self.preset_map[preset_key]

		if preset.scale ~= nil then
			effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * preset.scale
		end

		return effect
	end
end

do
	function dynamic_pattern_manager:init(systems)
		self.systems = systems

		self.next_game_clip_walker = 1
		self.game_clips = {}

		self.next_dispose_clip_walker = 1
		self.dispose_clips = {}
	end

	function dynamic_pattern_manager:on_destroy()
		self.systems = nil
		self.game_clips = nil
		self.dispose_clips = nil
	end

	function dynamic_pattern_manager:initialize()
	end

	function dynamic_pattern_manager:dispose()
		self.next_game_clip_walker = 1
		self.next_dispose_clip_walker = 1

		clear_table(self.game_clips)
		clear_table(self.dispose_clips)
	end

	function dynamic_pattern_manager:add_game_clip(clip_data)
		local prev_data = self.game_clips[self.next_game_clip_walker - 1]

		if prev_data ~= nil and prev_data.start_bit > clip_data.start_bit then
			-- 지나간 클립보다 더 이른 시간에 발동했어야 했다면 Warning을 띄워줌
			if use_debug then
				logger_util.warning(string.format(
						'Dynamic Clip [type : %s / start_bit : %d / end_bit : %d] need to added before the past clips',
						clip_data.type, clip_data.start_bit, clip_data.end_bit or clip_data.start_bit))
			end
		end

		for i = self.next_game_clip_walker, #self.game_clips do
			if self.game_clips[i].start_bit > clip_data.start_bit then
				table.insert(self.game_clips, i, clip_data)

				if use_debug then
					print_clip('game_dynamic', i, clip_data)
				end

				return
			end
		end

		if use_debug then
			print_clip('game_dynamic', #self.game_clips + 1, clip_data)
		end

		self.game_clips[#self.game_clips + 1] = clip_data
	end

	function dynamic_pattern_manager:add_dispose_clip(clip_data)
		-- 얘는 그냥 뒤에 쌓아버려도 됨
		self.dispose_clips[#self.dispose_clips + 1] = clip_data
	end

	function dynamic_pattern_manager:move_game_clip(bit_passed)
		if self.next_game_clip_walker > #self.game_clips then
			return nil
		end

		local next_data = self.game_clips[self.next_game_clip_walker]

		if next_data.start_bit <= bit_passed then
			self.next_game_clip_walker = self.next_game_clip_walker + 1

			return next_data
		end

		return nil
	end

	function dynamic_pattern_manager:move_dispose_clip()
		local next_data = self.dispose_clips[self.next_dispose_clip_walker]

		if next_data == nil then
			return nil
		end

		self.next_dispose_clip_walker = self.next_dispose_clip_walker + 1

		return next_data
	end
end

do
	function player_blocker:init(systems, type_const)
		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameGlobalSystems
		self.systems = systems

		---@type PixyWorldGrandMarchGameTypeConst
		self.type_const = type_const

		self.blockers = {
			min_x = {
				value = nil,
				calculate_blocked_pos = function(this, position)
					if position.x < this.value.x then
						return vector_util.get_0yz(position, this.value.x)
					end

					return nil
				end
			},
			max_x = {
				value = nil,
				calculate_blocked_pos = function(this, position)
					if position.x > this.value.x then
						return vector_util.get_0yz(position, this.value.x)
					end

					return nil
				end
			},
		}
	end

	function player_blocker:on_destroy()
		self.systems = nil
		self.type_const = nil
		self.blockers = nil
	end

	function player_blocker:initialize()
	end

	function player_blocker:dispose()
		for _, blocker in pairs(self.blockers) do
			blocker.value = nil
		end
	end

	function player_blocker:set_value(key, value)
		self.blockers[key].value = value
	end

	function player_blocker:get_value(key)
		return self.blockers[key].value
	end

	function player_blocker:remove_value(key)
		self.blockers[key].value = nil
	end

	function player_blocker:update()
		for player in pairs(self.systems.entity_manager.type_to_entities[self.type_const.entity_type.player]) do
			local position = self.systems.utilities:get_fo_position(player)

			for _, blocker in pairs(self.blockers) do
				if blocker.value ~= nil then
					local blocked_pos = blocker:calculate_blocked_pos(position)

					if blocked_pos ~= nil then
						self.systems.entity_manager:on_before_move(player)

						player.Position = blocked_pos

						self.systems.entity_manager:on_after_move(player)

						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if use_debug then
			for _, blocker in pairs(self.blockers) do
				if blocker.value ~= nil then
					CS.Oak.DebugDrawer.Instance:DrawLineSegment(
							blocker.value + unity_class.vector3.forward * 5,
							blocker.value + unity_class.vector3.back * 5,
							unity_class.color.red
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	local result = {
		--1. (10초 ~ 10.5초) : A 그룹에 0.5초간 1마리의 플라워가 배치된 파이프에서부터

		scene_bundle_generator.bundle.create_pop_out(data.start_bit, data.start_bit + 1,
				character, character .. '_land'),

		create_clip(data.start_bit + 1, common_data.move_1_start_bit, 'character.single.set_async', {
			name = character,

				anim = 'sing',

			},

		create_clip_bundle(common_data.move_3_start_bit, common_data.move_3_end_bit, {
			create_sub_clip('character.single.set', {
				name = character,
				direction = 'right',

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleAndroidIncineratorController')

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, _)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.get_fx_spotlight = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_spotlight_police') end

	self.get_incinerator_android = function(index) return get_character('incinerator_android_' .. index) end
	self.android_count = 13

	self.jumping_head_list = nil

	self.is_enter_club_grid = false

	-- scene_util 버전. 버전 올라갈 때 + N 해서 사용
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1'),
	}

	self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	self.get_fx_spotlight()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.quest_id)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete then
		-- 화로 다 불 들어오게
		local brazier_count = 12
		for i = 1, brazier_count do
			local brazier = get_field_object('incinerator_android_brazier_' .. i)
			command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier)
		end
	end

	self.jumping_head_list = {}
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_enter_club_grid = false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local hole = get_field_object('incinerator_android_hole_1')
	hole.Interactable = CS.Oak.HoleInteractable()
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	self.jumping_head_list = nil
	self:dispose_fx_spotlight()

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:set_spotlight(pos)
	self.fx_spotlight = self.get_fx_spotlight():Instantiate(pos)
end

function local_class:start_club_directing()
	local anim_list = { 'cast2', 'dance', 'dance_voodoo', 'dance_voodoo', 'dance'
	, 'dance', 'dance', 'dance', 'dance_voodoo', 'strike', 'dance_voodoo', 'dance', 'idle', }
	local emo_list = { 'dealwithit', 'smile', 'smile', 'awesome', 'smile'
	, 'awesome', 'dealwithit', 'greed', 'smile', 'smile', 'smile', 'smile', 'smile', }

	for i = 1, self.android_count do
		local android = self.get_incinerator_android(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, emo_list[i])
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, anim_list[i])
	end

	table.insert(self.jumping_head_list, self.get_incinerator_android(13))
end

function local_class:jumping_head_routine()
	start_coroutine(function()
		while self.is_enter_club_grid do
			for i = 1, #self.jumping_head_list do
				character_util.jump(self.jumping_head_list[i], 2, 1.5)
				character_util.spine_rotate(self.jumping_head_list[i], 0, 0)
				character_util.spine_rotate(self.jumping_head_list[i], 720, 1.5)
			end

			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:directing_club_light_routine()
	local tint_key_list = { 'club_tint_1', 'club_tint_2', 'club_tint_3', 'club_tint_4' }

	start_coroutine(function()
		local amb_cf_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_amb_cf_03', parent = self.get_incinerator_android(1),
			loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc', fade_in_time = 0.5 })

		local shout_fx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_03', parent = self.get_incinerator_android(6),
			loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		while self.is_enter_club_grid do
			-- 1초 간 틴트 (1, 0.3, 0.3, 1)
			field_util.tint(tint_key_list[1], CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 0.3, 0.3, 1), 1)
			-- 1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)
			if not self.is_enter_club_grid then
				break
			end
			field_util.remove_tint(tint_key_list[4], 0)

			-- 1초 간 틴트 (1, 1, 0.3, 1)
			field_util.tint(tint_key_list[2], CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 0.3, 1), 1)
			-- 1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)
			if not self.is_enter_club_grid then
				break
			end
			field_util.remove_tint(tint_key_list[1], 0)

			-- 1초 간 틴트 (0.3, 1, 0.3, 1)
			field_util.tint(tint_key_list[3], CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.3, 1, 0.3, 1), 1)
			-- 1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)
			if not self.is_enter_club_grid then
				break
			end
			field_util.remove_tint(tint_key_list[2], 0)

			-- 1초 간 틴트 (0.3, 0.3, 1, 1)
			field_util.tint(tint_key_list[4], CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1), 1)
			-- 1초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1)
			field_util.remove_tint(tint_key_list[3], 0)
		end

		for i = 1, #tint_key_list do
			field_util.remove_tint(tint_key_list[i], 0.25)
		end

		amb_cf_sfx:Stop()
		shout_fx:Stop()
	end)
end

function local_class:dispose_fx_spotlight()
	if self.fx_spotlight ~= nil then
		self.fx_spotlight:Dispose()
		self.fx_spotlight = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	self.quest_spec = nil

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress 0@
		QuestName = QueenCastleAndroidIncinerator
		Comment = 1스테이지 서브 퀘스트 안드로이드 소각장
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_1'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		open_brazier_door = 2,
		enter_first_zone = 3,
		enter_second_zone = 4,
		enter_third_zone = 5,
		enter_four_zone = 6,
		ending = 7,
	}
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.string_key = 'qc_incinerator_s1_'

	self.hole_zone_name = 'incinerator_android_hole_zone'

	self.event_zone_name = 'incinerator_event_zone_'

	self.get_fx_spotlight = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_spotlight_police') end
	self.get_fx_star_piece_in_character = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character') end

	self.get_incinerator_hole = function(index) return get_field_object('incinerator_android_hole_' .. index) end
	self.get_brazier = function(index) return get_field_object('incinerator_android_brazier_' .. index) end

	self.get_incinerator_s1_android = function(index) return get_character('incinerator_android_1_' .. index) end
	self.get_incinerator_dj_booth = function() return get_field_object('incinerator_dj_booth') end

	self.star_piece_name = 'incinerator_star_piece'

	self.android_s1_count = 6

	-- 화로 관련
	self.cur_brazier_on_count = 0
	self.max_brazier_count = 12

	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	-- 떨어뜨린 안드로이드 수
	self.fallen_android_list = nil

	--
	self.is_show_first_oneline_zone = false
	self.is_show_second_oneline_zone = false

	self.grid_tint_key = 'incinerator_enter_grid'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('incinerator_android_door_1', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('incinerator_door', true))
end

function local_class:start()
	self.fallen_android_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.android_s1_count do
		local android = self.get_incinerator_s1_android(i)
		character_util.add_color(android, android.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.7, 0)
		character_util.set_active_state(android, 'enabled')
	end

	for i = 1, self.controller.android_count do
		local android = self.controller.get_incinerator_android(i)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(android, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.add_color(android, android.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	end

	local dj_android = self.controller.get_incinerator_android(1)
	self.star_piece_effect = self.get_fx_star_piece_in_character():Instantiate(dj_android.Position)

	local incinerator_dj_booth = self.get_incinerator_dj_booth()
	incinerator_dj_booth.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.fallen_android_list = nil
	self:dispose_star_piece_effect()
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_star_piece_in_character()
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if e.Zone.Name == self.hole_zone_name
			and lua_helper.type_compare(e.FieldObject, typeof(CS.Oak.Character))
			and not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader)
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.none then
		local character = e.FieldObject
		if not table_util.contain_value(self.fallen_android_list, character.Name) then
			table.insert(self.fallen_android_list, character.Name)
			start_coroutine(self.android_falls_into_hole, self, e.FieldObject)
			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'incinerator_oneline_zone_1')
			and not self.is_show_first_oneline_zone then
		self.is_show_first_oneline_zone = true
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('guard_android_15'), { key = self.string_key .. 1 })
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'incinerator_oneline_zone_2')
			and not self.is_show_second_oneline_zone then
		self.is_show_second_oneline_zone = true
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('guard_android_16'), { key = self.string_key .. 2 })
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.event_zone_name .. 1)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.enter_first_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_first_zone
		start_coroutine(self.first_action, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.event_zone_name .. 2)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.enter_second_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_second_zone
		start_coroutine(self.second_action, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.event_zone_name .. 3)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.enter_third_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_third_zone
		start_coroutine(self.third_action, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.event_zone_name .. 5)
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.enter_four_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_four_zone

function local_class:android_falls_into_hole(android)
	self.cur_brazier_on_count = self.cur_brazier_on_count + 1
	local turn_on_brazier_count = self.cur_brazier_on_count
	if self.cur_brazier_on_count >= self.max_brazier_count then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.open_brazier_door
	end

	-- 안드로이드 바닥에 떨어지면 0.2초 간 가장 근접한 [gimmick]hole 오브젝트 중앙으로 이동 (대기 x), embarrassed 애니메이션
	local time_passed = 0
	while android.Position.y < 0.3 and time_passed < 2 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.stop(android)

	local target_hole = nil
	local cur_distance = 9999

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local hole = self.get_incinerator_hole(i)
		local distance = vector_util.distance(android.Position, hole.Position)
		if cur_distance > distance then
			cur_distance = distance
			target_hole = hole
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	character_util.spine_rotate(android, 360, 0.9)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(android, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'embarrassed')
	wp_util.move_async(android, target_hole.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), nil, 0.2)

	-- 0.7초 간 y축으로 -3 이동, 360도 회전, scale 1 -> 0으로 설정
	local target_pos = android.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.2)
	character_util.spine_scale(android, vector(0, 0, 0), 0.7)
	wp_util.move_async(android, target_pos, nil, 0.7)

	-- 이후 안드로이드 비활성화
	character_util.set_active_state(android, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_position(android, vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 좌측 위에서 우측, 좌측 아래에서 우측
	local brazier = self.get_brazier(turn_on_brazier_count)
	command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier)
end

--안드로이드 연구소 스테이지인지 확인. 해당 스테이지에서만 불러야 되는 게 있으면 이걸로 조건 체크 해야함.
function local_class:in_android_lab_stage()
	return stage.Name == self.android_lab_stage_name
end

function local_class:red_alert_routine()
	local tint_duration = 1.0
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false
	local siren_tint_key = 'siren_tint'

	local siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_oneshot_04", loop = true, fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'loop' })

	while self.is_red_alert_routine do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if siren_sfx ~= nil then
		siren_sfx:FadeOut()
		siren_sfx = nil
	end

	if not self.is_red_alert_routine and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end

		self.get_start_android_pos(2, 4),

			{ key = self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 3, skip = false })

	--연구원 안드로이드(left, attack, release) : 어서 안내해주세요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(doctor, self, 'left',
			'release',

	table.insert(self.android_music_list, dash_sfx)

	local start_key = 'start_key'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(doctor, doctor_pos, 8, nil, self, start_key,
			{ run = true, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(android, android_pos_list, 8, nil, self, start_key,
			{ run = true, last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, start_key)

	scene_util.set_anim(doctor, self, 'eat')

function local_class:battle_zone_event()
	-- 리더
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local leader_pos = self.get_leader_pos() + vector(2, 0, 0)
	local hero_ai_pos = leader_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	-- 연구원
	local doctor = self.get_doctor_android(1)

	-- 안드로이드 1~5
	local android_list = {
		self.get_android(1),
		self.get_android(2),
		self.get_android(3),
		self.get_android(4),
		self.get_android(5)
	}

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	wp_util.move(hero_ai, hero_ai_pos, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move(leader, leader_pos, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	-- 걸어가는 거 대기
	while not self.start_zone_event_clear_flag do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(doctor.Position, 1)

	--연구원 안드로이드(attack, eat) : 이 단단함…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(doctor, self, nil,
			{ name = 'eat', keep = true },
			'attack',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 5)
	--연구원 안드로이드(greed) : 바로 이겁니다! 이 소재만 있으면 신형 안드로이드 개발도…
	--대사 시작과 동시에 일반 안드로이드 가운데 right, idle, idle 물음표 이모티콘
	--대사 시작과 동시에 카메라 포커스 0.5초에 걸쳐 안드로이드와 가디언의 중간 지점으로 이동
	scene_util.set_emotion(doctor, self, 'greed')
	local camera_pos = (android_list[3].Position + leader.Position) / 2
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	local wait_flag = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(android_list[3], self, 'right',
				nil,
				nil,
				'question')
		wait_flag = true
	end)

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(doctor, self, nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 6)

	while not wait_flag do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	--안드로이드(right, attack, dagger_idle) : 침입자 발견!
	--대사 시작하면 연구원 + 일반 안드로이드 전원 right로 전환.
	--연구원 안드로이드는 surprise, idle, jump 1회
	--전환하기 직전에 연구원 안드로이드가 아이템을 획득(아이템 명은 띄우지 않음.)
	self.component_farm_stone_item.ConsumeTarget = doctor
	self.component_farm_stone_item.ShowFloatingText = false
	self.component_farm_stone_item:Fly()
	self.component_farm_stone_item = nil

	wait_for_sec(1)
	for idx = 1, #android_list do
		scene_util.set_direction(android_list[idx], 'right', false)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim(doctor)
	scene_util.set_direction(doctor, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(doctor, self, 'surprise')

	character_util.normal_jump(doctor, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(android_list[3], nil)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(android_list[3], self, nil,
			'dagger_idle',
			'attack',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 7)

	--대사 끝나면 연구원 + 일반 안드로이드 전원 right로 전환.
	--대사 끝나면 일반 안드로이드 전원 attack, dagger_idle
	for idx = 1, #android_list do
		scene_util.set_emotion(android_list[idx], self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(android_list[idx], self, 'dagger_idle')
	end
	scene_util.set_direction(doctor, 'right')

	--연구원 안드로이드(attack, release) : 모두 공격하세요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(doctor, self, nil,
			'release',
			'attack',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 8)

	--연구원 안드로이드(attack, dagger_idle) : 이 소재를 빼앗길 순 없습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(doctor, self, nil,
			'dagger_idle',
			'attack',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 9)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--안드로이드들이랑 전투.
	for idx = 1, #android_list do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(android_list[idx], self.controller)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(android_list[idx], self.battle_group_name, nil)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(android_list[idx], leader, 'battle')
		character_util.set_death_type(android_list[idx], 'prostrate')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_list[idx])
		character_util.hide_weapon(android_list[idx],false)
	end
	character_util.remove_relate_event(doctor, self.controller)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(doctor, self.battle_group_name, nil)
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(doctor, leader, 'battle')
	character_util.set_death_type(doctor, 'prostrate')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.android_lab_battle_gate_name, false))
	-- 리더
	local leader = get_party_leader()

function local_class:stage_open_event()
	-- 리더
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local paper = self.get_paper(1)
	local paper_pos = self.get_paper_pos(1) + vector(1, 0, 0)

	-- 카이
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local hero_ai_pos = paper_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	quest_icon_util.remove(paper)
	--인터랙트하여 이벤트 진행.
	--가디언 종이에 0.5칸 거리까지 다가가 idle, eat 1초
	--가디언이 종이를 획득한다.
	wp_util.move(hero_ai, hero_ai_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_async(leader, paper_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
	table.insert(self.android_music_list, eat_sfx)
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'left',
			'eat',
			nil,
			1)
	table.remove(self.android_music_list, 1)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)

	self.paper_item.ConsumeTarget = leader
	self.paper_item.ShowFloatingText = false
	self.paper_item:Fly()
	self.paper_item = nil

	--내레이션 박스

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 16 })

	--가디언 right, tired, cast 1초
	scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'right',
			'cast',
			'tired',
			1)

	--카이(smile, bomb_idle) : 제가 한 번 보겠습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle',
			'smile',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 17)

	--가디언이 종이를 카이에게 던져준다.
	--카이(tired, eat) : 흠… 기계어로 쓰여져있군요!
	eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_paper_01', loop = true })
	table.insert(self.android_music_list, eat_sfx)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'eat',
			'tired',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 18)

	--카이(attack, eat) : 신형 안드로이드 개발 조사 보고서…?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'eat',
			'attack',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 19)
	table.remove(self.android_music_list, 1)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--그럼 네 친구들이 늘어나겠네!(초록)
		{ self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 20, 'mercy' },
		--귀찮은 애들이 늘겠군.(빨강)
		{ self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 21, 'intellect' }
	})
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--그럼 네 친구들이 늘어나겠네!(초록)
		--가디언 right, smile, bomb_idle 1초
		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'right',
				'bomb_idle',
				'smile',
				1)
		--카이(smile, nod 2회) : 그러네요, 제 친구 안드로이드들이 늘어나겠네요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01' },
				'smile',
				self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 21 .. '_' .. 1)

		--카이(smile, corss_arm) : 그럼 다같이…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
				'cross_arm',
				'smile',
				self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 21 .. '_' .. 2)

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--귀찮은 애들이 늘겠군.(빨강)
		--가디언 tired, bomb_idle 1초
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, nil,
				'bomb_idle',
				'tired',
				1)
		--카이(smile, nod 2회) : 저 같은 안드로이드들은 도움이 될텐데 말이죠!
		--가디언 tired, idle
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
				{ name = 'nod', count = 2, one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_positive_01' },
				'smile',
				self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 21 .. '_' .. 3)

		--카이(smile, corss_arm) : 신형 안드로이드도 저처럼 유능한…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
				'cross_arm',
				'smile',
				self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 21 .. '_' .. 4)
	end

	--카이 attack, idle, jump 1회. 느낌표 이모티콘
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hero_ai, '01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			nil,
			'attack',
			'notice')

	--카이(damaged, embarrassed, jump 2회) : 생각해보니 큰일입니다, 용사님!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hero_ai, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hero_ai, '01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			{ name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = '03_runaway_02' },
			'damaged',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 22)

	--카이(tired, cast) : 신형 안드로이드는 적들이 개발하고 있으니…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			{ name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' },
			'tired',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 23)

	--카이(attack, release) : 용사님이 아니라 적들의 편이 될 겁니다!
	--가디언 attack, idle, jump 1회
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader,'01_player_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			'release',
			'attack',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 23 .. '_' .. 1)

	--카이(attack, cast, jump 2회) : 저희를 막아서는 안드로이드들이 더 강력해질 겁니다!
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hero_ai,'01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(hero_ai,'01_small_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			{ name = 'cast', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_ready_01' },
			'attack',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 24)

	--카이(attack, release) : 용사님! 반드시 이 신형 안드로이드 개발은 막아야 합니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil,
			{ name = 'release', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' },
			'attack',
			self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 25)

	--가디언 attack, nod 2회
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--서브스테이지 오픈 연출.
	--안드로이드 연구소에 대한 정보를 얻었다.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = self.unlock_stage_name,
		substage_open_string_key = self.android_lab_pre_string_key .. 26
	})
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	paper.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveByMagnetNoticeEvent), 'on_move_by_magnet_notice_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')

	self:setting_on_current_section_state()

	----TODO 임시
	--self:puzzle_1_setting()
	--self:puzzle_2_setting()
end

function local_class:start()

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.s1_quest_marker_key, self.quest_id, true, self.get_magnet(1).Position)

	--character_util.set_active_state(self.get_android(1), 'enabled')
end
function local_class:setting_on_current_section_state()
	self.android_assassinate_list = {}
	for i = 1, 11 do
		table.insert(self.android_assassinate_list, self.get_android(i))
	end

	for i = 1, self.android_num do
		table.insert(self.is_android_neutralized, false)
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		character_util.set_position(self.get_android(1), self.get_android_pos(1, 1))
		character_util.set_position(self.get_android(2), self.get_android_pos(2, 1))
		character_util.set_position(self.get_android(3), self.get_android_pos(3, 1))
		character_util.set_position(self.get_android(4), self.get_android_pos(4, 1))

		scene_util.set_direction(self.get_android(1), 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.get_android(2), 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.get_android(3), 'up', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(self.get_android(4), 'up', false)
	end

	--TODO 임시 문 닫기 코드
	--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s1_puzzle_2_door_1', false))
	--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s1_puzzle_2_door_2', false))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveByMagnetNoticeEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	if self.android_music_list then
		for i = 1, #self.android_music_list do
			if self.android_music_list[i] ~= nil then
				music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.android_music_list[i])
			end
		end
		self.android_music_list = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	--self:disable_androids()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_scene_1_zone_name) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_scene_1
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_1, self)
		return true
	end
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_scene_2_zone_name) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_scene_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_scene_2
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_2, self)
		return true
	end
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_scene_3_zone_name) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_scene_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_scene_3
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_3, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.android_assassinate_list do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.android_assassinate_list[i]) then
			local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate | CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
				self.is_android_neutralized[i] = true
				start_coroutine(self.convert_monster_holdable, self, self.android_assassinate_list[i])
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_move_by_magnet_notice_event(e)
	for i = 3, 11 do
		local android = self.get_android(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, android) then
			if e.IsStartMoving then
				self.is_android_neutralized[i] = true
				start_coroutine(self.convert_npc_holdable, self, android)
				return
			elseif not e.IsStartMoving then
				if not direction_util.is_side_ver2(character_util.get_direction(android)) then
					character_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
				end
				character_util.set_anim(android, { name = 'prostrate' })
				return
			end
		end

	end
end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, self.get_magnet(1))
			and e.IsTurningOn == true
			and self.is_first_connet_magnet == false then
		self.is_first_connet_magnet = true
		self:start_scene_without_throwing(self.first_connet_magnet, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	-- 문은 4개가 동시에 열리기 때문에 1개만 판별
	if e.DoorHandleName == 's1_puzzle_2_door_1' then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.s1_quest_marker_key, self.quest_id, true, self.get_cam_pos(3, 2))
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_reset_switch()) and e.IsTurningOn then

		if self.is_android_neutralized[7] == true then
			local andorid = self.get_android(7)
			self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(andorid.Position)
			character_util.set_position(andorid, self.get_android_pos(7, 1))
			scene_util.set_anim(andorid, self, 'prostrate')
		end

		if self.is_android_neutralized[8] == true then
			local andorid = self.get_android(8)
			self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(andorid.Position)
			character_util.set_position(andorid, self.get_android_pos(8, 1))
			scene_util.set_anim(andorid, self, 'prostrate')
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if self.is_detected then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		if e.Params[0] == self.detected_by_guard_key(i) then
			self.is_detected = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.on_detected_with_watcher, self, e.Sender, i, e.Params[0])
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

	self.quest_spec = nil

function local_class:scene_1()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local android_1 = self.get_android(1)
	local android_2 = self.get_android(2)
	local android_3 = self.get_android(3)
	local android_4 = self.get_android(4)
	local cam_pos = self.get_cam_pos(1, 1)
	local leader_pos = self.get_leader_pos(1, 1)
	local hero_ai_pos = self.get_hero_ai_pos(1, 1)
	local align_duration = 1.0

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--존 엔터하면 컨트롤 뺏고 이벤트 진행.
	--카메라 포커스 1초에 걸쳐서 초록색 마름모 지점으로 이동
	camera_util.move(cam_pos, align_duration)
	--동시에 가디언과 케이든도 1초에 걸쳐서 정렬한다.
	wp_util.move(leader, leader_pos, nil, align_duration)
	wp_util.move_async(hero_ai, hero_ai_pos, nil, align_duration)
	--Down, idle, idle
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'down', false)
	--안1(left, idle, idle) : 들으셨나요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 1)
	--안2(left, idle, idle) : 새 선임 연구원이 올거라는 소식 말씀이신가요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 2)
	--안2(left, idle, nod 1회) : 저도 들었습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, 'left',
			{ name = 'nod', count = 1 }, 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 3)
	--안2(left, idle ,idle) : 들리는 소문으로는…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 4)
	--안2(left, idle, bomb_idle) : 전임자가 실용적이지 못한 안드로이드만 만들어서 쫓겨났다고 하더군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 5)
	--안1(left, idle, bomb_idle) : 저희 경비 안드로이드들이나 더 충원해 줬으면 좋았을텐데…
	--대사 시작하면 안2 down, smile로 전환.
	scene_util.set_direction(android_2, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_2, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 6)

	--안2(down, smile, cast) : 교대입니다!
	scene_util.set_direction(android_1, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_2, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(android_2, self, 'cast')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, 'down',
			nil, nil,
			self.string_key .. 7)

	--안3과 안4가 화면 바깥에서 들어온다.
	--화면에 들어오기 시작하면 안1, 안2 smile, idle
	wp_util.move(android_3, self.get_android_pos(3, 2), 3, nil)
	wp_util.move_async(android_4, self.get_android_pos(4, 2), 3, nil)
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_2, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_1, self, 'smile')

	--안3, 안4 이동 끝날때까지 안3, 안4를 바라본다.
	--(down => left)
	--안3, 안4는 위치까지 이동한 후, right, idle, idle
	wp_util.move(android_3, self.get_android_pos(3, 3), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_async(android_4, self.get_android_pos(4, 3), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	scene_util.set_direction(android_1, 'left')
	scene_util.set_direction(android_2, 'left', false)

	--안1(left, smile, cast) : 드디어 꿀맛같은 휴식 시간이군요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'left',
			'cast', nil,
			self.string_key .. 8)

	--안2(left, smile, cast) : 아무것도 안 하고 누워있을 생각에 벌써부터 행복합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, 'left',
			'cast', nil,
			self.string_key .. 9)

	--안3(right, idle, idle) : …
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_3, self, 'right',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 10)

	--안4(right, idle, release) : 어서 가서 쉬시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_4, self, 'right',
			'release', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 11)

	--안 1, 2 아래로 퇴장한다.
	--안 3, 4는 안 1, 2의 위치로 이동한 후, left 바라보고 선다.
	wp_util.move(android_3, self.get_android_pos(1, 1), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move(android_4, self.get_android_pos(2, 1), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move(android_1, {
		self.get_android_pos(1, 2),
		self.get_android_pos(1, 3),
	}, 4, nil)
	wp_util.move_async(android_2, {
		self.get_android_pos(2, 2),
		self.get_android_pos(2, 3),
	}, 4, nil)

	--안 1,2 비활성화
	character_util.set_active_state(android_1, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(android_2, 'disabled')

	--안3(idle, idle) : 케이든님이 마지막으로 방문하신 뒤 지난 수백년 간…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_3, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 12)

	--안3(idle, bomb_idle) : 침입자는 커녕 생명체 하나도 온 적이 없습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_3, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 13)

	--안3(attack, dagger_idle) : 그냥 다같이 누워서 휴식을 취해도 되지 않습니까?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_3, self, 'left',
			'dagger_idle', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. 14)

	--안4(idle, idle) : …
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_4, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 15)

	--안4(attack, bomb_idle) : 그래도 명령은 지켜야 합니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_4, self, 'left',
			'bomb_idle', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. 16)

	--안4(idle, idle) : 다음 교대 근무자들의 시간대 설정이 잘못되어 조금이라도 더 일찍 오기나 바라시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_4, self, 'left',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 17)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.0)

	--카이(tired, cast) : … 역시 신형 안드로이드 개발이 진행되고 있는 것 같습니다.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'left',
			'cast', 'tired',
			self.string_key .. 18)

	--가디언 선택지
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qc_android_lab_s1_choose_1_1', 'brutal' },
		{ 'qc_android_lab_s1_choose_1_2', 'intellect' }
	})
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--모두 박살내주마!
		--Right, Attack, victory_get 1회
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'victory_get')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--카이(left, attack, clap) : 맞습니다, 용사님!
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'left',
				'clap', 'attack',
				self.string_key .. 19)

		--카이(left, attack, dagger_idle) : 신형 안드로이드를 파괴해서라도 개발을 막아내야 합니다!

				self.string_key .. 20 .. '_' .. 1)

			self.string_key .. 21)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'left',
			'sing', 'love',
			self.string_key .. 21 .. '_' .. 1)

	--카이(left, attack, victory_get 1회) : 어서 출발 하시죠!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'left',
			'victory_get', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. 22)
	--이후, 안드로이드3, 4 아래처럼 감시 시야 켠 채로 서 있는다.
	self:puzzle_1_setting()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

	local args = { ... }
	local routine = function()
		-- 이전 리더에 대한 정보를 미리 캐싱해둬야 해제가 가능함

function local_class:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(fo, dir, pos, jump_height, fall_duration)
	dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(dir, fo.Direction)
	pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pos, fo.Position)
	jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(jump_height, 10)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 0.4)

	-- 캐릭터를 히어로 랜딩 할 위치로 배치
	character_util.set_position(fo, pos + vector(0, jump_height, 0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, fo.Position.y, 0)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

--오거 안드로이드 추격 시작 존 이벤트
function local_class:ogre_chase_start_zone_event(idx)
	self.chase_flag_list[idx] = true

	local ogre = self.get_ogre(idx)
	local ogre_move_pos = nil
	if idx == 1 then
		ogre_move_pos = {
			self.get_ogre_pos(idx, 3),
			self.get_ogre_pos(idx, 4)
		}
	elseif idx == 2 then
		ogre_move_pos = {
			self.get_ogre_pos(idx, 2),
			self.get_ogre_pos(idx, 3),
			self.get_ogre_pos(idx, 4)
		}
	end
	self.ogre_follow = true
	self.ogre_follow_end = true

	local ogre_dir
	if idx == 1 then
		ogre_dir = 'right'
	elseif idx == 2 then
		ogre_dir = 'down'
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ogre)
	if idx == 1 then
		self:hero_landing_copy_not_emo_anim(ogre, ogre_dir, self.get_ogre_pos(idx, 2), 10, 0.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_01', parent = ogre })
		self.get_fx_slime_buttbounce():Instantiate(ogre.Position)

		--ogre.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
		--		ogre, ogre_move_pos, self.detected_by_ogre_ai_key(1), 4, 50)
	elseif idx == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_01', parent = ogre })
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	if self.is_detected then
		return
	end

	self.ogre_walk_sfxs[idx] = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_02', parent = ogre, loop = true })
	start_coroutine(self.target_follow_fail_check, self, ogre, idx)
	wp_util.move_async(ogre, ogre_move_pos, 6, nil, { run = true })
end

function local_class:target_follow_fail_check(ogre, idx)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local detection_dist_min = 1

	local ogre_walk_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_02', parent = ogre, loop = true })

	while self.ogre_follow and self.ogre_follow_end do
		-- 리더와 오거의 거리 계산
		local dist_to_player = (leader.Position - ogre.Position).sqrMagnitude
		self.attack_range_renderer_list[idx]:Update(ogre)
		-- 오거와 거리가 1만큼 가까워 졌을 때 발각
		if self:is_in_sight(leader, ogre) or dist_to_player < detection_dist_min
				and self.ogre_follow_end then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.player_detected_by_ogre, self, ogre)
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크용 함수
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = fo.Bounds.center - target.Bounds.center
	local diff = fo.Bounds.center - target.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > self.sight_distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction)) > self.sight_angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlocking(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(target.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
			CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 하늘에서 바닥으로 떨어지는 연출
function local_class:falling_from_sky_and_crush(target, crush_target, fall_duration)
	fall_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(fall_duration, 1)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		logger_util.error("Param: target was expected, nil was passed")
		return
	end
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local height = target.Position.y
	local dest_pos = target.Position - vector(0, height, 0)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = target.Position
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, target.Position.y, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(target, 2160, 3)
	local execute_flag = false
	target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(2.7)
		time_util.mod(self.fall_mod_key, 0.1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
		target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
	end)
	while time_passed < fall_duration do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if start_pos.y + dist_y > 0 then
			character_util.set_position(target, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)
		else
			character_util.set_position(target, vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z))
		end
		if time_passed > 2.95 and not execute_flag then
			time_util.unmod(self.fall_mod_key)
			execute_flag = true
			-- 땅에 닿는 순간 이펙트 fx_hit
			character_util.set_position(target, dest_pos)

			--카메라 쉐이크 0.3초
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
			--가디언과 교관 스파인에 FX_hit, fx_lashit
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(-0.5, -0.1, 0))
			self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(-0.5, -0.1, 0))
			--가디언과 박사 충동할 때 재생	02_hit_big_01
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

			--Redpulse, damagesquish
			target.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			target.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
			crush_target.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			crush_target.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

			free_fall:Dispose()
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(crush_target)
			--가디언은 박사의 자리에 배치되어 right, confused, seat
			scene_util.set_direction(target, 'right')
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'confused')
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'seat')

			--박사 날아가는 동안 재생	01_fall_down_01	뮤트되는 시점에 페이드 아웃으로 믹스 2초 부탁드리겠습니다.
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', fade_out_time = 2.0 })
			character_util.air_spin(crush_target, { offset = vector(-13, 0, 0), play_deathsfx = false })
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	local fin_pos = vector(target.Position.x, 0, target.Position.z)
	character_util.set_position(target, fin_pos)
end

function local_class:player_detected_by_ogre(detected_ogre)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	self.ogre_follow_end = false
	self.is_detected = true
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local ogre = {
		self.get_ogre(1),
		self.get_ogre(2)
	}
	local party_list = {
		user_party.Leader
	}
	local reset_pos = {
		self.get_ogre_pos(1, 1),
		self.get_ogre_pos(2, 1)
	}
	local attack_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(detected_ogre, 'attack')

	-- 추격 플래그 초기화
	character_util.stop(ogre[1])
	character_util.stop(ogre[2])

	-- walk 소리 모두 종료
	if self.ogre_walk_sfxs[1] ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ogre_walk_sfxs[1])
	end
	if self.ogre_walk_sfxs[2] ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ogre_walk_sfxs[2])
	end

	--local distance = vector_util.distance(detected_ogre.Position,leader.Position)
	local x_distance = math.abs(leader.Position.x - detected_ogre.Position.x)
	local z_distance = math.abs(leader.Position.z - detected_ogre.Position.z)
	local target_pos = detected_ogre.Position
	if math.abs(x_distance) > 2 then
		target_pos.x = leader.Position.x - 2
	end
	if math.abs(z_distance) > 2 then
		target_pos.z = leader.Position.z + 1.5
	end
	local target_dir = vector_util.to_direction(leader.Position - detected_ogre.Position)

	local target_offset = nil
	if target_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
		target_offset = vector(0, 0, -3)
	end
	if not (target_pos == detected_ogre.Position) then
		wp_util.move_async(detected_ogre, target_pos, nil, 0.3)
	end
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	scene_util.set_anim(detected_ogre, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(attack_duration * 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	character_util.air_spin(leader, { offset = target_offset })
	wait_for_sec(attack_duration * 0.5)
	--시야에 걸리면 가디언 damaged, embarrassed, ogre 안드로이드 공격 1회
	--자세한 연출은 추후 ogre 안드로이드 스파인 나오면 설정.
	scene_util.set_emotion(party_list[1], self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(party_list[1], self, { name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(detected_ogre, self, { name = 'release', count = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)

	for idx = 1, #party_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(party_list[idx])
	end
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	local reset_point = nil
	local direction = nil
	reset_point = self.detected_by_ogre_reset_pos(1)
	direction = 'left'

	party_util.align_party(reset_point, direction, 0, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ogre[1])
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(ogre[2])
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position, 1)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character_util.set_position(ogre[1], self.wait_pos)
	character_util.set_position(ogre[2], self.get_ogre_pos(2, 1))
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
	self.chase_flag_list[1] = false
	self.chase_flag_list[2] = false
	self.is_detected = false
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.debuff_yellow_effect ~= nil then
		self.debuff_yellow_effect:Dispose()
		self.debuff_yellow_effect = nil
	end
	if self.debuff_brown_effect ~= nil then
		self.debuff_brown_effect:Dispose()
		self.debuff_brown_effect = nil
	end

	if self.aura_hit_loop_effect ~= nil then
		self.aura_hit_loop_effect:Dispose()
		self.aura_hit_loop_effect = nil
	end

	if self.ammi_railgun_ready_effect ~= nil then
		self.ammi_railgun_ready_effect:Dispose()
		self.ammi_railgun_ready_effect = nil
	end

	if self.flamethrower_loop_effect ~= nil then
		self.flamethrower_loop_effect:Dispose()
		self.flamethrower_loop_effect = nil
	end

	if not (#self.fx_twinkle_list == 0) then
		for idx = 1, #self.fx_twinkle_list do
			self.fx_twinkle_list[idx]:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_twinkle_list = {}
	end

	if not (#self.debuff_brown_effects_list == 0) then
		for idx = 1, #self.debuff_brown_effects_list do
			self.debuff_brown_effects_list[idx]:Dispose()
		end
		self.debuff_brown_effects_list = {}
	end

	if self.popcorn_item ~= nil then
		self.popcorn_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.popcorn_item = nil
	end

	if self.popcorn_items ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.popcorn_items do
			self.popcorn_items[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.popcorn_items = nil
	end

	if self.shake_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.shake_sfx)
		self.shake_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.yuze_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.yuze_sfx)
		self.yuze_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.light_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.light_sfx)
		self.light_sfx = nil
	end

end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_scene_1_zone_name) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_scene_1
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_1, self)
		--sp_util.start_scene(self.select_corn, self)
		return true
	end
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_escape_zone_name) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.attempt_to_escape_room, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_android_exp()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_scene_1 then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_android_exp, self)
		return true
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local item = self.get_item_interact(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, item) and
				self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_scene_1 then
			if i == 1 then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_green_potion, self)
			elseif i == 2 then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_protein, self)
			else
				sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_corn, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_breakable_corn()) then
		start_coroutine(self.drop_corn, self)
		return true
		--20947	qc_broken_worker_arm	broken_worker_arm
		--20948	qc_broken_worker_leg	broken_worker_leg
		--20949	qc_broken_worker_body	broken_worker_body
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_breakable(1)) and not self.is_leg_drop then
		self.is_leg_drop = true
		start_coroutine(self.drop_part, self, self.get_breakable(1), 20948)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_breakable(2)) and not self.is_leg_drop then
		self.is_arm_drop = true
		start_coroutine(self.drop_part, self, self.get_breakable(2), 20947)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_breakable(3)) and not self.is_body_drop then
		self.is_body_drop = true
		start_coroutine(self.drop_part, self, self.get_breakable(3), 20949)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 브레이커블 오브젝트 파괴 시
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_breakable_corn()) then
		start_coroutine(self.drop_corn, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_breakable(1)) and not self.is_leg_drop then
		self.is_leg_drop = true
		start_coroutine(self.drop_part, self, self.get_breakable(1), 20948)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_breakable(2)) and not self.is_leg_drop then
		self.is_arm_drop = true
		start_coroutine(self.drop_part, self, self.get_breakable(2), 20947)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_breakable(3)) and not self.is_body_drop then
		self.is_body_drop = true
		start_coroutine(self.drop_part, self, self.get_breakable(3), 20949)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

		is_retry = false
	end

	--하나도 아이템을 가져오지 않았을 경우
	if self.is_item_empty then
		--안1(idle, idle) : 아직 연료를 고르지 않으셨군요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')

				self.string_key .. 32)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')

					'bomb_idle', nil,

	local super_size_me = function(target, duration, init_size, target_size)
		local timer = 0
		local inital_scale = vector(1, 1, 1) * init_size
		local target_scale = vector(1, 1, 1) * target_size
		while timer < duration do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = (timer / duration)

			target.Transform.localScale = vector_util.lerp(inital_scale, target_scale, progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		target.Transform.localScale = target_scale
	end

	table_util.for_each(androids_not_exp, function(i, android)
		character_util.look_at(android, leader)
		scene_util.set_anim(android, self, 'victory_extra')
		scene_util.set_emotion(android, self, 'awesome')
	end)
	--가디언 표정은 tired, idle
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
	--선임님 만세!

	camera_util.shake(0.02, 0.1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, {
		key = self.string_key .. 73, skip = false, bubble_type = 'shout',
		scale = 2, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5)
	})
	--이후, 컨트롤 풀린다.
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.popcorn_item, 0, 0.25)
	for i = 1, #self.popcorn_items do
		local popcorn_item = self.popcorn_items[i]
		start_coroutine(function()
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(popcorn_item, 0, 0.25)
		end)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	if self.popcorn_items ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.popcorn_items do
			self.popcorn_items[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.popcorn_items = nil
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s4_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s4_door_2', false))
	camera_util.return_to_leader(2.0)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local android = self.get_android_follower(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(android, user_party, false)
	end
	android_exp = self.get_android_exp()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_exp)

	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(android_exp, user_party, false)
	-- 섹션 종료.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)

	--qc_android_lab_s5_oneline_1
	--qc_android_lab_s5_oneline_2
	--right, attack, bomb_idle
	scene_util.set_direction(android_4, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(android_4, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_4, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_direction(android_5, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(android_5, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_5, self, 'attack')
	android_4.Interactable.Talk = 'qc_android_lab_s5_oneline_1'
	android_5.Interactable.Talk = 'qc_android_lab_s5_oneline_2'

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.s4_quest_marker_key)
end

--무엇을 고르든 처음에 실행하는 모든 일련의 연출들
function local_class:common_pre_experiment(item)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local android_1 = self.get_android_follower(1)
	local android_2 = self.get_android_follower(2)
	local android_3 = self.get_android_follower(3)
	local android_exp = self.get_android_exp()
	local android_4 = self.get_android_oneline(9)
	local android_5 = self.get_android_oneline(10)
	local androids = {
		android_1, android_2, android_3, android_exp
	}
	--안1(left, attack, bow_idle) : 그럼 당장 M-800에게 주입해 보겠습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'left',
			'bow_idle', 'attack',
			self.string_key .. 38)
	--안1이 실안의 뒤쪽으로 다가가 손에 물약(item) 장착한 채, left, attack, dualgun_attack_right 8회 반복.
	android_1.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', item)
	wp_util.move_async(android_1, {
		vector_util.get_xy0(self.get_android_pos(1, 2), self.get_android_pos(1, 1).z) + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		self.get_android_pos(1, 2) + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
	}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'dualgun_attack')
	if item == 'green_potion' then
		scene_util.set_anim(android_1, self, { name = 'dualgun_attack', one_shot_sfx = '02_magic_heal_02' })
	else
		scene_util.set_anim(android_1, self, 'dualgun_attack')
	end
	for i = 1, 4 do
		--2회 반복할 때마다 실안 shake 0.2초
		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 2)
		scene_util.shake(android_exp, 0.02, 0.2)
		if i == 2 then
			--4회 반복하고 나면 실안 표정 burning으로 변경.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(android_exp, self, 'burning')
		end
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_1)
	android_1.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	--이후 안1이 원래 자리로 돌아간다.
	wp_util.move_async(android_1, {
		vector_util.get_xy0(self.get_android_pos(1, 2), self.get_android_pos(1, 1).z) + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		self.get_android_pos(1, 1),
	}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	--가디언 선택지
	--테스트 시작!(초록)
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 39, 'mercy' } })
	--가디언 attack, victory_get 1회, 끝나고도 자세 그대로 0.5초 대기.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	--실안(mad, idle) : M-800. 제 648차 엔진 출력 테스트 시작합니다. // 이후, mad 유지.
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_exp, self, 'mad')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_exp, self, nil,
			'idle', nil,
			self.string_key .. 40)
	--region 실안이 위쪽 공간으로 올라가고, 가디언과 안드로이드 1~ 3도 위쪽으로 올라가 up 바라본다.

	--안드로이드 4, 5도 up, idle로 변경.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_4)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_5)
	scene_util.set_direction(android_4, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(android_5, 'up', false)

	local move_routine = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		camera_util.move(self.get_android_pos(4, 2), 2.0)
		wp_util.move_async(android_exp, {
			self.get_android_pos(4, 1) + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			self.get_android_pos(4, 1) + vector(-1, 0, 3),
		}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.move(leader, {
			self.get_leader_pos(1, 2),
		}
		, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
		wp_util.move(android_1, {
			vector_util.get_0yz(self.get_android_pos(1, 1), self.get_android_pos(1, 3).x),
			self.get_android_pos(1, 3),
		}
		, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
		wp_util.move(android_2, {
			vector_util.get_0yz(self.get_android_pos(2, 1), self.get_android_pos(2, 2).x),
			self.get_android_pos(2, 2),
		}
		, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
		start_coroutine(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			character_util.jump(android_exp, 1, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		end)
		wp_util.move(android_exp, {
			self.get_android_pos(4, 2) + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			self.get_android_pos(4, 2)
		}
		, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
		wp_util.move_async(android_3, {
			vector_util.get_0yz(self.get_android_pos(3, 1), self.get_android_pos(3, 2).x),
			self.get_android_pos(3, 2),
		}
		, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
		move_routine = false
	end)
	--regionend
	while move_routine do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--실안(down, mad, cast) : 엔진 출력 1단계.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_exp, self, 'down',
			'cast', 'mad',
			self.string_key .. 41)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(android_exp, 'Top Effects', 3)
	--FX_Aura_Hit_Loop 생성
	self.yuze_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_yuze_max_01', volume = 0.3, loop = true })
	self.aura_hit_loop_effect = self.get_aura_hit_loop_effect():Instantiate(android_exp.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, android_exp.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	self.aura_hit_loop_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

	--안3(up, idle) : 엔진 온도 정상. 엔진 내 압력 정상.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_3, self, 'up',
			'idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 42)
	--안3(up, idle, bomb_idle) : 엔진 내부 숙성장치 손상 없음!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_03')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_3, self, 'up',
			'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 43)
	--안3(up, release) : 지금까지는 문제 없습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_3, self, 'up',
			'release', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 44)
	--실안(down, mad, cast2) : 엔진 출력! 2단계!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_exp, self, 'down',
			'cast2', 'mad',
			self.string_key .. 45)
	--Fx_ammi_railgun_ready 생성(레이어 문제로 먼저 생성하고 이때 크기 변경)
	self.light_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_light_loop_04', volume = 0.5, loop = true })
	self.ammi_railgun_ready_effect = self.get_ammi_railgun_ready_effect():Instantiate(android_exp.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, android_exp.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	self.ammi_railgun_ready_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
	--몸 shake 시작.
	self.shake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', volume = 0.5, loop = true })

	scene_util.shake(android_exp, 0.05, 999)
	--안2(up, bomb_idle) : 엔진 온도 정상. 엔진 내 압력 정상.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_2, self, 'up',
			'bomb_idle', 'idle',
			self.string_key .. 46)
	--실안(down, burning, basket_damaged) : 엔진 출력! 3단계!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_exp, self, 'burning')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_exp, self, 'down',
			'basket_damaged', nil,
			self.string_key .. 47)
	--Shake 더 강하게
	scene_util.shake(android_exp, 0.1, 999)
end

function local_class:reset_androids()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local android_1 = self.get_android_follower(1)
	local android_2 = self.get_android_follower(2)
	local android_3 = self.get_android_follower(3)
	local android_4 = self.get_android_oneline(9)
	local android_5 = self.get_android_oneline(10)
	local android_exp = self.get_android_exp()

	local androids_follower = {
		android_1, android_2, android_3
	}
	local androids_oneline = {
		android_4, android_5,
	}
	--카메라 0.5초만에 사이즈 0.7배로 줌인 시작
	--0.7초만에 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
	--camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4 * 0.7, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_03')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')
	--0.2초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local android = self.get_android_follower(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android)
		character_util.set_position(android, self.get_android_pos(i, 1))
		character_util.set_direction(android, 'left')
	end
	character_util.spine_scale(android_1, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(android_1, true)
	character_util.spine_rotate(android_1, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(android_4, self.get_android_pos(5, 1))
	scene_util.set_direction(android_4, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_4, self, 'attack')
	character_util.set_anim(android_4, { name = 'release' })

	character_util.set_position(android_5, self.get_android_pos(6, 1))
	scene_util.set_direction(android_5, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(android_5, self, 'attack')
	character_util.set_anim(android_5, { name = 'release' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(android_exp)
	character_util.set_position(android_exp, self.get_android_pos(4, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(android_exp, 'left')
	character_util.stop_shake(android_exp)
	if self.shake_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.shake_sfx)
		self.shake_sfx = nil
	end
	android_exp.Transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_leader_pos(1, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.spine_scale(leader, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, true)
	for i = 1, 7 do
		local ddong = self.get_ddong(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(ddong, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_position(ddong, vector(999, 0, 999))

	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	if self.debuff_brown_effect ~= nil then
		self.debuff_brown_effect:Dispose()
		self.debuff_brown_effect = nil
	end

	if self.flamethrower_loop_effect ~= nil then
		self.flamethrower_loop_effect:Dispose()
		self.flamethrower_loop_effect = nil
	end

	if not (#self.debuff_brown_effects_list == 0) then
		for idx = 1, #self.debuff_brown_effects_list do
			self.debuff_brown_effects_list[idx]:Dispose()
		end
		self.debuff_brown_effects_list = {}
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	--0.7초만에 서큘러 페이드 인.

function local_class:custom_air_spin(fo, offset)
	local start_pos = fo.Position

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local air_spin_pos = start_pos + offset * progress
		fo.Position = air_spin_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * (-3.5 * time_passed * (time_passed - duration))
		fo.SpineController:Rotate(progress * 360 * 3)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 1.5
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	fo.SpineController:Rotate(0)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'prostrate' })

	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(fo)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(fo)
end

-- 조건에 맞는 항목 테이블에서 제거 함수
local function remove_if(func, arr)
	local new_array = {}
	for _, v in ipairs(arr) do
		if not func(v) then
			table.insert(new_array, v)
		end
	end

	return new_array
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	if self.debuff_yellow_effect_exp ~= nil then
		self.debuff_yellow_effect_exp:Dispose()
		self.debuff_yellow_effect_exp = nil
	end
	table_util.for_each(self.debuff_yellow_effects, function(i, effect)
		if effect ~= nil then
			effect:Dispose()
			effect = nil
		end
	end)
	self.debuff_yellow_effects = nil

	if self.effect ~= nil then
		self.hero_ai_rope_state:End()
		self.hero_ai_rope_state = nil
	end
	if self.aura_hit_loop_effect ~= nil then
		self.aura_hit_loop_effect:Dispose()
		self.aura_hit_loop_effect = nil
	end
	if self.ammi_railgun_ready_effect ~= nil then
		self.ammi_railgun_ready_effect:Dispose()
		self.ammi_railgun_ready_effect = nil
	end
	if self.android_music_list then
		for i = 1, #self.android_music_list do
			if self.android_music_list[i] ~= nil then
				music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.android_music_list[i])
			end
		end
		self.android_music_list = nil
	end
	if self.computer_sound_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.computer_sound_sfx)
	end
end
