function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_scene_3_zone_name) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_scene_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_scene_3
		sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_3, self)
		return true

	end
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_escape_zone_name) and
			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.after_scene_2 then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.attempt_to_escape_room, self)
		return true

	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_s6_room_name) then
		if self.current_section_state < self.section_state.after_scene_2 then
			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.s6_quest_marker_key, self.quest_id, true, self.get_monitor().Position + vector(0, 0, 1))
		else
			quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.s6_quest_marker_key, self.quest_id, true,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_cam_pos_3_2'))
		end

	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_s5_room_name) then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.s6_quest_marker_key, self.quest_id, true, self.get_s5_end_exit_pos())

	end

	--
	--end
	--zoneenterevent
	--왼쪽 존으로 나가려고 하면 컨트롤 뺏고 이벤트 try_exit
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	--퀘스트 마커 세팅
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_s6_room_name) then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.s6_quest_marker_key, self.quest_id, true, self.get_s6_exit_pos() + vector(-1, 0, 1))
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_s5_room_name) then
		quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.s6_quest_marker_key, self.quest_id, true, self.get_s6_exit_pos() + vector(-1, 0, 1))
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_monitor()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_scene_2
			sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_1, self)
			return true
			--elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_scene_1 then
			--	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_scene_2
			--	sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_2, self)
			--	return true
		end
	end
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_scene_2 then
		table_util.for_each(self.dead_android_list, function(i, android)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, android) then
				sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_prostrate_androids, self, android)
			end
		end)
	end

end

--endregion

function local_class:attempt_to_escape_room()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local android_1 = self.get_android_follower(1)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		--안1 : 상부에 보고 먼저 해야 합니다!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, nil,
				'release', 'attack',
				self.string_key .. 67)
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.after_scene_1 then
		--안1(left, smile, bomb_idle) : 곧 캡슐 보관 절차가 완료됩니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', 'smile',
				self.string_key .. 14)
		--안1(left, smile, release) : 조금만 기다려주십시오.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'left',
				'release', 'smile',
				self.string_key .. 15)
		--다시 right, smile, eat
		scene_util.set_direction(android_1, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(android_1, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(android_1, self, 'eat')
	end
	--오른쪽으로 1칸 돌아온다.
	wp_util.move_async(leader, self.get_leader_pos(1, 2), 4, nil)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

	--컨트롤 돌려준다.
end

function local_class:scene_1()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local android_1 = self.get_android_follower(1)
	local android_2 = self.get_android_follower(2)
	local android_3 = self.get_android_follower(3)
	local android_exp = self.get_android_exp()
	local monitor = self.get_monitor()
	local align_duration = 1.0
	local androids = {
		android_1, android_2, android_3, android_exp
	}
	local androids_not_exp = {
		android_1, android_2, android_3
	}
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	self.computer_sound_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_computer_01'
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', parent = monitor ,volume = 0.7})
	--컴퓨터에 인터랙트하면 이벤트 진행.
	--1초에 걸쳐서 각자 위치로 정렬.
	--가디언 down, 실안 left, 나머지 up
	--region1초에 걸쳐서 정렬 위치로 정렬.
	for i = 1, #androids_not_exp do
		wp_util.move(androids[i], self.get_android_pos(i, 1) + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), nil, align_duration,{ last_direction = 'up' })
	end
	wp_util.move(android_exp, self.get_android_exp_pos(1, 1), nil, align_duration)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, self.get_leader_pos(1, 1), nil, align_duration)

	for i = 1, #androids_not_exp do
		scene_util.set_direction(androids[i], 'up', false)
	end
	scene_util.set_direction(android_exp, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)
	--regionend

	--안1(up, release) : 상부에 보고 부탁드립니다, 선임님!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'up',
			'idle', 'release',
			self.string_key .. 1)
	--모니터 : 제 3 부유성 신형 안드로이드 개발 연구소 개발 진행 목록.
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monitor, self, nil,
			nil, nil,
			self.string_key .. 2)

	local choose_routine = true
	while choose_routine do
		--가디언 선택지
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--M-800(초록)
			{ self.string_choose_key(1, 1), 'mercy' },
			----유전자 변형 식물(노랑)
			--{ self.string_choose_key(1, 2), 'intellect' },
			----화약 내장형 내피(보라)
			--{ self.string_choose_key(1, 3), 'forced' },
		})
		self:touch_computer()
		--선택 결과에 따라
		if choose_result == 1 then
			--M-800(초록)
			choose_routine = false
		else
			--유전자 변형 식물(노랑), 화약 내장형 내피(보라)
			--폐기된 항목입니다.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monitor, self, nil,
					nil, nil,
					self.string_key .. 3)
			--다시 선택지 등장
		end

	end
	local is_report = false

	--모니터 : M-800에 관한 세부 사항을 설정합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_operator_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monitor, self, nil,
			nil, nil,
			self.string_key .. 4)
	--가디언 선택지
	choose_routine = true
	local menu_1 = { self.string_choose_key(2, 1), 'brutal' }
	local menu_2 = { self.string_choose_key(2, 2), 'intellect' }
	local menu_3 = { self.string_choose_key(2, 3), 'forced' }
	local eat_sfx = nil
	local choose_list = { menu_1, menu_2, menu_3 }
	while #choose_list > 0 do
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_list)
		if choose_list[choose_result] == menu_1 then
			--choose_list = remove_if(function(x)
			--	return x == menu_1
			--end, choose_list)
			choose_list = { menu_2 }
			--보고서 작성(빨강)
			self:touch_computer()

			--모니터 : 보고서가 접수되었습니다.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_operator_02')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monitor, self, nil,
					nil, nil,
					self.string_key .. 11)
			--모니터 : 신형 안드로이드 M-800. 냉동 캡슐에 보관이 필요합니다.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(monitor, self, nil,
					nil, nil,
					self.string_key .. 12)
			--안1(up, release) : 보관은 저희가 진행하도록 하겠습니다.
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(android_1, self, 'up',
					'release', 'idle',
					self.string_key .. 13)

			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

			wp_util.move(android_1, {
				vector_util.get_xy0(self.get_android_pos(1, 2), self.get_android_pos(1, 1).z + 0.5),
				self.get_android_pos(1, 2),
				self.get_android_pos(1, 2) + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
			}

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

		in_mini_game = 2,

	}

	self.shield_statues = {}

	-- 불석상 기믹들

		return get_character('battleball_girl')
	end

	self.get_jump_tile = function(index)
		return get_field_object('battleball_girl_jump_' .. index)
	end

	end

	self.get_fireball_effect()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	-- 기믹 투명 세팅
	local gimmick_setting = function(fo)
		fo.ActiveState = active_state('infield')
		fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	-- 방패 석상 기믹 캐싱
	local target_zone = field_util.get_zone('battleball_girl_statue')
	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		gimmick_setting(obj)
		obj.Position = obj.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 36
		table.insert(self.shield_statues, obj)
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	-- 불기믹 석상 캐싱
	target_zone = field_util.get_zone('battleball_girl_fireball')
	obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		gimmick_setting(obj)
		obj.Position = obj.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 64
		table.insert(self.fireball_statues, obj)
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	for i = 1, 3 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('battleball_girl_door_' .. i))
	end

	return true

end

	return false

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_mini_game and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'battleball_girl_jump_zone') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		sp_util.start_scene(self.meet_battleball_girl, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'battleball_girl_zone') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

		for i = 1, #self.fireball_statues do
			self.fireball_statues[i].FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable():turn_on()
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_mini_game and
		type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'battleball_girl_zone') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state - 1

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

		for i = 1, #self.fireball_statues do
			local lua_table = self.fireball_statues[i].FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable()
			lua_table:turn_off()
			lua_table:dispose_fireball()
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- DamageEvent
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.fireball_statues do
		if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.reset_event and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, get_party_leader()) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, self.fireball_statues[i]) then

			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.reset_event

			sp_util.start_scene(self.reset_player, self)

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:meet_battleball_girl()

	local kai = user_party[1]
	local battleball_girl = self.get_battleball_girl()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	for i = 1, #self.fireball_statues do
		self.fireball_statues[i].FieldObjectBehaviour:GetLuaTable():turn_off()
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('battleball_girl_door_' .. i))
	end

	scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_girl, self, 'burning')
	scene_util.set_anim(battleball_girl, self, 'boong_attack')

	local fireball_speed = 7
	local last_create_time = 0

	local create_fireball = true

	-- 야구공 생성 로직
	start_coroutine(function()
		local fireballs = {}

		repeat
			local is_fireball = false

			-- 화염구 생성
			if create_fireball then
				if unity_class.time.time - last_create_time > 0.333 then
					last_create_time = unity_class.time.time

					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_snowball_throw_01', parent = battleball_girl })

					local fireball = self.get_fireball_effect():Instantiate(battleball_girl.Position + vector(-0.5, 0.5, -0.1))
					fireballs[fireball] = {
						transform = fireball.transform,
						create_time = unity_class.time.time
					}
				end
			end

			-- 화염구 이동
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			for fireball, data in pairs(fireballs) do
				data.transform.localPosition = data.transform.localPosition + fireball_speed * unity_class.vector3.left * dt

				is_fireball = true

				if unity_class.time.time - data.create_time > 3 then
					fireballs[fireball] = nil
					fireball:Dispose()
				end
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		until not is_fireball

		fireballs = nil
	end)

	local start_pos = leader.Position

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_battleball_girl_14', mintotalduration = 1 })

		scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'get')

		battleball_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, 2))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 리에 (left, smile, cast2) : 내 훈련을 도와준 보답이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self,
		'left', 'cast2', nil, 'qc_battleball_girl_24')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self,
		'left', 'sing', nil, 'qc_battleball_girl_25')

	-- 리에 (left, smile, victory_get) : 그럼 제어실에서 쉬고 있을게!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(battleball_girl, self,
		'left', 'victory_get', nil, 'qc_battleball_girl_26')

	-- 이후 리에 하단으로 이동하며 사라짐. 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(battleball_girl)
	wp_util.move_async(battleball_girl, battleball_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, -7), 4)

	character_util.set_active_state(battleball_girl, 'disabled')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)
end

--[[QuestAttribute

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)

	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character')
	end

	self.effects = nil
	self.tint_key = 'capsule_tint'
	self.bgm_change = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.item ~= nil then
		self.item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.item = nil
	end

	if self.effect ~= nil then
		self.effect:Dispose()
		self.effect = nil
	end

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource('FX_starpiece_in_character')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

end

function local_class:load_progress()

end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	local paper = get_field_object('capsule_paper')

	if self.quest_progress == nil or not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self.effect = self.get_star_piece_effect_pool():Instantiate(paper.Position)
	end

	self.item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = 20897,
		notforinven = true,
		pos = paper.Position,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	character_util.set_anim(get_character('puzzle_pushable_1'), { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	character_util.set_anim(get_character('puzzle_pushable_2'), { name = 'idle', loop = false })
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('capsule_paper')) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_narration, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'capsule_tint_zone') then
		field_util.tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1 }), 0)

		if self.bgm_change then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			self.amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_facility_01', loop = true,
														type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'capsule_tint_zone') then
		field_util.remove_tint(self.tint_key, 0)
		if self.bgm_change then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
			self.amb_sfx:FadeOut()
			self.amb_sfx = nil
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'bgm_routine_start' then
		self.bgm_change = true
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'bgm_routine_stop' then
		self.bgm_change = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:show_narration()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_capsule_puzzle_1' })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_capsule_puzzle_2' })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_capsule_puzzle_3' })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_capsule_puzzle_4' })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_capsule_puzzle_5' })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_capsule_puzzle_6' })
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_capsule_puzzle_7' })

	if self.effect ~= nil then
		self.effect:Dispose()
		self.effect = nil

		self.sections[1]:quest_clear_routine()
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleCapsulePuzzleSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenCastleCapsulePuzzle @
		Comment = QueenCastleCapsulePuzzle 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	--region progress
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		door_1_open = 2,
		door_2_open = 3,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none
	--endregion

	self.capsule_in_count = 0
	self.head_in_count = 0
	self.pushable_in_count = 0
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.capsule_list = {
		{ capsule = get_field_object('capsule_1'), in_check = false },
		{ capsule = get_field_object('capsule_2'), in_check = false },
		{ capsule = get_field_object('capsule_3'), in_check = false },
	}

	self.head_list = {
		{ npc = get_character('dummy_head_3_1'), in_check = false },
		{ npc = get_character('dummy_head_6_1'), in_check = false },
	}

	self.pushable_list = {
		{ npc = get_character('puzzle_pushable_2'), in_check = false },
	}

	local stair = get_field_object('capsule_stair')
	stair.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.capsule_list do
		for j = 1, 3 do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.capsule_list[i].capsule, 'capsule_zone_' .. j) and
					not self.capsule_list[i].in_check then
				self.capsule_list[i].in_check = true
				self.capsule_in_count = math.min(self.capsule_in_count + 1, 3)
				if self.capsule_in_count == 3 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
					self.current_section_state = self.section_state.door_1_open
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('capsule_door_1', false))
				elseif self.capsule_in_count == 3 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.door_1_open then
					self:puzzle_2_door_check()
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.head_list do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.head_list[i].npc, 'capsule_head_zone') and
			not self.head_list[i].in_check then
			self.head_list[i].in_check = true
			self.head_in_count = math.min(self.head_in_count + 1, 2)
			if self.head_in_count == 2 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.door_1_open then
				self:puzzle_2_door_check()
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.pushable_list do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.pushable_list[i].npc, 'capsule_pushable_zone') and
				not self.pushable_list[i].in_check then
			self.pushable_list[i].in_check = true
			self.pushable_in_count = math.min(self.pushable_in_count + 1, 1)
			if self.pushable_in_count == 1 and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.door_1_open then
				self:puzzle_2_door_check()
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end


function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.capsule_list do
		for j = 1, 3 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.capsule_list[i].capsule) and
					e.Zone.Name == 'capsule_zone_' .. j and self.capsule_list[i].in_check then
				self.capsule_list[i].in_check = false
				self.capsule_in_count = math.max(0, self.capsule_in_count - 1)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.head_list do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.head_list[i].npc, 'capsule_head_zone') and
				self.head_list[i].in_check then
			self.head_list[i].in_check = false
			self.head_in_count = math.max(self.head_in_count - 1, 0)
			return true
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.pushable_list do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.pushable_list[i].npc, 'capsule_pushable_zone') and
				self.pushable_list[i].in_check then
			self.pushable_list[i].in_check = false

			'theatres/iron_teatans_head', 'iron_teatans_head', function(prefab)
				local obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.fo = obj:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.IronTeatansHead))
				self.fo.Name = 'iron_teatan_head_1'

				self.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				self.fo:Init()
				self.fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)

				self.script = self.fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.IronTeatansHead))

				self.fo.transform:Find("iron_teatans_head/fx").gameObject:SetActive(true)

				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(self.fo))
			end)
end

function local_class:move(start_pos, end_pos, speed, angular_speed, keep, play_sfx)
	if self.fo == nil then
		return
	end

	speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 5)
	angular_speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(angular_speed, 90)
	start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos, 0)
	end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos, 0)

	local duration = (start_pos - end_pos).magnitude / speed

	local head = self.fo
	local float_y = 3
	head.Position = start_pos
	head:Float(float_y)
	head.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	head.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible;

	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Missile_small_Explosion')
	local explosion_center = vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	local angle = self.fo.transform.localRotation
	local y_angle = angle.y
	local angle_time = 0

	local time_passed = 0

	local sfx = nil
	if play_sfx ~= nil then
		sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '03_iron_teatan_head_hover_01', parent = head,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', loop = true })
	end

	while time_passed < duration and self.fo ~= nil do
		if self.stop_moving then
			break
		end

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, time_passed / duration)
		head.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress

		angle_time = angle_time + dt

		y_angle = y_angle + angular_speed * dt
		self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(angle.x, y_angle, angle.z))

		if angle_time > 0.5 then
			local rad = math.pi * 2 * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value
			local rand = vector(math.cos(rad), 0, math.sin(rad) * 0.5)
			pool:Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(self.fo.Position, float_y) +
					explosion_center + rand, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.fo.transform)
			angle_time = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.stop_moving then
		self.stop_moving = false
	end

	if self.fo ~= nil and not keep then
		head.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	if sfx ~= nil then
		sfx:FadeOut(1)
	end
end

function local_class:stop()
	self.stop_moving = true
end

function local_class:normal_talk_async(key, skippable, data)
	if data == nil then
		data = {}
		data['world_pos'] = self.fo.Position
	elseif data['world_pos'] == nil then
		data['world_pos'] = self.fo.Position
	end

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.fo, key, skippable, data)
end

		data = {}
		data['world_pos'] = self.fo.Position
	elseif data['world_pos'] == nil then
		data['world_pos'] = self.fo.Position
	end

	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(self.fo, key, skippable, data)
end


return {

		return local_class()
	end

function local_class:break_loop_move(start_pos, end_pos, speed, target_angle)
	if self.fo == nil then
		return
	end

	speed = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 5)
	local duration = (start_pos - end_pos).magnitude / speed
	local time_passed = 0

	--IronTeatansHead에서 풀링한 오브젝트풀 사용
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Missile_small_Explosion')
	local explosion_center = vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	local angleSpeed = target_angle / duration
	local angle = self.fo.transform.localRotation
	local y_angle = angle.y
	local angle_time = 0

	self:set_position(start_pos)

	self.is_move_end = false
	self.is_rot_end = false

	while self.fo ~= nil do
		--이동과 회전 둘 다 끝나면 탈출
		if self.is_move_end and self.is_rot_end then
			break
		end

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not self.is_move_end then
			-- 이동 관련 처리
			if time_passed < duration then
				time_passed = time_passed + dt
				angle_time = angle_time + dt

				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Min(1, time_passed / duration)
				self.fo.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress
			else
				self.is_move_end = true
				self.fo.Position = end_pos
			end
		end

		if not self.is_rot_end then
			-- 회전 관련 처리
			y_angle = y_angle + angleSpeed * dt

			if y_angle > target_angle then
				y_angle = target_angle

				self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(angle.x, y_angle, angle.z))
				self.is_rot_end = true
				break
			end

			self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(angle.x, y_angle, angle.z))

			if angle_time > 0.5 then
				local rad = math.pi * 2 * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value
				local rand = vector(math.cos(rad), 0, math.sin(rad) * 0.5)
				pool:Instantiate(self.fo.Position + explosion_center + rand, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.fo.transform)
				angle_time = 0
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--IronTeatansHead.cs의 yAngle과 싱크 맞추기
	self.script:SetYAngle(self.fo.transform.localRotation.y)
end

function local_class:rotate(duration, end_angle)
	local timer = 0
	local start_angle = self.fo.transform.localRotation

	while timer < duration do
		local progress = timer / duration

		self.fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(start_angle, end_angle, progress)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))

	self.touch = false

	if not is_unity_null(self.mural_prefab) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.mural_prefab)
		self.mural_prefab = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.current_sector_mural_data = {}
end

function local_class:load_async()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	self.get_fx_scan()

	--region 벽화 프리팹 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, self.mural_asset_bundle_name, self.mural_asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.mural_prefab = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.mural_prefab:SetActive(false)
			end)

	--이미지 경로
	local image_infos = {
		first_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/first_mural',
			asset_name = 'first_mural.png',
			order = 1,
		},
		second_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/second_mural',
			asset_name = 'second_mural.png',
			order = 2,
		},
		third_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/third_mural',
			asset_name = 'third_mural.png',
			order = 3,
		},
		fourth_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/fourth_mural',
			asset_name = 'fourth_mural.png',
			order = 4,
		},
		fourth_mural_undeleted = {
			target_name = 'show/fourth_mural_undeleted',
			asset_name = 'fourth_mural_undeleted.png',
			order = 5,
		},
		fifth_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/fifth_mural',
			asset_name = 'fifth_mural.png',
			order = 6,
		},
		sixth_mural = {
			target_name = 'show/sixth_mural',
			asset_name = 'sixth_mural.png',
			order = 7,
		},
	}

	for key, info in pairs(image_infos) do
		local target_obj = self.mural_prefab.transform:Find(info.target_name).gameObject
		load_util.load_texture_byte(self.mural_asset_bundle_name, info.asset_name, target_obj, info.order)
		self.mural_show_data[key].target = target_obj
	end

	self.dialogue = self.mural_prefab.gameObject:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.UISubtitle))
	self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--카메라 셋팅
	local background = self.mural_prefab.transform:Find('back/wall_bg'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
	local camera = self.mural_prefab.transform:Find('Camera pivot'):GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	local bgUnitWidth = background.size.x * background.transform.localScale.x
	-- 현재 해상도에서 배경이 보이는 높이
	local viewUnitHeight = bgUnitWidth / camera.aspect

	-- 현재 해상도에 맞춰 카메라 높이를 클램핑해준다
	camera.orthographicSize = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp(viewUnitHeight * 0.35, 3.5, 4.7)

	--endregion

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:show_theatre_async(scene_name, show_dialogue, start_fade, end_fade, bubble_data)
	start_fade = lua_helper.get_or_default(start_fade, true)
	end_fade = lua_helper.get_or_default(end_fade, true)
	show_dialogue = lua_helper.get_or_default(show_dialogue, false)

	local show_info = {}
	if type_util.is_string(scene_name) then
		show_info = self.mural_show_data[scene_name]
		if show_info == nil then
			return
		end
	end

	if start_fade then
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	--벽화 그리기
	self.mural_prefab:SetActive(true)
	show_info.target:SetActive(true)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if type_util.is_array(bubble_data) then
		local bubble_setting = {
			bubble_direction = 'none', viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2),
		}

		for i = 1, #bubble_data do
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party[0], bubble_data[i], true, bubble_setting)
		end
	end

	--해당 벽화 텍스트 타이핑
	if show_dialogue then
		self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		local text_data = show_info.text_data
		for i = 1, #text_data do
			local routines = { self.dialogue:Show('nil', text_data[i], true) }

			wait_all(routines)
		end

		self.dialogue.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	else
		--나레이션 없을 경우 다음 터치 까지 대기
		self.touch = true
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

		while self.touch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--벽화 지우기
	show_info.target:SetActive(false)
	self.mural_prefab:SetActive(false)

	if end_fade then
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	--스테이지 별 벽화 기믹 셋팅
	if stage.Name == 'queencastle_1_3' then
		self:hub_stage_progress_setting()
	else
		self:sector_stage_progress_setting()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	self.touch = false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object(self.current_sector_mural_data.mural_name)) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.show_theatre_async, self, self.current_sector_mural_data.mural_name)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.current_sector_mural_data.zone_enter_name) and
			self.is_first then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.obelisk_mural_theatre_async, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:obelisk_mural_theatre_async()
	local leader = user_party[0]
	local hero_ai = user_party[1]

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	if self.is_first then
		--벽화 앞으로 이동
		local wp_key = 'mural_align'
		local hero_ai_pos = self.current_sector_mural_data.target.Position + vector(1, 0, -2)
		local leader_pos = hero_ai_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader_pos, nil, 2, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(hero_ai, hero_ai_pos, nil, 2, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		if self.interact_count == 0 then
			--카이 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 앗 이 그림은…
			character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_mural_script_1')
			--카이 (up, idle, cast) : 저스티스 리프트에 있던 벽화와 비슷한 것 같습니다!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'cast', nil, 'qc_mural_script_2')
			--카이 (up, idle, cast2) : 한번 살펴보겠습니다!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'cast2', nil, 'qc_mural_script_3')
		else
			--카이 (up, idle, jump 1회) : 또 다른 벽화입니다 용사님!
			character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_mural_script_4')
			--카이 (up, idle, cast2) : 한번 살펴보겠습니다!
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, nil, 'cast2', nil, 'qc_mural_script_5')
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_03')
	self:show_theatre_async(self.current_sector_mural_data.mural_name, false, true, true, self.current_sector_mural_data.bubble_data)

	if self.is_first then
		if self.interact_count == 0 then
			--카이 (left, tired, cross_arm) : 현재로선 무슨 내용인지 알 수 없겠네요…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'left', 'cross_arm', 'tired', 'qc_mural_script_6')

			--카이 (left, attack, release 2회) : 일단 용사님은 스위치 작동에 집중해주세요!

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleRobotKnight')

function local_class:init()
	self.handler = nil

	self.robot_ride_state = {
		none = 1,
		on_in = 2,
		riding = 3,
		on_out = 4
	}

	self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.none

	self.robots = nil
	self.default_robot = nil
	self.knight_on_robot = nil
	self.using_robots = nil

	self.get_robot = function()
		return get_character('robot')
	end

	self.get_knight_on_robot = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('robot_knight_male')
		else
			return get_character('robot_knight_female')
		end
	end

	self.button_active = false
	self.original_leader = nil

	self.is_loaded = false
	self.is_jumping = false

	self.can_ride = true
	self.can_exit = true
end

function local_class:load_async(handler)
	self.handler = handler

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JumpStartEvent), 'on_jump_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	self.default_robot = get_character('robot')
	self.knight_on_robot = self.get_knight_on_robot()
	self.using_robots = { self.default_robot, self.knight_on_robot }

	scene_util.set_anim(self.default_robot, self.handler, { name = 'idle', loop = false })

	self.default_robot.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.default_robot.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.is_loaded = true
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JumpStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.robots ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.robots)
		self.robots = nil
	end

	self.default_robot = nil
	self.knight_on_robot = nil
	self.using_robots = nil

	self.original_leader = nil

	self.handler = nil
end

--region events
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.default_robot) and
			self.cur_robot_ride_state == self.robot_ride_state.none and
			self.can_ride then
		self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.on_in
		start_coroutine(self.start_robot_ride, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown and
			self.button_active and self.cur_robot_ride_state == self.robot_ride_state.riding then
		self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.on_out
		sp_util.start_scene(self.stop_robot_ride, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown and
			self.button_active and self.can_exit and
			self.cur_robot_ride_state == self.robot_ride_state.riding then
		self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.on_out
		sp_util.start_scene(self.stop_robot_ride, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_jump_start_event(e)
	if self.is_jumping == true then
		return
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.knight_on_robot, get_party_leader()) then
		return
	end

	if self.button_active == false then
		return
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.is_jumping = true
		self.button_active = false
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.knight_on_robot, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1)

		while lua_helper.type_compare(self.knight_on_robot.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		self.is_jumping = false
		self.button_active = true
		self:make_button()
	end)
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local param = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if param == 'lightning_reset_player_start' then
		self.can_ride = false
	elseif param == 'lightning_reset_player_end' then
		self.can_ride = true
	elseif param == 'lightning_ignore_player_start' then
		self.can_exit = false
		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			self.can_exit = true
		end)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:start_robot_ride()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.original_leader = get_party_leader()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	if self.can_ride == false then
		self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.none
		sp_util.exit_scene({ show_ui = false, reset_party = false }, self.original_leader)
		return
	end

	local party_members = {}
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		table.insert(party_members, user_party[i])
	end

	if not direction_util.is_side(self.original_leader.Direction) then
		if self.default_robot.Position.x >= self.original_leader.Position.x then
			character_util.set_direction(self.original_leader, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.original_leader, 'left')
		end
	end
	scene_util.set_anim(self.original_leader, self.handler, { name = 'get' })

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.KeepParty = true
	param.MoveCamera = false
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.original_leader)

	local dur = 0.3

	self.knight_on_robot.Position = self.default_robot.Position
	self.knight_on_robot.Direction = self.default_robot.Direction
	camera_util.move(self.knight_on_robot.Position, dur, { end_target = self.knight_on_robot })

	for i = 1, #party_members do
		local member = party_members[i]
		character_util.move_to(member, user_party[i - 1].Position, dur, nil, true, true)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.original_leader, 0, dur)
	character_util.jump(self.original_leader, 0.5, dur)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.original_leader, self.default_robot.Bounds.center,
			dur, nil, false, false)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.default_robot, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.knight_on_robot, 'enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.knight_on_robot, param, true)

	character_util.cancel_jump(self.original_leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.original_leader)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.original_leader, 'disabled')

	-- 버튼 생성
	self:make_button()

	self.button_active = true

	self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.riding

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, self.original_leader)
end

function local_class:stop_robot_ride()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if not self.can_exit then
		self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.riding
		self.can_exit = true
		return
	end

	local dur = 0.3
	camera_util.move(self.knight_on_robot.Position, dur, { end_target = self.original_leader })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.knight_on_robot)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.default_robot, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.knight_on_robot, 'disabled')
	self.default_robot.Position = self.knight_on_robot.Position
	self.default_robot.Direction = self.knight_on_robot.Direction

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.knight_on_robot)

	character_util.set_active_state(self.original_leader, 'enabled')

	scene_util.set_anim(self.original_leader, self.handler, { name = 'get' })
	self.original_leader.Position = self.default_robot.Bounds.center
	self.original_leader.Direction = self.default_robot.Direction

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.original_leader, 1, dur)
	character_util.jump(self.original_leader, 0.5, dur)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.original_leader, self.default_robot.Position, dur, nil, false, false)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.KeepParty = true
	param.MoveCamera = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.original_leader, param, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.original_leader)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.knight_on_robot, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1)
	self.button_active = false

	scene_util.set_anim(self.default_robot, self.handler, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.none
end

function local_class:ride()
	self.original_leader = get_party_leader()

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.KeepParty = true
	param.MoveCamera = false
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.original_leader)

	scene_util.set_anim(self.default_robot, self.handler, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	character_util.set_active_state(self.default_robot, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.knight_on_robot, 'enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.knight_on_robot, param, true)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.original_leader)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.original_leader, 'disabled')

	self:make_button()

	self.button_active = true

	self.cur_robot_ride_state = self.robot_ride_state.riding
end

function local_class:make_button()
	local ui_type = CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(self.knight_on_robot, ui_type)
	local button = field_ui_manager:GetUI(self.knight_on_robot)[ui_type]
	button:SetIcon('actbtn_ic_change.png')
end

function local_class:reset(pos)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.knight_on_robot, get_party_leader()) then
		return
	end
	character_util.set_active_state(self.default_robot, 'enabled')
	scene_util.set_anim(self.default_robot, self.handler, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	self.default_robot.Position = pos
	character_util.set_direction(self.default_robot, 'down')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.original_leader, 'enabled')
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleSectorObeliskController')

function local_class:init()
	self.sector_section = nil

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.stage_to_sector_key = {
		['queencastle_1_4'] = 'lightning',
		['queencastle_1_5'] = 'wind',
		['queencastle_1_6'] = 'fire',
		['queencastle_1_7'] = 'water',
	}

	self.sector_info = {
		lightning = {
			quest_id = 338,
			nar_key = 'qc_sector_obelisk_nar_lightning',
			sfx_key = '01_thunder_01',
		},
		wind = {
			quest_id = 332,
			nar_key = 'qc_sector_obelisk_nar_wind',
			sfx_key = '01_earthquake_01',
		},
		fire = {
			quest_id = 336,
			nar_key = 'qc_sector_obelisk_nar_fire',
			sfx_key = '01_fire_06',
		},
		water = {
			quest_id = 331,
			nar_key = 'qc_sector_obelisk_nar_water',
			sfx_key = '01_water_float_01',
		}
	}

	self.get_knight = function()
		return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
	end

	self.get_hero_ai = function()
		return get_character('hero_ai')
	end

	-- 4~7 스테이지 전체에서 핸들네임 통일 필요
	self.get_obelisk = function(key)
		return get_field_object('obelisk_' .. key)
	end

	self.get_switch = function()
		return get_field_object('obelisk_switch')
	end

	self.is_interacting_switch = false

	-- FIXME : 유니크 애니메이션 나오면 수정
	self.get_warrior_pose_data = function()
		return { name = 'get' }
	end

	--- SectorObeliskController를 사용하기 위한 준비 사항 (스테이지 4 ~ 7만 해당)
	--- 1. 마지막 섹션 추가
	--- 2. enter 단에서 아래 호출
	---		local obelisk_controller = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/QueenCastle/Common/SectorObeliskController')
	---		obelisk_controller:register_section(self)
	--- 3. 타일맵에서 규칙에 맞게 핸들네임 세팅
	---		a. 신전 연출용 공간의 속성별 기둥 4개에 핸들네임 "obelisk_[lightning / wind / fire / water]" 지정
	---		b. 신전 스위치 오브젝트의 핸들네임을 "obelisk_switch"로 지정
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.sector_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	--신전 스위치 인터렉트 시 진행.
	if not self.is_interacting_switch and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_switch()) then
		self.is_interacting_switch = false

		start_coroutine(self.interact_switch_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 섹터의 마지막 섹션의 프로그래싱 (클리어) 권한을 여기로 넘겨줌
--- 스테이지 3에서는 사용하지 말 것
function local_class:register_section(sector_last_section)
	self.sector_section = sector_last_section

	-- 인터랙트 가능하도록 처리
	local switch = self.get_switch()
	switch.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:is_sector_cleared(sector_key)
	local info = self.sector_info[sector_key]

	if info == nil then
		return false
	end

	local quest_id = self.sector_info[sector_key].quest_id

	local sector_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_id)

	return sector_quest ~= nil and sector_quest.IsComplete
end

function local_class:get_current_sector_key()
	return self.stage_to_sector_key[stage.Name]
end

function local_class:get_current_sector_info()
	return self.sector_info[self:get_current_sector_key()]
end

---@return table 완료한 섹터(신전) 키를 테이블에 담아 반환
function local_class:get_cleared_sectors()
	local cleared_sectors = {}

	for sector_key, _ in pairs(self.sector_info) do
		if self:is_sector_cleared(sector_key) then
			table.insert(cleared_sectors, sector_key)
		end
	end

	return cleared_sectors
end

--- 현재 완료된 섹터들을 체크해 기둥 상태를 자동으로 업데이트해둠
function local_class:refresh_obelisk_state()
	local cleared_sectors = self:get_cleared_sectors()

	--이때 플레이어가 클리어한 스테이지에 따라 지정된 기둥은 이미 켜진 상태가 필요함
	--4스테이지 : 번개
	--5스테이지 : 바람
	--6스테이지 : 화염
	--7스테이지 : 물
	for i = 1, #cleared_sectors do
		local sector_key = cleared_sectors[i]
		local obelisk = self.get_obelisk(sector_key)

		local animator = obelisk.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('idle', -1, 1)
	end
end

function local_class:interact_switch_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local switch = self.get_switch()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local cleared_sectors = self:get_cleared_sectors()
	local clear_count = #cleared_sectors + 1

	-- 정렬
	do
		local move_key = 'switch_align'
		local min_speed = 1
		local duration = 1
		local activate_align = function(npc, target_pos, last_dir)
			local dist = (npc.Position - target_pos).magnitude

			local speed = math.max(dist / duration, min_speed)

			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, target_pos, speed, nil,
					self, move_key, { last_direction = last_dir })
		end

		--케이든 AI, 플레이어 지정된 위치에 정렬되고,
		activate_align(knight, switch.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 'left')
		activate_align(hero_ai, switch.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 'right')

		--카메라 활성화 스위치 중심으로 정렬.
		camera_util.move_async(switch.Position, duration)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)
	end

	--케이든 AI (right, smile, jump 1회) : 용사님! 드디어 활성화 스위치에 도착했습니다!
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'right',
			nil, 'smile', 'qc_sector_obelisk_1')

	--이후 연출은 현재 플레이어의 스테이지 클리어 횟수에 따라
	self['before_warrior_pose_scene_' .. clear_count](self)

	self:warrior_pose_scene()

	self:refresh_obelisk_state()

	local qc_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/QueenCastle/Common/Util')

	qc_util:set_sector_directional_light(3)

	self:obelisk_obelisk_scene()

	--2,4번째 클리어 시 대화
	--클리어 직전에 호출되는 함수 이기 때문에 미리 클리어 카운트를 1 증가 시킨다.
	if clear_count == 2 or clear_count == 4 then
		qc_util:set_sector_directional_light(1)

		self:talk_scene(clear_count)
	end

	quest_util.complete_quest(self.sector_section.controller, 0,
			false, false, false)

	--섹션 종료, 스테이지 종료.
	CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
end

--region 용사의 포즈 전 연출 4가지

function local_class:before_warrior_pose_scene_1()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	--신전 최초 클리어 시 진행
	--케이든 AI (right, attack, cast2) : 스위치를 만났다면 해야할 것은 단 하나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

function local_class:warrior_pose_scene()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()
	local switch = self.get_switch()

	local target_resize_scale = 2.5

	local get_resize_scale = function(count)
		local progress = count / 3

		return 4 * (1 - progress) + target_resize_scale * progress
	end

	local activate_resize = function(count)
		local duration = 0.2
		camera_util.move(switch.Position, duration)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(get_resize_scale(count), duration)
	end

	local activate_shake = function()
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	end

	local get_speech_data = function(key)
		return { key = key, skip = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.5) }
	end

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(hero_ai, { dir = 'down', sfx = false })

	--용사의 포즈 연출
	--현재 카메라 1번 크기의 상태.
	--이후 실행되는 케이든 AI의 말풍선은 스위치 상단에 출력되어,
	--줌 인 되더라도 중앙에 위치할 수 있도록 설정.
	do
		--화면 shake 강도 약하게 진행.
		activate_shake()
		--상단 대사와 함께 카메라 2번 크기까지 빠르게 줌 인 되며
		activate_resize(1)

		--플레이어 케이든AI와 동일하게 down, attack, release 1회 실행.
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'release', loop = false })
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')

		--케이든 AI (down, attack, release 1화) : [shout] 3!!!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'down',
				{ name = 'release', loop = false },
				'attack', get_speech_data('qc_sector_obelisk_31'))

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	end

	do
		--화면 shake 강도 중간 크기로 진행.
		activate_shake()
		--상단 대사와 함께 카메라 3번 크기까지 빠르게 줌 인 되며,
		activate_resize(2)

		--플레이어 케이든AI와 동일하게 down, smile, cast2, jump 1회 실행.
		character_util.normal_jump(knight, true)
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'cast2')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')

		--케이든 AI (down, smile, cast2, jump 1회) : [shout] 2!!!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'down',
				'cast2', 'smile', get_speech_data('qc_sector_obelisk_32'))

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	end

	do
		--화면 shake 강도 강하게 진행.
		activate_shake()
		--상단 대사와 함께 카메라 4번 크기까지 빠르게 줌 인 되며,
		activate_resize(3)

		--플레이어 케이든AI와 동일하게 down, awesome, jingak 1회 실행.
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'jingak')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'awesome')

		--케이든 AI (down, smile, jingak 1회) : [shout] 1!!!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(hero_ai, self, 'down', { name = 'jingak', keep = true },
				{ name = 'awesome', keep = true }, get_speech_data('qc_sector_obelisk_33'))
	end

	-- 진짜 말도안되는 상황이지만 혹시라도 튜토리얼 스파인 로드가 종료되지 않았을 경우를 대비
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	--위 상태 종료 후 QTE(↑) 실행. 플레이어 실행 전까지 정지되는 스펙으로 진행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	qte_util.swipe('up')

	do
		local anim_name = 'unique/hero_pose1'
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(hero_ai, anim_name)
		local front_pose_duration = anim_duration * 0.7

		--카이 (down, attack, hero_pose1 앞동작) : 용사의…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)
		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, { name = anim_name, loop = false })

		--상단 대사와 함께 플레이어 down, attack, hero_pose3 앞동작을 같이 실행하고, 카이가 실행한 대사를 스킵하지 않는다.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'unique/hero_pose3', loop = false })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hero_ai,
				{ key = 'qc_sector_obelisk_34', skip = false, type_speed = 0, bubble_type = 'shout',
				  keep_display = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75) })
		wait_for_sec(front_pose_duration)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(hero_ai)

		--hero_pose의 앞동작을 실행하는 동안까지 대사 스킵하지 않고 실행. 손 모으는 동작까지 앞대사를 실행하여야 함.

		--카이 (down, awesome, hero_pose1 뒷동작) : 포즈!!!!!
		--상단 대사와 함께 줌 복귀되며, 플레이어 카이와 함께 down, awesome, hero_pose3 뒷동작을 같이 실행. 동시에 줌 복귀되며 화면 shake 강도 제거.
		--hero_pose의 나머지 동작을 실행합니다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')

		scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'awesome')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'awesome')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hero_ai,
				{ key = 'qc_sector_obelisk_35', skip = false, type_speed = 0, bubble_type = 'shout',
				  keep_display = true, viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75) })

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration - front_pose_duration + 1.5)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(hero_ai)
	end

	--이후 신전 오벨리스크 연출로 넘어감.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:obelisk_obelisk_scene()
	local current_sector_key = self:get_current_sector_key()
	local activated_obelisk = self.get_obelisk(current_sector_key)

	--오벨리스크 연출
	local center_pos = nil

	do
		local sum = unity_class.vector3.zero
		local count = 0

		for sector_key, _ in pairs(self.sector_info) do
			local obelisk = self.get_obelisk(sector_key)

			sum = sum + obelisk.Position
			count = count + 1
		end

		center_pos = sum / count
	end

	-- 오벨리스크 높이가 높아서 1정도 올려줘야 중심처럼 보임
	center_pos = center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)

	-- 해당 카메라 크기로 줌 아웃 상태. 이로 인해 좌, 우측의 다른 오브젝트 모두 시야에 들어오는 상태.
	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(6, 0)

	--페이드 인 시
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--이후 해당 섹터의 오벨리스크 활성 애니메이션 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.sector_info[current_sector_key].sfx_key)

	animator_util.play(activated_obelisk, 'on')
	wait_for_sec(2.6)

	animator_util.play(activated_obelisk, 'idle')

	--나레이션 박스 실행.
	--나레이션 : 저스티스 스위치 [색상명]가 활성화되었습니다.
	--4스테이지 : 옐로
	--5스테이지 : 그린
	--6스테이지 : 레드
	--7스테이지 : 블루
	--나레이션 종료되면,
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.sector_info[current_sector_key].nar_key })

	--애니메이션 실행 완료된 후, 1초 길이로 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:show_world_cloud_async(codes, min_delay, max_delay, min_font_size, max_font_size, additional_speed)
	min_delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(min_delay, 0.05)
	max_delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(max_delay, 0.2)
	min_font_size = lua_helper.get_or_default(min_font_size, 32)
	max_font_size = lua_helper.get_or_default(max_font_size, 64)

	-- 말구름 각각의 y 위치를 일정 간격 이상으로 설정하는 로직
	local code_interval_large = 1.4 / (#codes + 1)
	local code_interval_small = code_interval_large / 4

	-- 평균 시간 계산
	local standard_delay = (min_delay + max_delay) / 2

	-- 홀수, 짝수 시의 시간 간격 저장
	local saved_delay = 0

	local default_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255)

	-- 말구름 색상 5개 준비
	local special_color = {
		CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 0, 255 ),
		CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 0, 255 ),
		CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 0, 255, 255 ),
		CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 0.7, 255, 255 ),
		CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 255, 255, 255 ),
	}

	local wait_coroutines = {}

	for i = 1, #codes do
		-- 말구름 각각의 y 위치를 일정 간격 이상으로 설정하는 로직
		local cur_y_middle = -0.7 + code_interval_large * i
		local cur_y_min = cur_y_middle + code_interval_small
		local cur_y_max = cur_y_middle + code_interval_small * 3

		-- 말구름 시작 위치 y값 랜덤으로 설정
		local cur_x = 1.5
		local cur_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(cur_y_min, cur_y_max)

		-- 말구름 폰트 사이즈 랜덤으로 설정
		local cur_font_size = random_util.get_random_int(min_font_size, max_font_size)

		-- 말구름 이동 속도 랜덤으로 설정
		local cur_speed = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.45, 0.55)
		if additional_speed ~= nil then
			cur_speed = cur_speed + additional_speed
		end

		-- 말구름 색상 랜덤으로 설정 (색상 들어갈 확률 5/15)
		local color_rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 15)
		local color = default_color

		if color_rand <= 5 then
			color = special_color[color_rand]
		end

		local target_x = -cur_x
		local life_time = math.abs(target_x - cur_x) / cur_speed

		-- 말구름 생성
		local text_coroutine = start_coroutine_enumerator(CS.MessyText.SetMessyText(game_string:GetString(codes[i]),
				vector(cur_x, cur_y), 0, 9999, cur_font_size, 0, vector(-1, 0), cur_speed, life_time, color, -1))

		table.insert(wait_coroutines, text_coroutine)

		if i < #codes then
			-- 랜덤으로 대기
			-- index가 짝수 : 현재 딜레이를 저장하고 다음으로 이동
			-- index가 홀수 : 짝수 값에 맞춰서 두 딜레이를 더한 값이 평균이 되도록 설정한 뒤 다음으로 이동
			local cur_delay = (i % 2 == 0) and
					CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min_delay, max_delay) or
					2 * standard_delay - saved_delay

			if i % 2 == 0 then
				saved_delay = cur_delay
			end

			wait_for_unscaled_sec(cur_delay)
		end
	end

	coroutine_util.wait_coroutines(wait_coroutines)

	CS.MessyText.DisposeAll()
end

--region 상점 처리

function local_class:add_score(score_adder)
	if not self.scoring_activated then
		return
	end

	local floating_text = CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(get_party_leader())
	floating_text:ActivateForAddDungeonkingdomRankPoint(score_adder)

	self:set_score(self.score_info.current_score + score_adder)
end

function local_class:set_score(target_score)
	self.score_info.current_score = target_score

	self:refresh_ranking()

	self:refresh_rank_board()
end

function local_class:refresh_ranking()
	do
		-- FIXME : 점수가 항상 플러스 된다고 가정...?
		local rank_info = self.score_info.rank_info[self.score_info.current_ranking_index]

		if self.score_info.current_score < rank_info.score then
			exception_stage_exit('Sector Tanker Rank Board Score Cannot Be Reduced')
			return
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.score_info.rank_info do
		local rank_info = self.score_info.rank_info[i]

		-- 계속 갱신해서 마지막 인덱스를 지나더라도 (1등 점수보다 올라가더라도) 추가 처리를 해주지 않도록 함
		if self.score_info.current_score >= rank_info.score then
			self.score_info.current_ranking_index = i
		else
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:refresh_rank_board()
	local rank_info = self.score_info.rank_info[self.score_info.current_ranking_index]

	self:set_rank_board(rank_info.ranking, self.score_info.current_score)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	self.get_fx_lasthit()

--- 섹터 보스 핼멧 부수는 연출
--- 캐릭터가 바뀌기 때문에 이 연출 이후로는 헬멧 없는 NPC를 사용해야 함
--- 시작하기 전 필수 준비 사항 :
--- 					sector_boss / knight / hero_ai 위치 및 방향 세팅
--- 					sector_boss 애니메이션 prostrate, 이모션 sleep_deep
---@param character_dict table 해당 연출에서 사용할 캐릭터들 테이블
---@param sector_boss_emotion string
---						knight 					기사 캐릭터
---						sector_boss 			해당 섹터의 보스 NPC (크레이그, 코코, 마리안, 마빈)
---						sector_boss_no_helmet 	sector_boss의 no_helmet 버전 NPC
function local_class:break_sector_boss_helmet(character_dict, sector_boss_emotion)
	local sector_boss = character_dict.sector_boss
	local sector_boss_no_helmet = character_dict.sector_boss_no_helmet
	local knight = character_dict.knight

	sector_boss_emotion = lua_helper.get_or_default(sector_boss_emotion, 'damaged')

	local break_anim_name = 'unique/helmet_break'

	scene_util.set_emotion(sector_boss, self, sector_boss_emotion)

	do
		character_util.set_position(sector_boss_no_helmet, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_direction(sector_boss_no_helmet, sector_boss.Direction)

		-- 빠르게 애니메이션의 마지막 프레임까지 옮겨줌
		scene_util.set_anim(sector_boss_no_helmet, self, { name = break_anim_name, loop = false, scale = 100 })
		scene_util.set_emotion(sector_boss_no_helmet, self, sector_boss_emotion)
		character_util.set_active_state(sector_boss_no_helmet, 'enabled')

		-- 스파인 업데이트가 덜되어있는 경우가 있어서 밖에서도 업데이트가 지속되도록 함
		sector_boss_no_helmet.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	end

	--보스전 완료 후 페이드 인 시 카메라 플레이어 중심으로 배치된 상태.

	-- FIXME : QTE Tap을 먼저 실행하면 엄지 모양 스파인이 위치가 가운데에만 보이는 문제가 있어 다른 QTE를 불러왔다가 바로 해제
	screen_util.qte_swipe('left')
	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	do
		--손에 활베라를 든 상태입니다.
		scene_util.show_weapon(knight)

		local height = 3
		local total_duration = 0.8
		local anim_name = 'twohand_attack4'
		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(knight, anim_name)
		local anim_scale = anim_duration / total_duration
		local start_pos = knight.Position

		--플레이어 right, attack, twohand_attack4(앞동작)을 실행하며
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = anim_name, scale = anim_scale, loop = false })

		do
			local time_factor = 4
			local up_duration = total_duration / 2 * time_factor

			knight.SpineController.TimeScale = 1 / time_factor

			--카메라 줌 인하고,
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, up_duration)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

			--캐릭터 2번 Y값만큼 상승.
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(up_duration, function(progress)
				local cur_height = interpolations_constants.ease_out_sine(progress, 0, height, 1)

				character_util.set_position(knight,
						start_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_height, true)
			end)
		end

		knight.SpineController.TimeScale = 0

		do
			local slow_key = 's5_slow'
			local qte_touched = false

			local event_listener = {
				on_touch_event = function(_, e)
					if not qte_touched and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
						qte_touched = true
						return true
					end

					return false
				end,
				on_stage_end_event = function(this, _)
					message_system:Unsubscribe(this, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

					return true
				end
			}

			do
				time_util.mod(slow_key, 0.1)

				message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
				message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

				screen_util.show_tap(nil, true)

				while not qte_touched do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

				message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
				message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

				time_util.unmod(slow_key)
			end
		end

		knight.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

		--QTE 실행되면 이후 플레이어 right, attack, twohand_attack4(뒷동작)을 3번 위치까지 Y값을 낙하시키며 실행.
		do
			local time_factor = 0.5
			local down_duration = total_duration / 2 * time_factor

			--플레이어 right, attack, twohand_attack4(앞동작)을 실행하며
			knight.SpineController.TimeScale = 1 / time_factor

			camera_util.move(sector_boss.Position, down_duration)

			--카메라 줌 인하고,

			--캐릭터 2번 Y값만큼 상승.
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(down_duration, function(progress)
				local cur_height = interpolations_constants.ease_in_sine(progress, height, -height, 1)

				character_util.set_position(knight,
						start_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_height, true)
			end)

			character_util.set_position(knight, start_pos)
		end

		knight.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

		-- 활베라에 헬멧이 가리는 문제가 있어서 knight보다 위치를 정말 살짝 -z 방향으로 내려줌
		character_util.set_position(sector_boss,
				vector_util.get_xy0(sector_boss.Position, knight.Position.z - 0.001))

		--해당 시점이 되도록 하락
		--손에 활베라를 든 상태입니다.

		--플레이어가 바닥에 닿은 시점에 화면 크게 shake 1회
		camera_util.shake(0.7, 0.3)

		-- 플레이어 중심으로 FX_lasthit 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_enhance_result_fail_02')
		self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(knight.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
		self.get_fx_helmet_hit():Instantiate(sector_boss.Position +
				vector(character_util.get_look_direction(sector_boss) == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and -0.35 or 0.35, 0.2, 0))


		wait_for_sec(1)

		scene_util.set_anim_async(sector_boss, self,
				{ name = break_anim_name, loop = false, keep_anim = true })

		character_util.set_active_state(sector_boss_no_helmet, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(sector_boss_no_helmet, sector_boss.Position)

		character_util.set_active_state(sector_boss, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_position(sector_boss, vector(999, 0, 999))

		sector_boss_no_helmet.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

		scene_util.hide_weapon(knight)
		character_util.stop(knight)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		--줌 빠르게 복귀를 동시에 실행.
		camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
		camera_util.move_async(knight.Position, 1, { end_target = knight })
	end
end

	local directional_light_count = 3

	for i = 1, directional_light_count do
		local light = get_field_object('directional_light_' .. i)
		light.ActiveState = active_state((i == turn_on_index) and 'enabled' or 'disabled')
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_door_cat()) then
		if not self.cat_return_complete then
			if not self.is_interacting and self.first_meet then
				self.is_interacting = true
				sp_util.start_scene(self.door_cat_ask_for_help, self, false)
				return true
			elseif not self.is_interacting and not self.first_meet then
				self.is_interacting = true
				sp_util.start_scene(self.door_cat_ask_for_help, self, true)
				return true
			end
		else
			if not self.is_interacting then
				self.is_interacting = true
				sp_util.start_scene(self.return_to_mirror_door_event, self)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_event_key(self.current_use_key_index)) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.keydoor_string .. self.current_use_key_index .. self.area_string then
			if self.camera_shaking then
				self.camera_shaking = false
				sp_util.start_scene(self.close_door_event, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader,
			self.keydoor_string .. self.current_use_key_index .. self.shake_string) then
		if not self.pause_camera_shaking then
			if not self.camera_shaking and self.current_use_key_index > 1 then
				self.camera_shaking = true
				start_coroutine(self.open_door_event, self)
				return true
			end
		else
			self.camera_shaking = true
			self.pause_camera_shaking = false
			start_coroutine(self.restart_shake_in_event_area, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.keydoor_string .. self.current_use_key_index .. self.shake_string then
			if self.camera_shaking then
				self.camera_shaking = false
				self.pause_camera_shaking = true
				start_coroutine(self.stop_shake_in_event_area, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end


function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle6' then
		start_coroutine(self.create_event_key, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_event_key_3_switch()) then
		if not self.show_key_3 then
			self.show_key_3 = true
			start_coroutine(self.create_event_key, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

	self:set_quest_icon(cat,'notice')

		end

	local exit = self.get_other_world_door_interact_object()
