function local_class:door_cat_ask_for_help(retry)
	local cat = self.get_door_cat()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	self:set_quest_icon(cat, 'remove')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.first_meet_with_cat
	self.first_meet = false

	party_util.align_party(cat.Position, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	-- 고양이(down, idle, seat): $name?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'seat' },
			nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })


	-- 1번째 선택지
	-- (초록색) 도와준다.
	-- (빨간색) 도와주지 않는다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 2, 'mercy' },
		{ self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 3, 'brutal' }
	})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언: (right, attack, release 2회)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(user_party.Leader, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.set_anim_async(user_party.Leader, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(user_party.Leader, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })
	elseif choose_result == 2 then

		-- 가디언(right, doyagao, 어깨 으쓱)
		scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'right', { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'doyagao' }, 1)
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })
		-- 고양이(down, tired, angry): (emoticon_bubble_sweat)
		scene_util.play_emoticon_action(cat, self, 'down', { name = 'angry', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' }, { name = 'tired' }, 'sweat')
		-- 이벤트 종료

		self.is_interacting = false

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

		self:set_quest_icon(cat, 'notice')

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

		return
	end

	-- 고양이(down, smile, seat): 너의 이름은…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'seat' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })
	-- 고양이(down, smile, seat): (emoticon_bubble_silence)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(cat, self, 'down', { name = 'seat', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_bad_01' }, { name = 'smile' }, 'silence')
	-- 고양이(down, idle, hurt): 지금 그게 중요한 게 아니야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'hurt' },
			nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 1 .. '_' .. 5, skip = true })
	-- 가디언(right, tired, question): (emoticon_bubble_question)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(leader, self, 'right', { name = 'question', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' }, { name = 'tired' }, 'question')
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.step_1

	self.earthquake_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true })
	camera_util.shake(0.025, 99999)
	self.camera_shaking = true

	-- 카메라 포커스 1번 키도어(keydoor_1)로 서서히 이동
	local key_door = self.get_key_door(1)
	local backup_stage_camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	camera_util.move_async(key_door.Position, 1)


	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(cat, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, { dir = 'right', sfx = false })

	-- 1번 키도어 Full Opening 후 카메라 포커스 가디언에게 서서히 이동

	local door = self.get_key_door(self.current_use_key_index)
	local animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator.speed = 3
	animator:Play('open')

	-- 고양이(right, scared, happy)
	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, { name = 'scared' })
	scene_util.set_anim(cat, self, { name = 'happy' })
	-- 가디언(right, surprise, embarrassed)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, { name = 'surprise' })
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	wait_for_sec(4)

	local pos = self.get_dark_effect_pos(self.current_use_key_index)
	self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index] = self.get_fx_dark_smoke():Instantiate(pos)
	self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index].transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 0, 1)
	self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index].transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local time_scale = 0.7
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local effect_move_time = 1.5
		while time_passed < effect_move_time do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * time_scale

			if self.loop_escape then
				return
			end

			self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index].transform.localScale = vector(1.5, time_passed, 1)
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		--self.fx_dark_smoke:Dispose()
	end)

	door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	camera_util.move_async(backup_stage_camera_pos, 1)

	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(leader, { dir = 'up', sfx = false })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 고양이(right, scared, happy): 안 돼! (제자리 점프 2회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(cat, true)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'happy', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_sadness_02' },
			{ name = 'scared' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 고양이(right, attack, release 2회 후 angry): (볼드체) 닫아야만해, 저 문을!
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(cat, { dir = 'right' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, { name = 'attack' })
	scene_util.set_anim_async(cat, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(cat, self,
			'right',
			{ name = 'angry', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_negative_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 고양이(right, attack, happy): 이쪽이야!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'happy', one_shot_sfx = '01_swing_01' },
			{ name = 'attack' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 3, skip = true })

	self:create_event_key()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local cat_next_move_pos = self.get_door_cat_pos(2)
	local cat_next_move_pos_list = nil

	local run_andtalk_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
		scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = self.string_key .. 2 .. '_' .. 4, skip = true })
		run_andtalk_end = true
	end)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cat)
	scene_util.set_anim(cat, self, { name = 'get' })
	character_util.jump_move(cat, cat_next_move_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 5.5, 1.3, true, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cat)

	cat_next_move_pos_list = { self.get_door_cat_pos(2), self.get_door_cat_pos(3) }

	wp_util.move_async(cat, cat_next_move_pos_list, 4.5, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	while not run_andtalk_end do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 고양이(키도어 방향, idle, hissing)
	scene_util.set_anim(cat, self, { name = 'hissing', keep = true })
	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(cat, self.controller)
	cat.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.is_interacting = false

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

function local_class:create_event_key()
	if self.current_use_key_index == 2 then
		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			if self.earthquake_loop_sfx ~= nil then
				self.earthquake_loop_sfx:Stop()
				self.earthquake_loop_sfx = nil
			end
			self.earthquake_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true })
		end)

	end

	local key = self.get_event_key(self.current_use_key_index)
	if key ~= nil then
		self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(self.key_pos_list[self.current_use_key_index])

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		--key.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		key.Position = self.key_pos_list[self.current_use_key_index]
	end
end

function local_class:open_door_event()
	local door = self.get_key_door(self.current_use_key_index)
	local animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator.speed = 3
	animator:Play('open')

	if self.earthquake_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.earthquake_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.earthquake_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.025, 99999)
	self.earthquake_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true })

	door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	wait_for_sec(4)

	local pos = self.get_dark_effect_pos(self.current_use_key_index)
	self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index] = self.get_fx_dark_smoke():Instantiate(pos)
	self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index].transform.localScale = vector(1.5, 0, 1)
	self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index].transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local time_scale = 0.7
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local effect_move_time = 1.5
		while time_passed < effect_move_time do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * time_scale

			if self.loop_escape then
				return
			end

			self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index].transform.localScale = vector(1.5, time_passed, 1)
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end)


end

function local_class:close_door_event()
	local key = self.get_event_key(self.current_use_key_index)
	if key ~= nil then
		self.get_fx_reset():Instantiate(key.Position)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_warp_01')

		key.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		key.Position = self.key_pos_list[self.current_use_key_index]
		key.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		key.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour.Instance
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_01')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	local door = self.get_key_door(self.current_use_key_index)
	local animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('close')

	local time_scale = 0.2
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		local effect_move_time = 1.5
		local time_passed = 0
		while effect_move_time > 0 do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * time_scale

			effect_move_time = effect_move_time - time_passed

			if self.loop_escape then
				return
			end

			self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index].transform.localScale = vector(1.5, effect_move_time, 1)
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		if self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index] ~= nil then
			self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index]:Dispose()
			self.dark_smoke_effect_list[self.current_use_key_index] = nil
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	if self.earthquake_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.earthquake_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.earthquake_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:door_cat_bevavior_after_close_event()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

	door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:door_cat_bevavior_after_close_event()

			backup_arrive_pos_index = arrive_pos_index
			arrive_pos_index = 13
		end

		for i = start_index + 1, arrive_pos_index do

			cat_next_move_pos_list = {}

			for i = start_index + 1, first_arrive_pos_index do
				table.insert(cat_next_move_pos_list, self.get_door_cat_pos(i))

			wp_util.move_async(cat, cat_next_move_pos_list, 5.5, nil)

		end

		else
			self.current_waiting_pos_count = self.current_waiting_pos_count + 1
		end

		if self.current_waiting_pos_count > 0 then
			start_coroutine(self.cat_wating_loop, self)
		else

function local_class:door_cat_anim_emotion_after_stop()
	local cat = self.get_door_cat()
	-- 고양이(키도어 방향, idle, hissing)
	scene_util.set_anim(cat, self, { name = 'hissing', keep = true })
	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, { name = 'attack' })
end

function local_class:cat_wating_loop()
	local cat = self.get_door_cat()
	self.cat_waiting = true

	local time_passed = 0
	local waiting_time = 2

	local distance = 0
	while self.cat_waiting do
		distance = (user_party.Leader.Position - cat.Position).magnitude
		if distance < 3 then
			self.cat_waiting = false
			local list = self.waiting_index_list[self.current_use_key_index]
			start_coroutine(self.door_cat_move_to_next_waiting_pos, self, self.current_use_key_index, list[self.current_waiting_pos_count + 1])
			break
		end

		-- 대기 제한 시간
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if waiting_time < time_passed then
			self.cat_waiting = false
			local list = self.waiting_index_list[self.current_use_key_index]
			start_coroutine(self.door_cat_move_to_next_waiting_pos, self, self.current_use_key_index, list[self.current_waiting_pos_count + 1])
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:return_to_mirror_door_event()
	local cat = self.get_door_cat()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 0.5)

	self:set_quest_icon(cat,'remove')

	party_util.align_party(cat.Position, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	-- 고양이(right, smile, happy): $name 덕분에 집에 갈 수 있게 됐어.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'happy', one_shot_sfx = '03_dialogue_positive_02' },
			{ name = 'smile' },
			{ key = self.string_key .. 6 .. '_' .. 1, skip = true })
	-- 고양이(right, idle, scratch): 따라와 볼래? 보여줄 게 있어!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(cat, self,
			nil,
			{ name = 'scratch' },
			nil,
			{ key = self.string_key .. 6 .. '_' .. 2, skip = true })
	-- 고양이(right, idle, angry): (emoticon_bubble_happy)
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(cat, self, 'right', { name = 'angry', one_shot_sfx = '01_guild_cat_01' }, nil, 'happy')
	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 고양이(up, idle, walk): (포탈로 입장한다.)
	wp_util.move(cat, cat.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), nil, 1)
	-- 스파인 1초에 걸쳐 알파값 0으로 변화
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cat, 0, 0.4)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
	-- 포탈 입구 인터랙션 시 이세계 포탈 출구로 이동하도록 변경
	local exit = self.get_other_world_door_interact_object()
	exit.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	start_coroutine(self.loop_event_in_other_world, self)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.5)

	self.is_interacting = false
end

function local_class:loop_event_in_other_world()
	local cat = self.get_door_cat()
	local butterfly = self.get_butterfly()
	local cat_loop_pos_1 = self.get_ending_door_cat_move_pos(1)

	cat.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	butterfly.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	--character_util.remove_relate_event(cat, self.controller)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cat, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_position(cat, cat_loop_pos_1 + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_emotion(cat, self, { name = 'smile' })
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(cat, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

	character_util.set_position(butterfly, cat_loop_pos_1 + vector(-3, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(butterfly, { dir = 'left', sfx = false })

	local move_pos_list = {}
	local start_index = 1
	local last_index = 4
	for i = last_index, start_index, -1 do
		table.insert(move_pos_list, self.get_ending_door_cat_move_pos(i))
	end
	wp_util.move(cat, move_pos_list, 4.5, nil, { end_type = 'loop' })
	wp_util.move(butterfly, move_pos_list, 4.5, nil, { end_type = 'loop' })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'door_cat_add_listener' }))
end

function local_class:stop_shake_in_event_area()
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	if self.earthquake_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.earthquake_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.earthquake_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:restart_shake_in_event_area()
	self.earthquake_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true })
	camera_util.shake(0.025, 99999)
end

function local_class:set_quest_icon(fo, type)
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(fo)

	if type == 'notice' then
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(fo)
	elseif type == 'cleared' then
		quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(fo)
	elseif type == 'accepted' then
		quest_icon.SetQuestAccepted(fo)
	elseif type == 'remove' then
		return
	end
end

return local_class

local function table_is_empty(table)
	local is_empty = true
	for key, value in pairs(table) do
		is_empty = false
		break
	end

	return is_empty
end

-- 테이블이 비어있을때까지 기다리는 함수
local function wait_for_table_is_empty(table)
	local table_is_not_empty = false
	for key, value in pairs(table) do
		table_is_not_empty = true
		break
	end

	while table_is_not_empty do
		table_is_not_empty = false
		for key, value in pairs(table) do
			table_is_not_empty = true
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local function aabb(a, b)
	return a:Intersects(b)
end

local function aabb_ex(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

-- 해당 점이 바운드 안에 충돌하는지 aabb 체크
local function aabb_by_point(bounds, point)
	return bounds.min.x <= point.x and bounds.max.x >= point.x
			and bounds.min.z <= point.z and bounds.max.z >= point.z
end

		if self.event_scripts[i].on_zone_enter_event ~= nil then
			self.event_scripts[i]:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		end
	end

	if self.game_is_running then
		local knight = self.knight
		-- 주인공이 존에 들어갔을 경우
		if self.knight_info.is_alive and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, knight) then
			-- 체크포인트 체크 (오직 현재 체크포인트보다 높은 것만 체크하면 된다.)
			if self.current_checkpoint >= 0 and self.current_checkpoint < self.checkpoint_count then
				for i = self.current_checkpoint + 1, self.checkpoint_count do
					if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.get_checkpoint_zone_name(i)) then
						self.current_checkpoint = i
						start_coroutine(self.start_checkpoint_event, self, i)
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			for i = 1, #self.player_event_zone_list do
				if (not self.player_event_zone_list[i].is_executed) and
						type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.player_event_zone_list[i].name) then
					self.player_event_zone_list[i].is_executed = true
					if self.player_event_zone_list[i].args ~= nil then
						start_coroutine(self.player_event_zone_list[i].callback, self.player_event_zone_list[i].handler, table.unpack(self.player_event_zone_list[i].args))
					else
						start_coroutine(self.player_event_zone_list[i].callback, self.player_event_zone_list[i].handler)
					end
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false

-- 플레이어 업데이트
function local_class:player_update()
	local knight = self.knight
	self.can_player_knockback = true

	while self.game_is_running do
		local unscale_dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.knight_info.knockback_time > 0 then
			self.knight_info.knockback_time = self.knight_info.knockback_time - unscale_dt
			if self.knight_info.knockback_time < 0 then
				self.knight_info.knockback_time = 0
			end
		end

		if not self.knight_info.is_pause then
			local dt = unscale_dt * self.time_scale
			local player_last_knockback_info = self.player_last_knockback_info

			if player_last_knockback_info.instigator ~= nil then
				player_last_knockback_info.duration = player_last_knockback_info.duration - dt

				if player_last_knockback_info.duration <= 0 then
					player_last_knockback_info.instigator = nil
					player_last_knockback_info.duration = 0
				end
			end

			local event_result = self:bound_event_trigger_by_character(knight)

			if event_result.result then
				local target = event_result.fo
				start_coroutine(self.on_player_hit_from_pos_event, self, target.Position, event_result.fo, event_result.sfx_key)
			end

			-- 플레이어가 낭떠러지에 있으면 캐치
			if self.knight_info.is_alive and (not self.knight_info.is_pause) and self.knight_info.knockback_time <= 0 then
				local knight_pos = knight.Position
				if self:is_fall_pos_by_entity_info(self.knight_info) and (not lua_helper.type_compare(knight.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)) then
					self.knight_info.is_alive = false
					start_coroutine(self.fall_game_over_scene, self)
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:flame_machine_update()
	-- 화염 방사기 이동 속도
	local knight = self.knight
	local z_limit = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_knight_jump_pos_1').z
	local time_passed = 3
	local sfx_duration = 3
	local sfx_distance = 8 * 8

	while self.game_is_running do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.time_scale
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local move_speed = self.current_flame_machine_info.speed

		for i = 1, self.flame_machine_count do
			local flame_machine = self.get_flame_machine(i)
			if i == 1 then
				local fire_pos = flame_machine.Position + vector(0, 0, 6)
				if (knight.Position - fire_pos).sqrMagnitude < sfx_distance then
					if time_passed > sfx_duration then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fire_06')
						time_passed = 0
					end
				else
					time_passed = sfx_duration + 1
				end
			end
		end

		if self.game_is_running then
			while self.knight_info.knockback_time > 0 and self.game_is_running do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			while (not self.flame_machine_is_alive) and self.game_is_running do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			if self.game_is_running then
				local min_x = nil
				local max_x = nil
				local min_z = nil

				dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.time_scale
				local current_speed = move_speed * dt

				for i = 1, self.flame_machine_count do
					local flame_machine = self.get_flame_machine(i)

					flame_machine.Position = flame_machine.Position + vector(0, 0, current_speed)

					--if i == 4 then
					--	if time_passed > sfx_duration then
					--		-- 화염 방사기 사운드 중간에서 발생하게
					--		music_player_util.play_sfx({
					--			sfx_name = '01_fire_06', parent = flame_machine, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
					--		time_passed = 0
					--	end
					--end

					-- z가 한계치까지 왔다면 더이상 화염 방사기가 못나가게
					if i == 1 and flame_machine.Position.z >= z_limit then
						self.flame_machine_is_alive = false
					end

					if self.controller.fx_flamethrower_list ~= nil and self.controller.fx_flamethrower_list[i] ~= nil then
						self.controller.fx_flamethrower_list[i].transform.position = flame_machine.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.25)
					end

					-- 여기서 min x, max x 구해두자.
					local bounds = flame_machine.Bounds

					if min_x == nil then
						min_x = bounds.min.x
					elseif min_x > bounds.min.x then
						min_x = bounds.min.x
					end

					if max_x == nil then
						max_x = bounds.max.x
					elseif max_x < bounds.max.x then
						max_x = bounds.max.x
					end

					if min_z == nil then
						min_z = bounds.min.z
					end
				end

				if self.knight_info.is_alive and min_x ~= nil and max_x ~= nil then
					local max_z = min_z + self.flame_machine_attack_distance
					local flame_bounds = {
						min = {
							x = min_x,
							z = min_z
						},
						max = {
							x = max_x,
							z = max_z
						}
					}
					local knight_bounds = knight.Bounds

					if self.knight_info.knockback_time <= 0 and aabb_ex(flame_bounds, knight_bounds) then
						-- 불에 타죽는 연출 시작
						self.knight_info.is_alive = false
						start_coroutine(self.fire_game_over_scene, self)
					end

					-- 다른 엔티티들 체크하기
					for key, value in pairs(self.entities) do
						if key ~= 'player' then
							local fo = value.fo
							if value.knockback_time <= 0 and value.is_alive and aabb_ex(flame_bounds, fo.Bounds) and value.on_die_from_fire then
								value.on_die_from_fire(value.handler, value)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

-- 인덱스를 리턴함
function local_class:register_bound_fo(fo, on_hit_by_character, on_hit_by_position, callback_table, has_override, sfx_key)
	local index = 1
	has_override = lua_helper.get_or_default(has_override, false)

	-- 만약 recycle_index가 존재하다면 그것을 가져온다.
	if self.bound_fo_recycle_index_list[1] ~= nil then
		index = self.bound_fo_recycle_index_list[1]
		table.remove(self.bound_fo_recycle_index_list, index)
	else
		index = self.bound_fo_count + 1
		self.bound_fo_count = index
	end

	self.bound_fo_list[index] = {
		fo = fo,
		on_hit_by_character = on_hit_by_character,
		on_hit_by_position = on_hit_by_position,
		callback_table = callback_table,
		-- 오버라이드 여부 체크
		has_override = has_override,
		sfx_key = sfx_key
	}

	return index
end

function local_class:unregister_bound_fo(index)
	if self.bound_fo_list[index] ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.bound_fo_recycle_index_list, index)
		self.bound_fo_list[index] = nil
	end
end

-- 바운드 리스트에 바운드를 트리거 한다. (외부에서 호출) 캐릭터 전용
-- 바운드끼리 hit 하면 true와 fo를 리턴
function local_class:bound_event_trigger_by_character(from)
	local from_bound = from.Bounds

	for key, value in pairs(self.bound_fo_list) do
		local target = value.fo
		local target_bound = target.Bounds
		if from_bound:Intersects(target_bound) then
			-- target의 콜백을 호출해주자.
			if value.on_hit_by_character ~= nil then
				value.on_hit_by_character(value.callback_table, from, target)
			end

			return { result = true, fo = target, sfx_key = value.sfx_key }
		end
	end

	return { result = false, fo = nil }
end

function local_class:on_player_hit_from_pos_event(pos, instigator, sfx_key)
	if self.game_is_running then
		local knight = self.knight
		local pos_key = pos

		if instigator ~= nil then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.player_last_knockback_info.instigator, instigator) then
				return
			end

			self.player_last_knockback_info.instigator = instigator
			self.player_last_knockback_info.duration = self.knockback_delay
		end

		sfx_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(sfx_key, '02_hit_big_01')
		local dir = (knight.Position - pos)
		local dist = dir.magnitude * 0.5
		local fx_pos = (dir.normalized) * dist
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(pos + fx_pos + vector(0, 0.02, 0))

		self.player_knockback_list[pos_key] = true
		self.knight_info.knockback_time = self.knockback_time
		knock_back_from_pos(knight, pos)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_key, play_pos = pos, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'npc' })

		wait_for_sec(1)
		self.player_knockback_list[pos_key] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:register_player_zone_event(zone_name, callback, handler, ...)
	local args = { ... }
	table.insert(self.player_event_zone_list, {
		name = zone_name,
		callback = callback,
		handler = handler,
		is_executed = false,
		args = args
	})
end

function local_class:add_checkpoint_event(checkpoint_num, event, handler)
	if checkpoint_num > self.checkpoint_count then
		return
	end

	local target_event_table = self.checkpoint_event_table[checkpoint_num]

	table.insert(target_event_table, {
		event = event,
		handler = handler
	})
end

function local_class:start_checkpoint_event(checkpoint_num)
	if checkpoint_num > self.checkpoint_count then
		return
	end

	self.current_flame_machine_info = self.flame_machine_checkpoint_info[checkpoint_num]
	if self.current_flame_machine_info == nil then
		self.current_flame_machine_info = self.flame_machine_checkpoint_info[0]
	end

	-- async 이벤트가 있다면 동작해서 기달려준다.
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if self.event_scripts[i].checkpoint_async_event ~= nil then
			self.event_scripts[i]:checkpoint_async_event(checkpoint_num)
		end
	end

	local target_event_table = self.checkpoint_event_table[checkpoint_num]

	for i = 1, #target_event_table do
		start_coroutine(target_event_table[i].event, target_event_table[i].handler)
	end
end

-- 특정 커스텀 캐릭터들에게 함수를 실행 시키자.
function local_class:execute_to_custom_characters(key, func, handler)
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if self.event_scripts[i].execute_to_custom_characters ~= nil then
			self.event_scripts[i]:execute_to_custom_characters(key, func, handler)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_fall_pos_by_entity_info(entity_info)
	if self.tilemap == nil then
		return false
	end

	local pos = entity_info.fo.Position
	local x = math.ceil(pos.x - 0.5)
	local z = math.ceil(pos.z - 0.5)

	if self.tilemap[x] ~= nil and self.tilemap[x][z] ~= nil then
		-- 여기서 바운드 체크
		if self.custom_tilemap[x] ~= nil and self.custom_tilemap[x][z] ~= nil then
			local custom_tile_key_list = self.custom_tilemap[x][z]
			local is_fall_pos = true

			for i = 1, #custom_tile_key_list do
				local tile_key = custom_tile_key_list[i]
				if self.custom_tile_bounds[tile_key] ~= nil then
					-- 내부 테이블은 다음과 같이 생겼다.
					--self.custom_tile_bounds[key] = {
					--		bounds = bounds,
					--		callback = callback,
					--		handler = handler,
					--		args = { ... }
					--	}

					local info = self.custom_tile_bounds[tile_key]
					if aabb_by_point(info.bounds, pos) then
						is_fall_pos = false
						-- callback 호출해주기 (코루틴으로 디자인 해서는 절대 안된다.)
						info.callback(info.handler, entity_info, table.unpack(info.args))
					end
				end
			end

			return is_fall_pos
		end

		local bound_size = 0

		if self.tilemap[x][z] ~= true then
			if self.tilemap[x][z] == 0 then
				return (z - bound_size) > pos.z
			elseif self.tilemap[x][z] == 1 then
				return (x - bound_size) > pos.x
			elseif self.tilemap[x][z] == 2 then
				return (z + bound_size) < pos.z
			elseif self.tilemap[x][z] == 3 then
				return (x + bound_size) < pos.x
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:is_fall_pos(pos)
	if self.tilemap == nil then
		return false
	end

	local x = math.ceil(pos.x - 0.5)
	local z = math.ceil(pos.z - 0.5)

	if self.tilemap[x] ~= nil and self.tilemap[x][z] ~= nil then
		-- 여기서 바운드 체크
		if self.custom_tilemap[x] ~= nil and self.custom_tilemap[x][z] ~= nil then
			local custom_tile_key_list = self.custom_tilemap[x][z]
			local is_fall_pos = true

			for i = 1, #custom_tile_key_list do
				local tile_key = custom_tile_key_list[i]
				if self.custom_tile_bounds[tile_key] ~= nil then
					-- 내부 테이블은 다음과 같이 생겼다.
					--self.custom_tile_bounds[key] = {
					--		bounds = bounds,
					--		callback = callback,
					--		handler = handler,
					--		args = { ... }
					--	}

					local info = self.custom_tile_bounds[tile_key]
					if aabb_by_point(info.bounds, pos) then
						is_fall_pos = false
						-- callback 호출해주기 (코루틴으로 디자인 해서는 절대 안된다.)
						info.callback(info.handler, pos, table.unpack(info.args))
					end
				end
			end

			return is_fall_pos
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 엔티티를 추가하는 함수
-- 엔티티 info는 테이블 형태로 받으며 무조건 is_alive와 is_pause가 존재해야한다.
-- 또한 entity_info에는 fo도 포함되어야함
-- entity_info = { fo, is_alive, is_pause } 와 같은 형태를 이뤄야한다.
function local_class:add_entity(key, entity_info)
	self.entities[key] = entity_info
end

function local_class:remove_entity(key)
	self.entities[key] = nil
end

-- 커스텀 바운드를 넣는 함수
-- 바운드가 점유한 타일 x, z를 이용해 key값을 넣어서 최적화 되어 있는 상태.
function local_class:set_custom_tile_bounds(key, bounds, callback, handler, ...)
	self.custom_tile_bounds[key] = {
		bounds = bounds,
		callback = callback,
		handler = handler,
		args = { ... }
	}

	local start_x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.min.x)
	local end_x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.max.x)
	local start_z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.min.z)
	local end_z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.max.z)

	local out_pos_list = { }
	for x = start_x, end_x do
		for z = start_z, end_z do
			if not table_util.contain_value(out_pos_list, { x ,z }) then
				local table_x = self.custom_tilemap[x]
				if table_x == nil then
					self.custom_tilemap[x] = { }
					table_x = self.custom_tilemap[x]
				end

				local table_z = table_x[z]
				if table_z == nil then
					table_x[z] = { }
					table_z = table_x[z]
				end

				table.insert(table_z, key)
				table.insert(out_pos_list, { x, z })
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_custom_tile_bounds(key, bounds)
	local start_x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.min.x)
	local end_x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.max.x)
	local start_z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.min.z)
	local end_z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.max.z)
	local out_pos_list = { }
	for x = start_x, end_x do
		for z = start_z, end_z do
			if not table_util.contain_value(out_pos_list, { x ,z }) then
				local table_x = self.custom_tilemap[x]
				if table_x ~= nil then
					local table_z = table_x[z]
					if table_z ~= nil then
						for i = 1, #table_z do
							if table_z[i] == key then
								table.remove(table_z, i)
								break
							end
						end
					end
				end

				table.insert(out_pos_list, { x, z })
			end
		end
	end

	self.custom_tile_bounds[key] = nil
end

return local_class

		wp_util.move(clone_2, self.get_marker_clone_maid_pos(4) + drop_offset_pos, 5, nil)

function local_class:check_clone_drop(clone1, clone2, drop_offset_pos_z)
	while clone1.Position.z > (self.get_marker_clone_maid_pos(3).z + drop_offset_pos_z) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	--로레인 클론 1 ~ 14 절벽에 도착하면 0.3초 간 y축으로 -3 이동, 360도 회전, scale 1 -> 0으로 설정
	local drop_duration = 0.7
	character_util.spine_rotate(clone1, 360, drop_duration)
	character_util.jump(clone1, 3, drop_duration)

	character_util.spine_rotate(clone2, 360, drop_duration)
	character_util.jump(clone2, 3, drop_duration)

	character_util.spine_scale(clone1, unity_class.vector3.zero, drop_duration)
	character_util.spine_scale(clone2, unity_class.vector3.zero, drop_duration)

	character_util.move_to(clone1, self.get_marker_clone_drop_pos(1), drop_duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(clone2, self.get_marker_clone_drop_pos(2), drop_duration)

	character_util.set_active_state(clone1, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(clone2, 'disabled')

function local_class:start_scene()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	local maiden = self.get_maiden()
	local start_pos = self.get_knight_start_pos()
	local camera_pos = start_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	-- 카메라 위 가디언 위치와 라나 위치 사이로 이동
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 0)
	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)
	-- 화면 1초 간 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black,'linear')
	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 가디언 위 위치에서 y좌표로 10 올라간 곳에 생성 (right, damaged, embarrassed)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'embarrassed')

	-- 가디언 1초 간 자유낙하
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1
	local move_start_pos = knight.Position
	local dir = start_pos - move_start_pos
	local distance = dir.magnitude
	dir = dir.normalized
	local speed = distance / duration

	while time_passed < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local target_pos = knight.Position + (dir * (speed * dt))

		character_util.set_position(knight, target_pos, true)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	knight.Position = start_pos
	-- 03_mech_stomp_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 가디언 shake(0.04, 1)

local function table_is_empty(table)
	local is_empty = true
	for key, value in pairs(table) do
		is_empty = false
		break
	end

	return is_empty
end

-- 테이블이 비어있을때까지 기다리는 함수
local function wait_for_table_is_empty(table)
	local table_is_not_empty = false
	for key, value in pairs(table) do
		table_is_not_empty = true
		break
	end

	while table_is_not_empty do
		table_is_not_empty = false
		for key, value in pairs(table) do
			table_is_not_empty = true
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

local function aabb(a, b)
	return a:Intersects(b)
end

local function aabb_ex(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

-- 해당 점이 바운드 안에 충돌하는지 aabb 체크
local function aabb_by_point(bounds, point)
	return bounds.min.x <= point.x and bounds.max.x >= point.x
			and bounds.min.z <= point.z and bounds.max.z >= point.z
end

-- 특정 좌표로부터 넉백 판단.
local function knock_back_from_pos(target, pos)
	local knock_back_dir = ((target.Position - pos).normalized)
	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'physics', true, knock_back_dir, 12000, 0.05,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local dir = direction_util.to_str(vector_util.to_direction(pos - target.Position))
	character_util.set_direction(target, dir)
	command_util.publish_knock_back(target.Owner, target, knock_back_info, target.Position)
end

local function start_scene(func, ...)
	local args = { ... }
	local routine = function()
		sp_util.start_scene(func, table.unpack(args))

		local leader = get_party_leader()

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
		end

		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(get_party_leader(), false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	end

	return start_coroutine(routine)
end

function local_class:load_scripts(file_names)
	local scripts = {}

	for i = 1, #file_names do
		local script = get_or_create_global_table(file_names[i])
		if script ~= nil then
			table.insert(scripts, script(self))
		end
	end

	return scripts
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if self.event_scripts[i].on_pre_load ~= nil then
			self.event_scripts[i]:on_pre_load()
		end
	end

	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()
	self.get_fx_flamethrower()
	self.get_fx_dead()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.knight = self.get_knight()
	self.stage_end = false
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.knight, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	start_coroutine(self.update, self)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	for i = 1, self.flame_machine_count do
		local flame_machine = self.get_flame_machine(i)
		self.flame_machine_origin_pos_list[i] = flame_machine.Position
	end

		if self.event_scripts[i].enter ~= nil then
			self.event_scripts[i]:enter()
		end
	end

	self.current_checkpoint = self.start_checkpoint
	self:stage_setup(false, self.current_checkpoint)
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.5, 0)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(knight, { self.flower_bloom_custom_event }))

	start_coroutine(self.start_scene, self, self.current_checkpoint)

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if self.event_scripts[i].on_interact_event ~= nil then
			self.event_scripts[i]:on_interact_event(e)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if self.event_scripts[i].on_zone_enter_event ~= nil then
			self.event_scripts[i]:on_zone_enter_event(e)
		end
	end

	if self.game_is_running then
		local knight = self.knight
		-- 주인공이 존에 들어갔을 경우
		if self.knight_info.is_alive and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, knight) then
			-- 체크포인트 체크 (오직 현재 체크포인트보다 높은 것만 체크하면 된다.)
			if self.current_checkpoint >= 0 and self.current_checkpoint < self.checkpoint_count then
				for i = self.current_checkpoint + 1, self.checkpoint_count do
					if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.get_checkpoint_zone_name(i)) then
						self.current_checkpoint = i
						start_coroutine(self.start_checkpoint_event, self, i)
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			for i = 1, #self.player_event_zone_list do
				if (not self.player_event_zone_list[i].is_executed) and
						type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.player_event_zone_list[i].name) then
					self.player_event_zone_list[i].is_executed = true
					if self.player_event_zone_list[i].args ~= nil then
						start_coroutine(self.player_event_zone_list[i].callback, self.player_event_zone_list[i].handler, table.unpack(self.player_event_zone_list[i].args))
					else
						start_coroutine(self.player_event_zone_list[i].callback, self.player_event_zone_list[i].handler)
					end
					return true
				end
			end
		end

		if self.goal_event_flag and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.get_event_zone_name(5)) then
			self.goal_event_flag = false
			start_coroutine(self.goal_scene, self)
			return true
		elseif self.jump_tile_event_flag and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.get_event_zone_name(4)) then
			self.jump_tile_event_flag = false
			start_coroutine(self.jump_tile_scene, self)
			return true
		elseif self.clear_event_flag and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.get_event_zone_name(6)) then
			self.clear_event_flag = false
			start_coroutine(self.clear_scene, self)
			return true
		elseif self.onigirl_shout_flag and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, self.get_event_zone_name(3)) then
			self.onigirl_shout_flag = false
			start_coroutine(self.onigirl_shout_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 플레이어 업데이트
function local_class:player_update()
	local knight = self.knight
	self.can_player_knockback = true

	while self.game_is_running do
		local unscale_dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.knight_info.knockback_time > 0 then
			self.knight_info.knockback_time = self.knight_info.knockback_time - unscale_dt
			if self.knight_info.knockback_time < 0 then
				self.knight_info.knockback_time = 0
			end
		end

		if not self.knight_info.is_pause then
			local dt = unscale_dt * self.time_scale
			local player_last_knockback_info = self.player_last_knockback_info

			if player_last_knockback_info.instigator ~= nil then
				player_last_knockback_info.duration = player_last_knockback_info.duration - dt

				if player_last_knockback_info.duration <= 0 then
					player_last_knockback_info.instigator = nil
					player_last_knockback_info.duration = 0
				end
			end

			local event_result = self:bound_event_trigger_by_character(knight)

			if event_result.result then
				local target = event_result.fo
				start_coroutine(self.on_player_hit_from_pos_event, self, target.Position, event_result.fo, event_result.sfx_key)
			end

			-- 플레이어가 낭떠러지에 있으면 캐치
			if self.knight_info.is_alive and (not self.knight_info.is_pause) and self.knight_info.knockback_time <= 0 then
				local knight_pos = knight.Position
				if self:is_fall_pos_by_entity_info(self.knight_info) and (not lua_helper.type_compare(knight.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)) then
					self.knight_info.is_alive = false
					start_coroutine(self.fall_game_over_scene, self)
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:fall_game_over_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self.game_is_running = false

								 player_priority = 'player' })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString("qc_fall_guardian_2_5"))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')

	-- 캐릭터 (down, damaged, embarrassed)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'embarrassed')
	-- 1초 간 y축으로 -3 이동
	-- 1초 간 720도 회전
	-- 1초 간 scale 1 -> 0
	character_util.spine_rotate(knight, 720, 1)
	character_util.spine_scale(knight, unity_class.vector3.zero, 1)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, 'down')
	coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(1, 0, -3, function(_, value)
		knight.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(knight.Position, value)
	end)

	character_util.spine_rotate(knight, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	camera_util.move(vector(-100, 0, -100), 0)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.5, 0)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.current_checkpoint > 0 then
		menu = { { 'qc_fall_guardian_2_6', 'brutal' },
				 { 'qc_fall_guardian_2_7', 'mercy' } }
	end

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(menu)

	-- 처음부터를 선택했다면 체크포인트를 0으로 설정
	if result == 1 then
		self.current_checkpoint = 0
	end

	self:reset_game()
end

		menu = { { 'qc_fall_guardian_2_6', 'brutal' },
				 { 'qc_fall_guardian_2_7', 'mercy' } }
	end

	-- 처음부터를 선택했다면 체크포인트를 0으로 설정
	if result == 1 then
		self.current_checkpoint = 0
	end

	self:reset_game()
end

function local_class:flame_machine_update()
	-- 화염 방사기 이동 속도
	local knight = self.knight
	local z_limit = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_knight_jump_pos_1').z
	local time_passed = 3
	local sfx_duration = 3
	local sfx_distance = 8 * 8

	while self.game_is_running do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.time_scale
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		local move_speed = self.current_flame_machine_info.speed

		for i = 1, self.flame_machine_count do
			local flame_machine = self.get_flame_machine(i)
			if i == 1 then
				local fire_pos = flame_machine.Position + vector(0, 0, 6)
				if (knight.Position - fire_pos).sqrMagnitude < sfx_distance then
					if time_passed > sfx_duration then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fire_06')
						time_passed = 0
					end
				else
					time_passed = sfx_duration + 1
				end
			end
		end

		if self.game_is_running then
			while self.knight_info.knockback_time > 0 and self.game_is_running do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			while (not self.flame_machine_is_alive) and self.game_is_running do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			if self.game_is_running then
				local min_x = nil
				local max_x = nil
				local min_z = nil

				dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.time_scale
				local current_speed = move_speed * dt

				for i = 1, self.flame_machine_count do
					local flame_machine = self.get_flame_machine(i)

					flame_machine.Position = flame_machine.Position + vector(0, 0, current_speed)

					--if i == 4 then
					--	if time_passed > sfx_duration then
					--		-- 화염 방사기 사운드 중간에서 발생하게
					--		music_player_util.play_sfx({
					--			sfx_name = '01_fire_06', parent = flame_machine, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })
					--		time_passed = 0
					--	end
					--end

					-- z가 한계치까지 왔다면 더이상 화염 방사기가 못나가게
					if i == 1 and flame_machine.Position.z >= z_limit then
						self.flame_machine_is_alive = false
					end

					if self.controller.fx_flamethrower_list ~= nil and self.controller.fx_flamethrower_list[i] ~= nil then
						self.controller.fx_flamethrower_list[i].transform.position = flame_machine.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.25)
					end

					-- 여기서 min x, max x 구해두자.
					local bounds = flame_machine.Bounds

					if min_x == nil then
						min_x = bounds.min.x
					elseif min_x > bounds.min.x then
						min_x = bounds.min.x
					end

					if max_x == nil then
						max_x = bounds.max.x
					elseif max_x < bounds.max.x then
						max_x = bounds.max.x
					end

					if min_z == nil then
						min_z = bounds.min.z
					end
				end

				if self.knight_info.is_alive and min_x ~= nil and max_x ~= nil then
					local max_z = min_z + self.flame_machine_attack_distance
					local flame_bounds = {
						min = {
							x = min_x,
							z = min_z
						},
						max = {
							x = max_x,
							z = max_z
						}
					}
					local knight_bounds = knight.Bounds

					if self.knight_info.knockback_time <= 0 and aabb_ex(flame_bounds, knight_bounds) then
						-- 불에 타죽는 연출 시작
						self.knight_info.is_alive = false
						start_coroutine(self.fire_game_over_scene, self)
					end

					-- 다른 엔티티들 체크하기
					for key, value in pairs(self.entities) do
						if key ~= 'player' then
							local fo = value.fo
							if value.knockback_time <= 0 and value.is_alive and aabb_ex(flame_bounds, fo.Bounds) and value.on_die_from_fire then
								value.on_die_from_fire(value.handler, value)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

-- 인덱스를 리턴함
function local_class:register_bound_fo(fo, on_hit_by_character, on_hit_by_position, callback_table, has_override, sfx_key)
	local index = 1
	has_override = lua_helper.get_or_default(has_override, false)

	-- 만약 recycle_index가 존재하다면 그것을 가져온다.
	if self.bound_fo_recycle_index_list[1] ~= nil then
		index = self.bound_fo_recycle_index_list[1]
		table.remove(self.bound_fo_recycle_index_list, index)
	else
		index = self.bound_fo_count + 1
		self.bound_fo_count = index
	end

	self.bound_fo_list[index] = {
		fo = fo,
		on_hit_by_character = on_hit_by_character,
		on_hit_by_position = on_hit_by_position,
		callback_table = callback_table,
		-- 오버라이드 여부 체크
		has_override = has_override,
		sfx_key = sfx_key
	}

	return index
end

function local_class:unregister_bound_fo(index)
	if self.bound_fo_list[index] ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.bound_fo_recycle_index_list, index)
		self.bound_fo_list[index] = nil
	end
end

-- 바운드 리스트에 바운드를 트리거 한다. (외부에서 호출) 캐릭터 전용
-- 바운드끼리 hit 하면 true와 fo를 리턴
function local_class:bound_event_trigger_by_character(from)
	local from_bound = from.Bounds

	for key, value in pairs(self.bound_fo_list) do
		local target = value.fo
		local target_bound = target.Bounds
		if from_bound:Intersects(target_bound) then
			-- target의 콜백을 호출해주자.
			if value.on_hit_by_character ~= nil then
				value.on_hit_by_character(value.callback_table, from, target)
			end

			return { result = true, fo = target, sfx_key = value.sfx_key }
		end
	end

	return { result = false, fo = nil }
end

function local_class:on_player_hit_from_pos_event(pos, instigator, sfx_key)
	if self.game_is_running then
		local knight = self.knight
		local pos_key = pos

		if instigator ~= nil then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.player_last_knockback_info.instigator, instigator) then
				return
			end

			self.player_last_knockback_info.instigator = instigator
			self.player_last_knockback_info.duration = self.knockback_delay
		end

		sfx_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(sfx_key, '02_hit_big_01')
		local dir = (knight.Position - pos)
		local dist = dir.magnitude * 0.5
		local fx_pos = (dir.normalized) * dist
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(pos + fx_pos + vector(0, 0.02, 0))

		self.player_knockback_list[pos_key] = true
		self.knight_info.knockback_time = self.knockback_time
		knock_back_from_pos(knight, pos)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_key, play_pos = pos, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'npc' })

		wait_for_sec(1)
		self.player_knockback_list[pos_key] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:add_checkpoint_event(checkpoint_num, event, handler)
	if checkpoint_num > self.checkpoint_count then
		return
	end

	local target_event_table = self.checkpoint_event_table[checkpoint_num]

	table.insert(target_event_table, {
		event = event,
		handler = handler
	})
end

function local_class:start_checkpoint_event(checkpoint_num)
	if checkpoint_num > self.checkpoint_count then
		return
	end

	self.current_flame_machine_info = self.flame_machine_checkpoint_info[checkpoint_num]
	if self.current_flame_machine_info == nil then
		self.current_flame_machine_info = self.flame_machine_checkpoint_info[0]
	end

	-- async 이벤트가 있다면 동작해서 기달려준다.
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if self.event_scripts[i].checkpoint_async_event ~= nil then
			self.event_scripts[i]:checkpoint_async_event(checkpoint_num)
		end
	end

	local target_event_table = self.checkpoint_event_table[checkpoint_num]

	for i = 1, #target_event_table do
		start_coroutine(target_event_table[i].event, target_event_table[i].handler)
	end
end

function local_class:is_fall_pos_by_entity_info(entity_info)
	if self.tilemap == nil then
		return false
	end

	local pos = entity_info.fo.Position
	local x = math.ceil(pos.x - 0.5)
	local z = math.ceil(pos.z - 0.5)

	if self.tilemap[x] ~= nil and self.tilemap[x][z] ~= nil then
		-- 여기서 바운드 체크
		if self.custom_tilemap[x] ~= nil and self.custom_tilemap[x][z] ~= nil then
			local custom_tile_key_list = self.custom_tilemap[x][z]
			local is_fall_pos = true

			for i = 1, #custom_tile_key_list do
				local tile_key = custom_tile_key_list[i]
				if self.custom_tile_bounds[tile_key] ~= nil then
					-- 내부 테이블은 다음과 같이 생겼다.
					--self.custom_tile_bounds[key] = {
					--		bounds = bounds,
					--		callback = callback,
					--		handler = handler,
					--		args = { ... }
					--	}

					local info = self.custom_tile_bounds[tile_key]
					if aabb_by_point(info.bounds, pos) then
						is_fall_pos = false
						-- callback 호출해주기 (코루틴으로 디자인 해서는 절대 안된다.)
						info.callback(info.handler, entity_info, table.unpack(info.args))
					end
				end
			end

			return is_fall_pos
		end

		local bound_size = 0

		if self.tilemap[x][z] ~= true then
			if self.tilemap[x][z] == 0 then
				return (z - bound_size) > pos.z
			elseif self.tilemap[x][z] == 1 then
				return (x - bound_size) > pos.x
			elseif self.tilemap[x][z] == 2 then
				return (z + bound_size) < pos.z
			elseif self.tilemap[x][z] == 3 then
				return (x + bound_size) < pos.x
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:jump_tile_execute(user, jump_tile_num, horizontal_speed, jump_speed)
	local jump_tile = self.get_jumptile(jump_tile_num)
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local jump_tile_data = jump_tile.FieldObjectBehaviour

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(jump_tile_data, CS.Oak.JumpTileBehaviour) then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')
	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if self.game_is_running then
			jump_tile_animator:Play('off')
		end
	end, self)

	local jump_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(jump_tile.Direction)
	local current_jump_speed = jump_tile_data.JumpSpeed
	if jump_speed ~= nil then
		current_jump_speed = jump_speed
	end

	local dir = horizontal_speed * jump_dir + current_jump_speed * unity_class.vector3.up

	local jumpInfo = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	jumpInfo.jumper = user
	jumpInfo.jumpSource = jump_tile
	jumpInfo.jumpType = CS.Oak.JumpType.JumpTileJump
	jumpInfo.speed = dir.magnitude
	jumpInfo.direction = dir.normalized
	jumpInfo.jumpStartPos = user.Position
	jumpInfo.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jumpInfo.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity
	command_util.execute_jump(jumpInfo)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	while lua_helper.type_compare(user.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:goal_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local knight = self.knight
	local onigirl = self.get_onigirl()
	local maiden = self.get_maiden()
	local goal_event_pos = self.get_goal_event_pos()

	-- 존 1 입장 이벤트
	-- 라나 파티원 해제
	character_util.convert_to_npc(onigirl)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	-- 위치 이동
	-- 가디언 속도 3으로 현재 x축 좌표 유지하면서 결승선으로부터 z축 1칸 아래 위치로 이동
	local knight_pos = vector(knight.Position.x, 0, goal_event_pos.z)

	local onigirl_pos = nil
	local knight_dir = nil
	local onigirl_dir = nil

	-- 기사의 x가 골 이벤트 좌표의 x보다 클 경우 우측에 있는거니 라나를 좌측으로 가게해야함.
	if knight_pos.x > goal_event_pos.x then
		onigirl_pos = knight_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		knight_dir = 'left'
		onigirl_dir = 'right'
	else
		onigirl_pos = knight_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
		knight_dir = 'right'
		onigirl_dir = 'left'
	end

	-- 라나는 가디언으로부터 중앙 방향으로 x축으로 1칸 떨어진 x좌표로 이동해서 결승선으로부터 z축 1칸 아래 위치로 이동

	local move_key = 'goal_event_key'
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, knight_pos, nil, 1, self, move_key)

	-- 이동 완료되면 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 가디언과 라나 서로 바라봄, (awesome, success)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, knight_dir)
	scene_util.set_direction(onigirl, onigirl_dir)

	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'awesome')
	scene_util.set_emotion(onigirl, self, 'awesome')

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'success')

-- 커스텀 바운드를 넣는 함수
-- 바운드가 점유한 타일 x, z를 이용해 key값을 넣어서 최적화 되어 있는 상태.
function local_class:set_custom_tile_bounds(key, bounds, callback, handler, ...)
	self.custom_tile_bounds[key] = {
		bounds = bounds,
		callback = callback,
		handler = handler,
		args = { ... }
	}

	local start_x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.min.x)
	local end_x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.max.x)
	local start_z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.min.z)
	local end_z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.max.z)

	local out_pos_list = { }
	for x = start_x, end_x do
		for z = start_z, end_z do
			if not table_util.contain_value(out_pos_list, { x ,z }) then
				local table_x = self.custom_tilemap[x]
				if table_x == nil then
					self.custom_tilemap[x] = { }
					table_x = self.custom_tilemap[x]
				end

				local table_z = table_x[z]
				if table_z == nil then
					table_x[z] = { }
					table_z = table_x[z]
				end

				table.insert(table_z, key)
				table.insert(out_pos_list, { x, z })
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:remove_custom_tile_bounds(key, bounds)
	local start_x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.min.x)
	local end_x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.max.x)
	local start_z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.min.z)
	local end_z = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(bounds.max.z)
	local out_pos_list = { }
	for x = start_x, end_x do
		for z = start_z, end_z do
			if not table_util.contain_value(out_pos_list, { x ,z }) then
				local table_x = self.custom_tilemap[x]

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleHiddenObeliskController')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = controller @
		QuestName = HiddenObelisk @
		Comment = HiddenObelisk 퀘스트/이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

	self.unlock_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_secret'

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

-- pre story section 설정
function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PreSection')
end

-- main section 설정
function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section2')
	}

	--self.post_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PostSection')
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mk99()) and
			not self.is_screen_play then
		self.is_screen_play = false
		sp_util.start_scene(self.wake_up_scene, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

		elseif choose_result == 3 then
			--가디언 left, attack, shoot 1.5초
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'attack')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'shoot')
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)

			--mk.99 (right, mad, rifle_idle shake 0.03) angry버블
			scene_util.play_emoticon_action(mk99, self, nil, nil, nil, 'angry')

			--mk.99 (right, mad, rifle_reload): 즉시 숨통을 끊어드리죠. 휴먼.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_04')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mk99, 'qc_hidden_obelisk_pre_28')
		end

		--이후 공통

		scene_util.shake(mk99, 0.03, 99999)

		character_util.stop_shake(mk99)

		--mk.99 (down, idle, rifle_idle): 이번이 정말 마지막 기회입니다. 휴먼!

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mk99)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mk99, 'qc_hidden_obelisk_pre_29')

		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(mk99, 'qc_hidden_obelisk_pre_30')

		--하단 샤우트와 동시에 0.5초간 카메라 shake 세기 0.2

		scene_util.set_direction(mk99, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(mk99, self, 'mad')
		scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(mk99, 'qc_hidden_obelisk_pre_31')
	end

	--이후 화면 좌측으로 빠르게 사라짐
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magwi_drill_docking_01')

		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')
		wait_for_sec(1)
	elseif self.interact_level == 4 then
		--서브 스테이지 오픈.
		stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
			substage_name = self.controller.unlock_stage_name,
			substage_open_string_key = 'qc_hidden_obelisk_pre_32'
		})

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	mk99.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(mk99)

	--해당 이벤트 여부 저장
	for key, info in pairs(self.stage_by_setting_info) do
		if stage.Name == key then
			local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.data_quest_id)
			quest_util.set_custom_state(quest_progress, info.finished_key, 1)
			break
		end
	end
end

--스테이지 별 자리 셋팅
function local_class:stage_by_pre_setting()
	--스테이지 별 진행도 확인 및 해당 스테이지 npc 셋팅
	for key, info in pairs(self.stage_by_setting_info) do
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.data_quest_id)
		local state = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, info.finished_key)

		--대화 여부
		if state == 1 then
			--이벤트 봤을 경우 내부 단계 위로
			self.interact_level = self.interact_level + 1
		else
			--해당 스테이지 셋팅
			if stage.Name == key then
				message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
				local npc = self.get_mk99()
				character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
				character_util.set_position(npc, self.get_mk99_pos())
				scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'down', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'tired')
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'sleep')
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
				character_util.add_listener(npc, self.cs_controller)
			end
		end
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleHiddenObeliskSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenCastleHiddenObeliskSection1 @
		Comment = QueenCastleHiddenObeliskSection1 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_secret'

	self.get_battle_gate_name = function(num)
		return 's1_boss_battle_gate_' .. num
	end

	--npc
	self.get_hero = function()
		return get_character('hero_ai')
	end

	self.get_mk99 = function()
		return get_character('mk99_queencastle')
	end

	self.get_mk99_battle = function()
		return get_character('mk99_battle')
	end

	self.is_first = true

	self.section_state = {
		before_interact = 1,
		before_battle = 2,
		after_battle = 3,
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.before_interact
	self.quest_marker_name = 'mk99_battle'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()

	sp_util.start_scene(self.intro_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_mk99()) then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_interact then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.mecha_android_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'mk99_battle' and self.current_state == self.section_state.before_battle then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.after_battle
		start_coroutine(self.after_battle_scene, self)
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:intro_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero = self.get_hero()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0 then
		camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	end

	--카이(right,attack,idle)(jump1회): 용사님! 역시 방금 지나간 것은 Mk.99였군요!
	--이때 가디언(left,idle,idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.normal_jump(hero)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self, nil, nil, 'attack', 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_1')

	--카이(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm):  Mk 시리즈 유닛이라면 사고 회로에 즉각적인 전투 대응을 위한 자율 행동 알고리즘이 탑재되어 있습니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self, nil, 'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_2')

	--카이(right,tired,idle): 초기 모델 중엔 이로 인해 사용자와 충돌하는 트러블이 생겨 논란이 있었지만…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self, nil, 'idle', 'tired', 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_3')

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self, nil, 'release', 'attack', 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_4')

	--카이(right,burning,cast): 이걸 이용하면 저 전투형 안드로이드의 통제권을 되찾을 수 있을겁니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self, nil, 'cast', 'burning', 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_5')

	--그 트러블 힘들었지. (보라)

			{

				{ 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_choose_2', 'mercy' },
				{ 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_choose_3', 'brutal' },
			})

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		--가디언(left,scared,idle)(shake0.03 1초)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
		--카이(right,smile,idle): 하하, 마치 그때 탈출한 안드로이드를 직접 만난 것 처럼 얘기하시는 군요!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self, nil, 'idle', 'smile', 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_6')

	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		--가디언(left,smile,sing)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'sing')

		--카이(right,slee_deep,cross_arm): 그러면 좋겠지만, 쉽지 않을 겁니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self, nil, 'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_7')
	elseif choose_result == 3 then
		--가디언(left,mad,gauntlet_combo_attack)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'mad')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		--카이(right,smile,idle): 좋은 결의입니다! 용사님!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hero, self, nil, 'idle', 'smile', 'qc_sub_hidden_obelisk_s1_8')
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry(leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
			leader.Direction, game_string:GetString(stage.Name)))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	local mk99_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('mk99_battle_pos')
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec, false, mk99_pos)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero)
end

			--Mk.99(left,idle,idle)(...) slience 이모티콘 버블

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleHiddenRoomController')

-- EnterSection, ActivateQuest, ProgressSection, CompleteQuest 등의 함수들을 quest_util 에 들어가 있음
-- 이전 C# 에서 부모 함수에 구현 된 부분은 quest_util 로 빼놓았음
-- 생성자
function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller, _)
	-- CS Controller 로 OnEvent 를 받을수 있다.
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.starting_inner_progress = -1
	self.starting_grade = -1
	self.inter_section_params = {}

	-- scene_util 버전. 버전 올라갈 때 + N 해서 사용
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.stage_ended = false

	--region 오픈 이벤트

	self.stage_8_name = 'queencastle_1_8'

	self.room_zone_name = 'hidden_room_pre_room'

	self.in_room = false
	--endregion 오픈 이벤트

	self.sub_stage_name = 'queencastle_substage_hidden_room'

	self.get_fx_magic_circle = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_AppearIdle')
	end

	self.magic_circle_effects = {}
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	if stage.Name == self.stage_8_name then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	end

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if stage.Name == self.sub_stage_name then
		for _, effect in pairs(self.magic_circle_effects) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end

		self.magic_circle_effects = {}
	end

	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()
	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()
	self.sections = {

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleHiddenRoomPreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_8'

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		out_room = 1,
		in_room = 2,
		all_ignited = 3,
		interact_switch = 4,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.out_room

	self.candle = {
		count = 4,
		get_fo = function(this, index)
			return get_field_object('hidden_room_pre_candle_' .. index)
		end,
		ignition_dist = 1.3,
		ignite_fire = function(this, index)
			this:toggle_fire(index, true)

			if not this.ignited_hashset[index] then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '01_catch_fire_01',
					parent = this:get_fo(index),
					type_priority = 'gimmick',
					player_priority = 'object'
				})

				this.ignited_hashset[index] = true
				this.ignited_count = this.ignited_count + 1
			end
		end,
		toggle_fire = function(this, index, on)
			local fo = this:get_fo(index)

			fo.Transform:Find('fx').gameObject:SetActive(on)
		end,
		can_ignite = function(this, index, brazier)
			return not this.ignited_hashset[index] and
					vector_util.get_x0z(this:get_fo(index).Position - brazier.Position).sqrMagnitude <=
							this.ignition_dist * this.ignition_dist
		end,
		turn_all_off = function(this)
			for i = 1, this.count do
				this:toggle_fire(i, false)
			end
		end,
		is_all_ignited = function(this)
			return this.count == this.ignited_count
		end,
		ignited_hashset = {},
		ignited_count = 0,
	}

	self.get_flag = function()
		return get_field_object('hidden_room_pre_flag')
	end

	self.get_switch = function()
		return get_field_object('hidden_room_pre_switch')
	end

	self.get_switch_interactable = function()
		return get_field_object('hidden_room_pre_switch_interactable')
	end

	self.get_switch_interactable_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('hidden_room_pre_switch_interactable')
	end

	self.get_brazier = function()
		return get_field_object('hidden_room_pre_brazier')
	end

	self.room_zone_name = 'hidden_room_pre_room'

	self.current_check_ignite_req_id = 0
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_icon_util.pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.candle:turn_all_off()

	local switch_interactable_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('hidden_room_pre_switch_interactable')

	do
		local switch = self.get_switch()

		switch.Position = switch_interactable_pos + vector(0, 1.702, 0.218)
		switch.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(82, 180, 0)
	end

	do
		local flag = self.get_flag()

		flag.Position = switch_interactable_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.1)
		flag.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
	end

	do
		local switch_interactable = self.get_switch_interactable()

		switch_interactable.Position = switch_interactable_pos
		switch_interactable.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.out_room and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.room_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_room

		field_util.tint(nil, unity_color({ 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1 }), 0)

		start_coroutine(self.check_ignite_routine, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_room and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.room_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.out_room

		field_util.remove_tint(nil, 0)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.all_ignited and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_switch_interactable()) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interact_switch

		sp_util.start_scene(self.open_sub_stage_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_ignite_routine()
	self.current_check_ignite_req_id = self.current_check_ignite_req_id + 1

	local req_id = self.current_check_ignite_req_id

	local brazier = self.get_brazier()

	while not self.controller.stage_ended and req_id == self.current_check_ignite_req_id and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_room do

		for i = 1, self.candle.count do
			if self.candle:can_ignite(i, brazier) then
				self.candle:ignite_fire(i)
			end
		end

		if self.candle:is_all_ignited() then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.all_ignited
			sp_util.start_scene(self.switch_appear_scene, self)

			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:switch_appear_scene()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local flag = self.get_flag()
	local switch_interactable = self.get_switch_interactable()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_04')
	field_util.tint(nil, unity_color({ 0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1 }), 1)

	--카메라 shake 시작.
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 999)

	--가디언 surprise, idle, jump 1회
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump_async(knight, '01_player_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언 left, surprise, idle 1초
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언 right, surprise, idle 1초
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언 up으로 전환하면
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	scene_util.set_direction_by_args(knight,
			{ look_target = switch_interactable.Position })

	--카메라 shake 중지.
	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	--카메라 포커스 1초에 걸쳐 왼쪽의 깃발에게로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(switch_interactable.Position, 1)
	--
	--깃발이 shake하다가 위쪽으로 1칸 이동한다.
	do
		local duration = 0.7

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_break_wood_03')
		field_object_util.shake(flag, 0.03, duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)

		local start_pos = flag.Position
		local move_dist = 1.5

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(2, function(progress)
			local cur_dist = progress * move_dist

			flag.Position = start_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * cur_dist
		end)
	end

	--그 뒤에는 스위치가 보인다.

	--스위치에 서브스테이지 오픈 마커
	switch_interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(switch_interactable,
			switch_interactable.Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0) + vector(0, 1, -1))

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)
end

function local_class:open_sub_stage_scene()
	do
		local switch_interactable = self.get_switch_interactable()

		quest_icon_util.remove(switch_interactable)

		switch_interactable.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = 'queencastle_substage_hidden_room',
		is_navigation_bar = false
	})

	local flag = self.get_flag()

	local move_dist = 1.5
	local start_pos = flag.Position

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(2, function(progress)
		local cur_dist = progress * move_dist

		flag.Position = start_pos + unity_class.vector3.down * cur_dist
	end)

	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)
end

return local_class

	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local statue = self.get_statue()
	local statue_center_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(statue.Bounds.center)

	do
		local align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('knight_pos_1')
		local duration = 1

		coroutine.yield()

		user_party:PositionParty(align_pos, CS.Oak.Direction.Up, duration, 'linear')

		camera_util.move_async(statue_center_pos, duration)
	end

	--내레이션 박스
	--석상 아래 무언가 꽂을 수 있는 흠이 보인다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qc_hidden_room_1', })

	local insert_heart_rocket = false

	--하트로켓 없을 시
	--가디언 선택지(흰색)
	--돌아간다.
	--하트로켓 있을 시
	--가디언 선택지
	--하트로켓을 끼운다.(초록)
	--돌아간다.(흰색)
	if self:has_heartlocket() then
		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'qc_hidden_room_2', 'mercy', function()
				insert_heart_rocket = true
			end },
			{ 'qc_hidden_room_3', 'normal' }
		})
	else
		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'qc_hidden_room_3', 'normal' }
		})
	end

	if insert_heart_rocket then
		-- 하트 모양 로켓
		-- 가디언 up, release로 하트로켓 아이템 던진다.
