		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx_name = false })

		-- silver_heart_locket (qc_camilla_locket) 20966
		local item_id = 20966
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = knight.Position + vector(0, 1, 0),
			itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = false,
		})

		drop_item_util.move_item_async(item, statue_center_pos + vector(0, 0.5, -0.7), {
			angle = 1080,
			duration = 0.7,
			y_move = function(progress)
				return math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 1.2
			end
		})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_key_01')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--1초간 하트로켓이 알파 페이드 아웃으로 사라진다.
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(item, 0, 1)
		item:ConsumeComplete()

		-- 카메라 4초간 shake
		camera_util.shake(0.02, 999)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 3)

		local effect_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01',
			type_priority = 'event',
			player_priority = 'object'
		})

		--fx_cin_lightbeam_target 실행 0.5초 뒤
		self.get_fx_lightbeam():Instantiate(statue_center_pos)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--FX_Death_Light 실행 3초 뒤
		self.get_fx_death_light():Instantiate(statue_center_pos)
		wait_for_sec(2)

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(effect_sfx, 0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_shield_01')

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

		camera_util.cancel_shake()

		statue.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		--리리 동상 좌표 기준(피봇이 좌하단에 치우친 상태)
		--(0.5, 2.5, -1)

		-- 이후, 마법진이 생겨난다.
		self.controller:instantiate_magic_circle()

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white)

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)

		quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0,
				false, false, false)
	else
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none
	end
end

function local_class:has_heartlocket()
	local quest_id = self.quest_id
	local quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(quest_id)

	if quest ~= nil and quest_util.get_custom_state(quest, self.heart_locket_custom_key) == 1 then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

return local_class

function local_class:npc_setting()
	local hyo = self.get_hitoroid_hyo()
	local maika = self.get_hitoroid_maika()
	local bunnyta = self.get_hitoroid_bunnyta()
	local hitori = self.get_hitoroid_hitori()
	character_util.set_active_state(hitori, 'enabled')
	local hitori_first_key = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.hitori_android_first_key)
	local hitori_second_key = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.hitori_android_second_key)
	local hitori_third_key = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.hitori_android_third_key)
	local hitori_ending_key = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.hitori_android_ending_key)
	local door_count = 3
	character_util.add_color(hitori, hitori.Name,
			unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }), 1, 1)

	--스타피스 획득 여부
	if not star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name) then
		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false
	end

	if hitori_ending_key == 1 then
		--문 열어두기
		door_count = 2
		for i = 1, door_count do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.name_hitoroid_door[i], false))
		end
		character_util.set_position(hitori, self.get_marker_hitori_pos(3))
		scene_util.set_direction(hitori, 'left')
		character_util.add_listener(hitori, self.controller)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hitori)
		self.hitori_panic_stun_state = false
		return
	end
	-- 봇치가 기절하는 씬까지 본 경우
	if hitori_third_key == 1 then
		--문 열어두기
		door_count = 2
		for i = 1, door_count do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.name_hitoroid_door[i], false))
		end
		--봇치(right,tired,idle)(shake0.03)0.5초 간격으로 흔들림
		character_util.set_position(hitori, self.get_marker_hitori_pos(3))
		scene_util.set_direction(hitori, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'dead')
		character_util.add_listener(hitori, self.controller)
		start_coroutine(function()
			while self.hitori_panic_stun_state do
				character_util.shake(hitori, 0.03, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(1)
			end
		end)
		return
	end
	--외톨이 안드로이드를 삼인조가 데려갔을 때 (두번째 씬)
	if hitori_second_key == 1 then
		--문 열어두기
		for i = 1, door_count do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.name_hitoroid_door[i], false))
		end
		--오른쪽 그리드 내부 봇치(right,tired,sleep) 망치,바니,메이드(left,idle,idle) 도어 내려와 있음
		character_util.set_position(hitori, self.get_marker_hitori_pos(3))
		character_util.set_position(hyo, self.get_marker_hyo_pos(2))
		character_util.set_position(maika, self.get_marker_maika_pos(2))
		character_util.set_position(bunnyta, self.get_marker_bunnyta_pos(2))
		scene_util.set_direction(hyo, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction(maika, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction(bunnyta, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction(hitori, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'sleep_deep')
		scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'prostrate')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hyo)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maika)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bunnyta)
		return
	end
	if self.star_piece_effect == nil then
		self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect_pool():Instantiate(hitori.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, hitori.Transform)
	end
	--아직 스타피스 이벤트를 보지 않았기 때문에 꺼주기
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = true
	--외톨이를 조우 했었는 가?(1이면 조우했다)
	if hitori_first_key == 1 then
		self.spying_event_state = true
		local npcs_pos_offset = vector(10, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(hyo, self.get_marker_hyo_pos(1) + npcs_pos_offset)
		character_util.set_position(maika, self.get_marker_maika_pos(1) + npcs_pos_offset)
		character_util.set_position(bunnyta, self.get_marker_bunnyta_pos(1) + npcs_pos_offset)
		scene_util.set_direction(hyo, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction(maika, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction(bunnyta, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hyo)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(maika)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bunnyta)
		--외톨이 안드로이드 패닉 상태 설정
		start_coroutine(function()
			character_util.set_position(hitori, self.get_marker_hitori_pos(2), false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'tired')
			scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'walk')
			local hitori_start_pos = hitori.Position
			local panic_walk_pos_list = {
				hitori_start_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
				hitori_start_pos + vector(2, 0, -1.5),
				hitori_start_pos + vector(2, 0, 0),
				hitori_start_pos
			}
			while self.hitori_panic_state do
				wp_util.move(hitori, panic_walk_pos_list, nil, 2)
				wait_for_sec(1)
				--어떡하지…
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hitori, { key = 'qc_hitori_android_9' })
				if self.hitori_panic_state == false then
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(hitori)
					break
				end
				wait_for_sec(0.9)
				--들어가야 하는데…
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(hitori, { key = 'qc_hitori_android_10' })
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end)
	else
		--한번도 못 만났을 때
		--해당 표시해둔 곳에 봇치(down,sing,sing2)스타피스 이펙트 (계단 중앙에 서서 못지나가도록)
		--NowList: rifle_idle로 변경
		character_util.set_position(hitori, self.get_marker_hitori_pos(1))
		scene_util.set_direction(hitori, 'down')
		scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'sing')
		scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'sing2')
		self.hitori_origin_hitbox_size = hitori.Hitbox.size
		character_util.add_listener(hitori, self.controller)
		hitori.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1, 1, 1.2))
	end
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))

	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
	if self.character_thunder_player_effect ~= nil then
		self.character_thunder_player_effect:Dispose()

	end
	if self.cloud_thunder_effect ~= nil then

		self.cloud_thunder_effect = nil
	end
	if self.hitori_shadow_android ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.hitori_shadow_android)
		self.hitori_shadow_android = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:hitoroid_ending_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
	--봇치 인터랙트 시
	local hitori = self.get_hitoroid_hitori()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	wp_util.move(leader, hitori.Position + vector(-1,0,0), 4, nil,{last_direction = 'right'})
	wp_util.move_async(self.get_hero_ai(), hitori.Position + vector(-2,0,0), 4, nil,{last_direction = 'right'})
	if not (quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.controller.hitori_android_ending_key) == 1) then
		--봇치(right,tired,dead)(shake 0 .03) 1초 후 (get)포즈로 기상
		self.hitori_panic_stun_state = false
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(hitori, 'right', 1, nil, true)
		character_util.stop_shake(hitori)

		--봇치(left,surprise,idle)(jump1회): 아!
		scene_util.set_direction(hitori, 'left')
		scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'idle')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hitori, 'qc_hitori_android_42')

		--봇치(left,scared,idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'scared')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		--봇치(left,scared,cast): 사… 사람!
		scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'cast')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hitori, 'qc_hitori_android_43')
		scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'idle')

		--봇치(left,damaged,idle)(shake0.03): 아, 아무리 그래도.
		character_util.shake(hitori, 0.03, 9999)
		scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'damaged')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hitori, 'qc_hitori_android_44')

		--봇치(left,attack,cast): 이, 이대로는 아무것도 할 수 없습니다!
		scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'attack')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hitori, 'qc_hitori_android_45')
		scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'idle')

		--봇치(left,tired,idle)(shake0.03): 저… 저저저 저기.
		scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'tired')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hitori, 'qc_hitori_android_46')
		character_util.stop_shake(hitori)
	end


	--봇치(left,damaged,idle)(shake 0.03) 1초
	scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'damaged')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	--(right,tired,cast)0.5초 (down) 0.5초 (right) 0.5초

	scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(hitori, self, 'cast')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(hitori, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(hitori, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--봇치(left,attack,idle)(shout 말풍선): 저… 저랑!!

	scene_util.set_emotion(hitori, self, 'attack')

--오브젝트를 든 상태로 진행 해야하는 씬이 필요해서 만들어진 함수
function local_class:start_scene_without_throwing(func, ...)
	local args = { ... }
	local routine = function()
		-- 이전 리더에 대한 정보를 미리 캐싱해둬야 해제가 가능함
		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		sp_util.enter_scene({ release_hold = false })

		yield_return_func(func, table.unpack(args))

		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)
	end

	return start_coroutine(routine)
end

local local_class = newclass('LeafFairyComicsSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = LeafFairyComics @
		Comment = LeafFairyComics 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_4'

	-- npc
	self.get_leaf_fairy = function()
		return get_character('sub_leaf_fairy')
	end

	self.get_hero_ai = function()
		return get_character('hero_ai')
	end

	-- field_object
	self.get_sub_leaf_fairy_comics = function(idx)
		return get_field_object('sub_leaf_fairy_comics_' .. idx)
	end

	-- marker
	self.get_comics_pos = function(idx)
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_leaf_fairy_comics_pos_' .. idx)
	end

	-- 만화책 id
	self.comics = {
		quest_id = 355,
		obj_data = {},
		id = {
			20967,
			20968,
			20969,
		},
		state_key = {
			'comics_state_key_1',
			'comics_state_key_2',
			'comics_state_key_3',
		},
		item = {},
		item_get_count = 0
	}

	self.wait_before_get_comics = false

	self.section_state = {
		first_interact = 1,
		one_line_interact = 2,
		collect_interact = 3,
		done = 4
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.first_interact
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_item_get_event()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_item_get_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent))

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.comics.obj_data[1]) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.comics_get_scene, self, 1)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.comics.obj_data[2]) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.comics_get_scene, self, 2)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.comics.obj_data[3]) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.comics_get_scene, self, 3)
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_leaf_fairy()) then
		if self.current_state == self.section_state.first_interact then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.first_leaf_fairy_scene, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.collect_interact then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.collect_leaf_fairy_scene, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if self.wait_before_get_comics then
		for idx = 1, 3 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Getter, get_party_leader()) and e.Item.ItemId == self.comics.id[idx] then
				start_coroutine(self.comics_get_event, self, idx)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:pre_setting()
	--아오바(left,sleep,sleep) 상태로 되어 있다.
	local leaf_fairy = self.get_leaf_fairy()
	local leaf_fairy_start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_leaf_fairy_pos_1')
	character_util.set_position(leaf_fairy, leaf_fairy_start_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(leaf_fairy, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'eat')
	character_util.add_listener(leaf_fairy, self.controller)

	local off_set = {
		vector(0, 0.7, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0),
	}
	local drop_item_setting = function(comics_num)
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = self.get_comics_pos(comics_num) + off_set[comics_num],
			itemid = self.comics.id[comics_num],
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			skip_text = false
		})

		return item
	end

	self.comics.obj_data = {
		self.get_sub_leaf_fairy_comics(1),
		self.get_sub_leaf_fairy_comics(2),
		self.get_sub_leaf_fairy_comics(3),
	}

	local progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.comics.quest_id)
	for idx = 1, 3 do
		local state = quest_util.get_custom_state(progress, self.comics.state_key[idx])

		local item = drop_item_setting(idx)
		table.insert(self.comics.item, item)

		if state ~= 1 then
			self.comics.obj_data[idx].Position = self.get_comics_pos(idx)
		else
			item.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self.comics.item_get_count = self.comics.item_get_count + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:comics_get_scene(comics_num)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.wait_before_get_comics = true

	--만화책 획득 이벤트 스펙
	--인터랙트 시 가디언 보는 방향으로 eat
	character_util.set_side_direction(leader)

	local eat_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = leader,
		loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc',
	})
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sound)

	--스프라이트가 빨려들어가는 이벤트와 함께 책 획득
	self.comics.item[comics_num].ConsumeTarget = leader
	self.comics.item[comics_num]:Fly()

	--getitemevent
	--아이템이 습득 되는 시간동안 기다림
	while self.wait_before_get_comics do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.comics.quest_id)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(progress, self.comics.state_key[comics_num], 1)
	self.comics.obj_data[comics_num].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:comics_get_event(comics_num)
	screen_util.item_get_event(
			'qc_comics_' .. comics_num,
			'qc_comics_' .. comics_num .. '_title',
			'qc_comics_' .. comics_num .. '_sub_title',
			'qc_comics_' .. comics_num .. '_desc'
	)
	self.comics.obj_data[comics_num].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	--아오바가 특정 스테이트 일 경우 조건 처리
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.one_line_interact then
		character_util.add_listener(self.get_leaf_fairy(), self.controller)
		self.current_state = self.section_state.collect_interact
	end

	-- 만화책을 얻을 때 마다 카운트 하나씩 증가
	self.comics.item_get_count = self.comics.item_get_count + 1

	self.wait_before_get_comics = false
end

function local_class:first_leaf_fairy_scene()
	local leaf_fairy = self.get_leaf_fairy()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

	party_util.align_party(leaf_fairy.Position, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	--아오바(left,sleep,sleep) 상태로 되어 있다.

	loop_sfx:Stop()
	--아오바(left,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(leaf_fairy, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(leaf_fairy)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leaf_fairy, true)

	--아오바(left,tired,release): $name, 너구나!
	scene_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'release')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_1')
	character_util.remove_anim(leaf_fairy)

	--카이(right,attack,cast)(jump1회):오, 이분도 용사님과 아는 사이신가 보군요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(hero_ai, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, 'cast')
	character_util.normal_jump(hero_ai, true)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_2')

	--카이(right,attack,release):이곳은 위험하니 빨리 중앙 제어실로 대피해주세요!
	scene_util.set_anim(hero_ai, self, 'release')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(hero_ai, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_3')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hero_ai)

	--아오바(left,tired,bomb_idle):안돼, 난 여기 한발자국도 못 움직여.
	scene_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_4')

	--아오바(left,tired,release): 안드로이드한테 쫓기다가 여기서 내가 제일 아끼는 만화책 세 권을 잃어버렸단 말이야.
	scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'release')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_5')

	--아오바(left,tired,bomb_idle): 혹시 오는길에 만화책 못봤어? 봤으면 좀 가져다 줄래?
	scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_6')

	--아오바(left,tired,release): 난 이 주변을 좀 더 찾아 볼게.
	scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'release')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_7')

	--이 후 아오바는 (left,tired,eat) 상태로 상단 대사 원 라인이 된다.
	scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'eat')

	if self.comics.item_get_count == 0 then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(leaf_fairy, self.controller)
		leaf_fairy.Interactable.Talk = 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_7'
		self.current_state = self.section_state.one_line_interact
	elseif self.comics.item_get_count > 0 then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.collect_interact
	end
end

function local_class:collect_leaf_fairy_scene()
	local leaf_fairy = self.get_leaf_fairy()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hero_ai = self.get_hero_ai()

	--만화책을 다 얻지 못했을 경우
	if self.comics.item_get_count < 3 then
		--아오바 (left,smile,sing)(jump1회) : 앗! 벌써 {0}권 이나 찾아온 거야?
		party_util.align_party(leaf_fairy.Position, 'left', 1, 'linear')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'sing')
		character_util.normal_jump(leaf_fairy, true)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, { 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_8', self.comics.item_get_count })

		--아오바 (left,smile,release) :조금만 더 찾아오면 되겠어!
		scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'release')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_9')
		scene_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy, self, 'tired')
		scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'eat')
		return
	else
		--만화책을 다 모아왔을 경우
		--기존 정렬위치에서 (left)로 한칸 더 가서 정렬
		party_util.align_party(leaf_fairy.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'linear')

		--아오바(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 오, 벌써 세 권을 다 모아온 거야?
		character_util.remove_anim(leaf_fairy)
		character_util.normal_jump(leaf_fairy)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_10')

		--만화책을 까는 연출과 획득하는 연출은 해당 레퍼런스와 동일하게 연출
		local off_set = {
			vector(1, 0, 1),
			vector(1, 0, 0),
			vector(1, 0, -1),
		}
		local item_group = {}
		for i = 1, #off_set do
			local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = leader.Position,
				target = leader.Position + off_set[i],
				itemid = self.comics.id[i],
				notforinven = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				skip_text = false
			})
			table.insert(item_group, item)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--아오바(left,smile,eat) 1초
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
		scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'eat')

		for i = 1, #item_group do
			item_group[i].ConsumeTarget = leaf_fairy
			item_group[i]:Fly()
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		eat_sfx:Stop()

		--아오바(left,smile,idle) : 좋아, 다행히 상태에 문제는 없네.
		character_util.remove_anim(leaf_fairy)
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_11')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		--아오바(left,idle,question): 안드로이드 녀석들이 조금 돌려본 거 같긴 하지만…
		character_util.remove_anim(leaf_fairy)
		scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_12')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		--아오바(left,awesome,success): 정말 고마워! 그럼 이제 그 제어실인가로 갈게!
		scene_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy, self, 'awesome')
		scene_util.set_anim(leaf_fairy, self, 'success')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_13')
		character_util.remove_anim(leaf_fairy)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leaf_fairy, self, 'smile')

		--아오바 이동속도 1로 해당 경로로 이동 아오바가 빨간색존에 들어오면 가디언 카이(down)방향 빨간색존을 다시 나가면 (left)방향
		wp_util.move(leaf_fairy, {
			leaf_fairy.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			leaf_fairy.Position + vector(-4, 0, -1),
		}, 1)
		wait_for_sec(3)

		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'down')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)

		wait_for_sec(2)

		scene_util.set_direction(hero_ai, 'left')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--이동중 아오바 표정 (smile)
		--아오바(left,smile,idle): 아 그래!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_14')
		scene_util.set_direction(leaf_fairy, 'right')

		--아오바(right,smile,idle) 상태 그대로 스타피스를 자신 한칸위로 던진다.
		local star_piece = get_field_object('leaf_fairy_star_piece')
		star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, leaf_fairy.Position, leaf_fairy.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))

		wait_for_sec(3)

		--아오바(right,smile,bomb_idle): 그거 가져, 잃어버린 만화책을 찾다가 발견한 거야.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leaf_fairy, 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_15')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		--걸어나가면서 대사 : 이제야 누워서 편하게 만화를 볼 수 있겠어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(leaf_fairy, { key = 'qc_sub_leaf_fairy_comics_16', skip = false })
		wp_util.move_async(leaf_fairy, leaf_fairy.Position + vector(-6, 0, 0), 1)

		character_util.set_position(leaf_fairy, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leaf_fairy)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(leaf_fairy, self.controller)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
	end
end

return local_class

	self.resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resource_holder, 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/effects', 'theatre_flyout_c16', function(prefab)
				self.flyout_root = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.flyout_root.transform.position = self.flyout_position
			end)

	-- 카메라 세팅
	self.flyout_camera = self.flyout_root.transform:Find('main_camera'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	self.flyout_camera.orthographicSize = stage_camera:GetDefaultSize()
	self.camera_base_pos = self.flyout_camera.transform.localPosition
	self.camera_shake = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()

	-- 에바 세팅
	self.cap_trans = self.flyout_root.transform:Find('theatre_flyout/cap_outer')
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.cap_trans.transform, 'SpecialEvents')

	local cap_resource = CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance.UseKongResources and 'cap_kong' or 'cap'
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resource_holder, 'theatres/flyout_sky', cap_resource, function(prefab)
				self.cap_inner_trans = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab, self.cap_trans).transform
			end)
	self.cap_trail = self.cap_inner_trans.transform:Find('fx').gameObject
	self.cap_spine = self.cap_inner_trans:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
	self.cap_renderer = self.cap_spine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	self.cap_color = CS.Oak.ColorOverrideCalculator()
	self.cap_fade_color = CS.Oak.ColorOverrideCalculator()
	self.cap_mpb = CS.UnityEngine.MaterialPropertyBlock()
	self.cap_squish = CS.Oak.SquishCalculator()

	-- 카밀라 세팅
	self.queen_trans = self.flyout_root.transform:Find('theatre_flyout/queen_outer')
	self.queen_inner_trans = self.flyout_root.transform:Find('theatre_flyout/queen_outer/queen')
	self.queen_trail = self.queen_inner_trans.transform:Find('fx').gameObject
	self.queen_spine = self.queen_inner_trans:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
	self.queen_renderer = self.queen_spine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	self.queen_color = CS.Oak.ColorOverrideCalculator()
	self.queen_fade_color = CS.Oak.ColorOverrideCalculator()
	self.queen_mpb = CS.UnityEngine.MaterialPropertyBlock()
	self.queen_squish = CS.Oak.SquishCalculator()

	-- 공주와 기사 그륩 세팅
	self.main_group_trans = self.flyout_root.transform:Find('theatre_flyout/group_outer')
	self.main_group_inner_trans = self.flyout_root.transform:Find('theatre_flyout/group_outer/group_p_k')

	-- 공주 세팅
	self.princess_trans = self.main_group_inner_trans.transform:Find('princess')
	self.princess_spine = self.princess_trans:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
	self.princess_trail = self.princess_trans.transform:Find('fx').gameObject

	-- 기사 세팅

	self.knight_trans = self.main_group_inner_trans.transform:Find(my_knight_gender)
	self.knight_spine = self.knight_trans:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
	self.knight_renderer = self.knight_spine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	-- 검은 마법사 (베스) 세팅

	self.dark_magician_spine = self.dark_magician_trans:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))

	self.flyout_background.skeleton.G = 0

	self.feather_list = {}

		local bird = self.bird_container:Find('bird' .. i):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
		local feather = self.flyout_root.transform:Find('theatre_flyout/FX_feather' .. (i - 1))

		table.insert(self.bird_list, bird)
		table.insert(self.bird_trans_list, bird.transform)
		table.insert(self.feather_list, feather)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(fallen_queen, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(fallen_queen, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_fallen_queen_pos_1'))
	character_util.set_active_state(fallen_queen, 'enabled')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(fallen_queen, 0, 0)

	field:Darken(self.darken_key, 1, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	fallen_queen.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent.Instance)

function local_class:opening_event()
	local queen_base_pos = vector(3.661, -0.33, 0)
	local cap_base_pos = vector(3.3, 0.88, 0)
	local main_group_base_pos = vector(2.719, -0.5, 0)
	local dark_magician_base_pos = vector(-3.44, -0.75, 0)

	camera_util.move_async(self.flyout_position, 0)
	stage_camera.Enabled = false

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 등장 씬
	self:flyout_appear_event(queen_base_pos, cap_base_pos, main_group_base_pos)

	-- 암흑 마법사 등장 씬
	self:appear_dark_magician(dark_magician_base_pos)

	-- 대사 후 에바 추락
	self:fall_captain()

	-- 기사 공주 추락
	self:fall_knight_and_princess()

	-- 카밀라 베스 대화 연출
	self:talk_dark_magician_and_queen()

	-- 군단장 카밀라 이벤트
	self:fallen_queen_monologue()

	-- 컷씬 재생
	do
		local media_path_generator = function()
			local region_postfix = ''

			if music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode == 'ja_kong' then
				region_postfix = '_kong'
			elseif music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage ~= 'ko' then
				region_postfix = '_global'
			end

			return 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/video/chapter16_opening' .. region_postfix .. '.$codec.mp4'
		end

		local subtitle_path_generator = function()
			local region_postfix = ''

			if music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode == 'ja_kong' then
				region_postfix = '_kong'
			elseif music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage ~= 'ko' then
				region_postfix = '_global'
			end

			return 'ondemand/v2_65_queencastle/theatres/cast:opening_srt_1' .. region_postfix
		end

		local media_path = media_path_generator()
		local subtitle_path = subtitle_path_generator()

		screen_util.play_media(media_path, { subtitle_path = subtitle_path })
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 이후 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:flyout_appear_event(queen_base_pos, cap_base_pos, main_group_base_pos)
	local appear_time_scale = 0.7

	local calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()
	calculator:SetParameters(10, 10, 0, 0)
	calculator:SetElasticity(0.6)
	calculator:ScaleTime(1.6 * appear_time_scale)

	local max_distance = calculator:GetPinnacleDistance()
	local target_distance = max_distance * 0.9

	local x_distance = 8.0
	local x_move_duration = 2.25 / appear_time_scale
	local x_done = false

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')

	self.queen_trans.localPosition = queen_base_pos + vector(-x_distance, -target_distance, 0)
	self.cap_trans.localPosition = cap_base_pos + vector(-x_distance, -target_distance, 0)
	self.main_group_trans.localPosition = main_group_base_pos + vector(-x_distance, -target_distance, 0)

	self.queen_trans.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.cap_trans.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.knight_spine.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.princess_spine.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self:set_animation(self.knight_spine, 1, '[emo]shock', true)
	self:set_animation(self.queen_spine, 1, '[emo]idle', true)
	self:set_animation(self.queen_spine, 0, 'fly_side', true)

	local downward = false
	local downward_done = false
	local time_passed = 0

	while ((downward_done == false) and (downward == false)) or (x_done == false) do
		local deltaTime = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + deltaTime

		calculator:Proceed(deltaTime)
		local distance = calculator:GetDistance()

		if (downward == false) and (calculator:GetPinnacleProgress() >= 1) then
			if distance <= target_distance then
				distance = target_distance
				downward = true
				downward_done = true

				start_coroutine(self.flyout_scene_routine, self)
			end
		elseif downward_done then
			distance = target_distance
		end

		local extra_y_progress = time_passed / 0.3
		if extra_y_progress < 1 then
			distance = distance - (1 - extra_y_progress)
		end

		local x_progress = math.min(1, time_passed / x_move_duration)
		local x_movement = math.sin(x_progress * math.pi / 2 * 1.2)
				/ math.sin(math.pi / 2 * 1.2) * x_distance

		if x_progress >= 1 then
			x_progress = 1
			x_movement = x_distance
			x_done = true
		end

		self.queen_trans.localPosition = queen_base_pos + vector(-x_distance + x_movement, -target_distance + distance, 0)
		self.cap_trans.localPosition = cap_base_pos + vector(-x_distance + x_movement, -target_distance + distance, 0)
		self.main_group_trans.localPosition = main_group_base_pos + vector(-x_distance + x_movement, -target_distance + distance, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

	end

	self.queen_trans.localPosition = queen_base_pos
	self.cap_trans.localPosition = cap_base_pos
	self.main_group_trans.localPosition = main_group_base_pos
	-- 배경 페이드 인

	time_passed = 0

	local bg_fade_duration = 1
	local bg_speed = 1

	self:set_animation(self.knight_spine, 1, '[emo]scared', true)

	self.blizzard_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_03'
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', fade_in_time = 4 })
	while time_passed < bg_fade_duration do
		local progress = time_passed / bg_fade_duration

		self.flyout_background.skeleton.R = progress
		self.flyout_background.skeleton.G = progress
		self.flyout_background.skeleton.B = progress

		self.queen_trans.localPosition = queen_base_pos - vector(time_passed * bg_speed, 0, 0)
		self.cap_trans.localPosition = cap_base_pos - vector(time_passed * bg_speed, 0, 0)
		self.main_group_trans.localPosition = main_group_base_pos - vector(time_passed * bg_speed, 0, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.flyout_background.skeleton.R = 1
	self.flyout_background.skeleton.G = 1
	self.flyout_background.skeleton.B = 1

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 1
	, speaker_transform = self.cap_inner_trans, skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 2
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 3
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })
end

function local_class:appear_dark_magician(dark_magician_base_pos)
	local bird_y = -0.34

	self.bird_container.localPosition = vector(10, bird_y, 0)
	self.bird_container.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local bird_start_x = 10
	local bird_end_x = -4

	local time_passed = 0
	local bird_move_duration = 4.0

	local dm_time = 0.5
	local dm_time_tail = 0.1

	self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition = dark_magician_base_pos + vector(-10, 3, 0)
	self.dark_magician_spine.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local dm_start_pos = self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition

	local princess_reaction = false
	local birds_dead = false

	local bird_start_pos = {}
	for i = 1, #self.bird_trans_list do
		table.insert(bird_start_pos, self.bird_trans_list[i].localPosition)
	end

	local is_sfx_play = false

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bird_enter_01')
	while time_passed < bird_move_duration do
		local progress = time_passed / bird_move_duration

		local target_x = bird_start_x * (1 - progress) + bird_end_x * progress
		self.bird_container.localPosition = vector(target_x, bird_y, 0)
		for i = 1, #self.bird_trans_list do
			local factor = 1 + (i - 1) * 0.5
			local offset = math.sin(time_passed * factor) * (0.05 + 0.025 * (i - 1))
			self.bird_trans_list[i].localPosition = bird_start_pos[i] + vector(offset, offset, 0)
		end

		if (princess_reaction == false
				and (self.bird_container.localPosition.x - 2 < self.main_group_inner_trans.localPosition.x)) then
			princess_reaction = true
			self:set_animation(self.princess_spine, 0, 'fly_bird_side', true)
			self:set_animation(self.knight_spine, 1, '[emo]empty', true)
		end

		if time_passed > (bird_move_duration - dm_time - dm_time_tail) then
			if not is_sfx_play then
				is_sfx_play = true
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_shadow_beast_rush_01')
			end

			local dm_passed = time_passed - (bird_move_duration - dm_time - dm_time_tail)
			local dm_progress = math.min(dm_passed / dm_time, 1)
			local dm_progress_2 = math.sin(math.pi / 2 * 1.15 * dm_progress) / math.sin(math.pi / 2 / 1.15)

			if dm_progress_2 >= 0.8 and birds_dead == false then
				birds_dead = true
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_fire_02')
				start_coroutine(self.birds_death, self)
				self.is_camera_shake = true
				self.camera_shake:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo('nil', unity_class.vector3.forward, 0.2, 0.2, true))
			end

			self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition = dm_start_pos * (1 - dm_progress_2) + dark_magician_base_pos * dm_progress_2

			if dm_progress >= 1 then
				break
			end
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dark_magician_follow_01')

	self.is_dark_magician_floating = true

	self:set_animation(self.knight_spine, 1, '[emo]shock', true)
	self:set_animation(self.princess_spine, 1, '[emo]shock', true)
	self:set_animation(self.cap_spine, 1, '[emo]turn', true)
	self:set_animation(self.queen_spine, 1, '[emo]turn', true)

	time_passed = 0

	self.flyout_spark:SetActive(true)

	local bg_r = 0.5882
	local bg_g = 0.3803
	local bg_b = 0.5058

	self.blizzard_loop_sfx.Volume = 0.3
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_escape', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dark_magician_follow_01')
	while time_passed < 0.2 do
		local progress = time_passed / 0.2

		self.flyout_background.skeleton.R = (1 - progress) + bg_r * progress
		self.flyout_background.skeleton.G = (1 - progress) + bg_g * progress
		self.flyout_background.skeleton.B = (1 - progress) + bg_b * progress

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_camera_shake = false
	self.flyout_background.skeleton.R = bg_r
	self.flyout_background.skeleton.G = bg_g
	self.flyout_background.skeleton.B = bg_b
end

function local_class:birds_death()
	for i = 1, #self.bird_list do
		self:set_animation(self.bird_list[i], 0, 'dead_side', true)
		self.feather_list[i].position = self.bird_trans_list[i].position
		self.feather_list[i].gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	local start_pos = {}
	for i = 1, #self.bird_list do
		table.insert(start_pos, self.bird_trans_list[i].localPosition)
	end

	local x_speed_list = { -0.2, -1.2, 0.1, -1.4 }

	local fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()
	local h = 7
	fall:SetParameters(0, 10, h, 0)
	fall:ScaleTime(2.0)

	local time_passed = 0

	while fall:IsDone() == false do
		local delta_time = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		fall:Proceed(delta_time)
		time_passed = time_passed + delta_time

		for i = 1, #self.bird_list do
			self.bird_trans_list[i].localPosition = start_pos[i]
					+ vector(x_speed_list[i] * time_passed * 7, fall:GetDistance() - h, 0)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.bird_container.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:fall_captain()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 4
	, speaker_transform = self.cap_inner_trans, skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 5
	, speaker_transform = self.princess_trans, skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 6
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	self:set_animation(self.knight_spine, 1, '[emo]empty', false)
	self:set_animation(self.princess_spine, 1, '[emo]idle_chased', false)
	self:set_animation(self.queen_spine, 1, '[emo]idle', false)
	self:set_animation(self.cap_spine, 1, '[emo]empty', false)

	self.flyout_background.state:GetCurrent(0).TimeScale = 2
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1

	local start_r = self.flyout_background.skeleton.R
	local start_g = self.flyout_background.skeleton.G
	local start_b = self.flyout_background.skeleton.B

	local end_r = 0.5568
	local end_g = 0.19607
	local end_b = 0.2784

	while (time_passed < duration) do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.flyout_background.skeleton.R = start_r * (1 - progress) + end_r * progress
		self.flyout_background.skeleton.G = start_g * (1 - progress) + end_g * progress
		self.flyout_background.skeleton.B = start_b * (1 - progress) + end_b * progress

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_cast_magic_04', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	self:set_animation(self.dark_magician_spine, 0, 'attack_loop_side', true)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	local offset = vector(0.3, 0, 0.4)
	local diff = self.cap_trans.localPosition - vector(0, 0.3, 0)
			- (self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition + offset)
	diff.z = 0
	diff:Normalize()

	local rad = math.acos(diff.x)
	if diff.y < 0 then
		rad = rad * -1
	end

	local deg = rad * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg - 90

	offset.y = 0.1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_devil_trigger_on_01')
	music_player:PlayVoice(5, 0, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Damaged1)

	self.flyout_laser.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-deg, unity_class.vector3.up)
			* unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
	self.flyout_laser.position = self.dark_magician_trans.position + offset
	self.flyout_laser.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.get_fx_hit_projectile():Instantiate(self.cap_inner_trans.position
	, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.cap_inner_trans)
	self.is_cap_alive = false

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	sfx:Stop()
	self.flyout_laser_hit.position = self.cap_trans.position
	self.flyout_laser_hit.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.cap_trail:SetActive(false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')

	local damage_pulse_color = unity_class.color(1, 0.396, 0.396, 1)
	local damage_pulse_fade_color = unity_class.color(1, 0.2274, 0, 1)
	local damage_pulse_frequency = 1
	local damage_pulse_time = 0.25
	local damage_pulse_anchor = 0.2
	local target_intensity = 0.8

	self.cap_color:AddPulse(nil, damage_pulse_color, damage_pulse_time, target_intensity
	, damage_pulse_anchor, damage_pulse_frequency)

	self.cap_fade_color:AddPulse(nil, damage_pulse_fade_color, damage_pulse_time, target_intensity
	, damage_pulse_anchor, damage_pulse_frequency)

	local damage_scale_broad = 1.2
	local damage_scale_narrow = 0.8
	local damage_scale_frequency = 1
	local damage_scale_time = 0.3
	local damage_scale_first_anchor = 0.2
	local damage_scale_second_anchor = 0.5

	self.cap_squish:Squish(damage_scale_broad, damage_scale_narrow, damage_scale_frequency
	, damage_scale_time, damage_scale_first_anchor, damage_scale_second_anchor)

	self:set_animation(self.cap_spine, 0, 'fail', true)
	self.cap_spine.state:ClearTrack(1)

	self.is_camera_shake = true
	self.camera_shake:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo('nil', unity_class.vector3.forward, 0.2, 0.2, true))

	local mod_key = 'fall_captain'
	time_util.mod(mod_key, 0.1)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	time_util.unmod(mod_key)

	self:set_animation(self.knight_spine, 1, '[emo]shock', false)
	self:set_animation(self.princess_spine, 1, '[emo]shock', false)
	self:set_animation(self.queen_spine, 1, '[emo]turn', false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.queen_trans, { key = self.string_key .. 7
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	local initial_h = 12
	local x_offset = 4
	local start_pos = self.cap_trans.localPosition
	local fall_duration = 1

	local calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()
	calculator:SetParameters(6.5, 10, initial_h, 0)
	calculator:ScaleTime(1.6)

	local laser_off = false

	time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < fall_duration do
		if laser_off == false and time_passed > 0.3 then
			self:set_animation(self.dark_magician_spine, 0, 'run_side', true)
			self.flyout_laser.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.flyout_laser_hit.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			laser_off = true
		end

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt
		calculator:Proceed(dt)

		local progress = time_passed / fall_duration

		self.cap_trans.localPosition = start_pos + vector(-x_offset * progress, calculator:GetDistance() - initial_h, 0)
		self.cap_inner_trans.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(time_passed * 720, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		if progress > 0.35 then
			local scale_progress = (progress - 0.35) / 0.65

			self.cap_inner_trans.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 - scale_progress)
			self.cap_spine.skeleton.R = (1 - scale_progress)
			self.cap_spine.skeleton.G = (1 - scale_progress)
			self.cap_spine.skeleton.B = (1 - scale_progress)
			self.cap_spine.skeleton.A = (1 - scale_progress)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_camera_shake = false
	self.cap_trans.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(3)
end

		if self.main_group_trans.localPosition.y < -6 then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.main_group_trans.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		time_util.unmod(mod_key)
	end
end

function local_class:talk_dark_magician_and_queen()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local function remove_queen_tint()
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 1.25

		local start_r = self.queen_spine.skeleton.R
		local start_g = self.queen_spine.skeleton.G
		local start_b = self.queen_spine.skeleton.B

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			self.queen_spine.skeleton.R = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_r, 1, progress)
			self.queen_spine.skeleton.G = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_g, 1, progress)
			self.queen_spine.skeleton.B = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_b, 1, progress)

		self.queen_spine.skeleton.G = 1
		self.queen_spine.skeleton.B = 1

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 암흑 마법사 : 캔터베리의 여왕, 카밀라…

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. '9_1'
	, speaker_transform = self.dark_magician_trans, skip = true, offset = dark_magician_bubble_offset })

	-- 암흑 마법사 : 정화의 심판을 받아들여라!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 8 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. '9_2'
	, speaker_transform = self.dark_magician_trans, skip = true, offset = dark_magician_bubble_offset })

	-- 암흑 마법사 2초 간 그림처럼 이동 (애니메이션 run)
	self:set_animation(self.dark_magician_spine, 0, 'run_side', true)
	local start_pos = self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition
	local end_pos = self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition + unity_class.vector3.right * 3
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 2

	local is_remove_queen_tint = false

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if is_remove_queen_tint == false and time_passed >= 1 then
			is_remove_queen_tint = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
			start_coroutine(remove_queen_tint)
		end

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 암흑 마법사 이동 시작 2초 후 queen 대사
	self:set_animation(self.dark_magician_spine, 0, 'idle_side', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 카밀라 : 역시 듣던 대로 괜찮은 실력이군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 10
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	self:set_animation(self.queen_spine, 1, '[emo]turn', true)
	self:set_animation(self.dark_magician_spine, 1, '[emo]mad', true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	start_coroutine(function()
		local jump_time_passed = 0
		local jump_duration = 0.3
		local height = 0.5

		local start_y = self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition.y
		while jump_time_passed < jump_duration do
			jump_time_passed = jump_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(jump_time_passed / jump_duration)
			local cur_y = start_y + math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition, cur_y)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition, start_y)
	end)

	-- 카밀라 : 제 13 군단장, 베스.
	self:dispose_blizzard_loop_sfx(4)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_throne_main', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 11
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	-- 암흑 마법사 : 네가 어떻게 내 이름을…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 12
	, speaker_transform = self.dark_magician_trans, skip = true, offset = dark_magician_bubble_offset })

	-- flyout_queen 이모션 idle로 설정
	self:set_animation(self.queen_spine, 1, '[emo]idle', true)

	-- 카밀라 : …전부 다 알고 있었습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 13
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	-- 카밀라 : 당신들, 인베이더가 캔터베리 왕국을 침략한다는 것을.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 14
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	-- 카밀라 : 그리고 이 모든 것이 당신들의 지도자인 구세주의 뜻이라는 것을.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 15
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	-- 암흑 마법사 왔던 방향으로 1초간 0.5 정도 이동
	time_passed = 0
	duration = 1
	start_pos = self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition
	end_pos = self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 암흑 마법사 : 너, 도대체 무슨…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 16
	, speaker_transform = self.dark_magician_trans, skip = true, offset = dark_magician_bubble_offset })

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카밀라 : 당신께 한 가지 부탁을 드리겠습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 17
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	-- 카밀라 : 저를…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 18
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	-- 2초간 카메라 카밀라에게 이동 (대기)
	time_passed = 0
	duration = 2
	start_pos = self.flyout_camera.transform.localPosition
	local offset = self.queen_inner_trans.localPosition.y
	end_pos = vector(self.queen_trans.localPosition.x, 10, self.queen_trans.localPosition.y + offset - 0.2)
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		self.flyout_camera.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.flyout_camera.transform.localPosition = end_pos

	-- 0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- flyout_queen 이모션 turn으로 설정
	self:set_animation(self.queen_spine, 1, '[emo]turn', true)

	-- 카밀라 : 구세주에게 안내해 주세요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = self.string_key .. 19
	, speaker_transform = self.queen_inner_trans, skip = true })

	-- 카밀라를 제외한 배경과 암흑 마법사 2초간 알파 페이드 아웃
	time_passed = 0
	duration = 2

	local start_r = self.flyout_background.skeleton.R
	local start_g = self.flyout_background.skeleton.G
	local start_b = self.flyout_background.skeleton.B
	self.flyout_spark:SetActive(false)
	self.dark_magician_aura:SetActive(false)

	-- 2초간 배경 및 암흑 마법사 페이드 아웃
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.flyout_background.skeleton.R = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_r, 0, progress)
		self.flyout_background.skeleton.G = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_g, 0, progress)
		self.flyout_background.skeleton.B = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_b, 0, progress)

		self.dark_magician_spine.skeleton.R = 1 - progress
		self.dark_magician_spine.skeleton.G = 1 - progress
		self.dark_magician_spine.skeleton.B = 1 - progress

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	-- 2초간 flyout_queen 검은색으로 틴트시킴
	time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.queen_spine.skeleton.R = 1 - progress
		self.queen_spine.skeleton.G = 1 - progress
		self.queen_spine.skeleton.B = 1 - progress
		self.queen_spine.skeleton.A = 1 - progress

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	self.queen_trans.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 공중 연출 씬 dispose
	self:dispose_flyout_scene()
end

function local_class:fairy_move_routine()
	local fairy = self.get_fairy()
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fairy, false)

	local fairy_marker_name = 's1_fairy_pos_'
	local fait_pos_1 = field_util.get_marker_pos(fairy_marker_name .. 1)
	character_util.set_position(fairy, fait_pos_1, true)
	scene_util.set_direction(fairy, 'left')
	character_util.set_active_state(fairy, 'enabled')

	-- 속도 2로 1번 경로대로 이동
	local fait_pos_2 = field_util.get_marker_pos(fairy_marker_name .. 2)
	local radius_x = 2.5
	wp_util.move(fairy, fait_pos_2 + vector(radius_x, -0.6, 0)
	, nil, 6, { y_mode = 'flying', last_direction = 'left' })
	wait_for_sec(3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fairy_02')
	wait_for_sec(3)

	while not self.is_stage_end do
		if self.cur_fairy_move_state >= self.fairy_move_state.first_point then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 요정 2번 경로 이동 시작
	-- 가로로 5, 세로로 3칸의 타원형을 그리며 이동
	local center = fait_pos_2
	local cur_angle = 0
	local radius_z = 2
	local y = fairy.Position.y

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fairy_04')
	while not self.is_stage_end and cur_angle < 3.05 do
		-- 매 프레임마다 카밀라 위치(중심점)를 바라보도록 설정
		fairy.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(fait_pos_2 - fairy.Position)
		cur_angle = cur_angle + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local pos = vector(center.x + math.cos(cur_angle) * radius_x
		, y, center.z + -math.sin(cur_angle) * radius_z)
		character_util.set_position(fairy, pos, true)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(fairy, 'right')

	while not self.is_stage_end do
		if self.cur_fairy_move_state >= self.fairy_move_state.leave_point then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fairy_05')
	wp_util.move_async(fairy, field_util.get_marker_pos(fairy_marker_name .. 3)
	, 2, nil, { y_mode = 'flying', last_direction = 'left' })

	self.cur_fairy_move_state = self.fairy_move_state.move_end

	character_util.set_active_state(fairy, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:flyout_scene_routine()
	self.is_run_flyout_routine = true

	local floating_time_passed = 0
	local dark_magician_floating_time_passed = 0
	local dark_magician_base_pos = vector(-3.44, -0.75, 0)

	while self.is_run_flyout_routine do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- calculator 연출
		self:calculator_char_spine(dt)

		-- 캐릭터 떠다니는 연출
		local floating_progress = math.min(1, floating_time_passed * 0.16666)
		local time_scale = 5.5 * (1 - floating_progress) + floating_progress

		if floating_time_passed >= math.pi then
			floating_time_passed = floating_time_passed + dt * time_scale
		else
			floating_time_passed = floating_time_passed + dt * 5.5
		end

		local magnitude = 0.5 * (1 - floating_progress) + 0.2 * floating_progress
		local offset = -math.sin(floating_time_passed) * magnitude

		if self.is_cap_alive then
			self.cap_inner_trans.localPosition = vector(0, offset, 0)
		end

		if self.is_queen_floating then
			self.queen_inner_trans.localPosition = vector(0, offset, 0)
			self.main_group_inner_trans.localPosition = vector(0, offset, 0)
		end

		if self.is_dark_magician_floating then
			dark_magician_floating_time_passed = dark_magician_floating_time_passed + dt
			offset = -math.sin(dark_magician_floating_time_passed) * 0.2
			self.dark_magician_trans.localPosition = dark_magician_base_pos + vector(0, offset, 0)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		floating_time_passed = floating_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
end

function local_class:calculator_char_spine(dt)
	-- 카메라
	if self.is_camera_shake then
		if self.camera_shake.IsActive then
			self.camera_shake:UpdateFrame(dt)
			self.flyout_camera.transform.localPosition = self.camera_base_pos + self.camera_shake.ShakeOffset
		else
			self.flyout_camera.transform.localPosition = self.camera_base_pos
		end
	end

	--region 에바
	if self.cap_color.IsActive then
		self.cap_color:UpdateFrame(dt)

		local color = self.cap_color.CurrentMaxColor
		local alpha = self.cap_color.CurrentMaxAlpha

		local c = unity_class.color.Lerp(unity_class.color.white, color, alpha)
		c.a = 1

		self.cap_spine.skeleton.R = c.r
		self.cap_spine.skeleton.G = c.g
		self.cap_spine.skeleton.B = c.b
	end

	if self.cap_fade_color.IsActive then
		self.cap_fade_color:UpdateFrame(dt)

		local color = self.cap_fade_color.CurrentMaxColor
		local alpha = self.cap_fade_color.CurrentMaxAlpha

		local c = unity_class.color.Lerp(unity_class.color.white, color, alpha)
		c.a = 1

		self.cap_mpb:SetFloat('_TextureFade', c.a)
		self.cap_mpb:SetColor('_FadeColor', c)

		self.cap_renderer:SetPropertyBlock(self.cap_mpb)
	end

	if self.cap_squish.IsActive then
		self.cap_squish:UpdateFrame(dt)
		local scale = vector(self.cap_squish.CurrentSquish.x, 1, self.cap_squish.CurrentSquish.y)
		self.cap_inner_trans.localScale = scale
	end
	--endregion

	--region 카밀라

	if self.queen_color.IsActive then
		self.queen_color:UpdateFrame(dt)

		local color = self.queen_color.CurrentMaxColor
		local alpha = self.queen_color.CurrentMaxAlpha

		local c = unity_class.color.Lerp(unity_class.color.white, color, alpha)
		c.a = 1

		self.queen_spine.skeleton.R = c.r
		self.queen_spine.skeleton.G = c.g
		self.queen_spine.skeleton.B = c.b
	end

	if self.queen_fade_color.IsActive then
		self.queen_fade_color:UpdateFrame(dt)

		local color = self.queen_fade_color.CurrentMaxColor
		local alpha = self.queen_fade_color.CurrentMaxAlpha

		local c = unity_class.color.Lerp(unity_class.color.white, color, alpha)
		c.a = 1

		self.queen_mpb:SetFloat('_TextureFade', c.a)
		self.queen_mpb:SetColor('_FadeColor', c)

		self.queen_renderer:SetPropertyBlock(self.queen_mpb)
	end

	if self.queen_squish.IsActive then
		self.queen_squish:UpdateFrame(dt)
		local scale = vector(self.queen_squish.CurrentSquish.x, 1, self.queen_squish.CurrentSquish.y)
		self.queen_inner_trans.localScale = scale
	end

	--endregion
end

local local_class = newclass('QueenCastleMainSection10')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenCastleMain @
		Comment = @
		Index = 9 @
		NextSections = 10 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_1'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		enter_queen_room = 2,
		search_handkerchief_1 = 3,
		search_handkerchief_2 = 4,
		show_fairy_1 = 5,
		show_fairy_2 = 6,
		show_last_handkerchief = 7,
		ending = 8,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.get_tanker = function() return get_character('tanker') end
	self.get_desert_slave = function() return get_character('desert_slave') end
	self.get_teatan_hero = function() return get_character('teatan_hero') end
	self.get_innuit = function() return get_character('innuit') end
	self.get_fairy = function(index) return get_character('s10_fairy_' .. index) end

	self.get_s5_start_pos = function() return field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_start') end
	self.get_handkerchief_pos = function(index) return field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_handkerchief_' .. index) end
	self.get_handkerchief_obj = function() return get_field_object('s10_handkerchief') end

	self.get_fx_reset = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object') end
	self.get_fx_magic_circle = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('MagicCircle_AppearIdle') end

	-- string key
	self.string_key = 'qc_main_s10_'

	self.stage_exit_name = 'exit_queencastle_1_8'

	self.handkerchief_count = 3
	self.handkerchief_list = nil
	self.getting_handkerchief = nil

	self.fairy_count = 2
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_reset()
	self.get_fx_magic_circle()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	-- 공주 손수건 세팅
	self.handkerchief_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.handkerchief_count - 1 do
		local handkerchief = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.get_handkerchief_pos(i)
		, itemid = 20018, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })
		table.insert(self.handkerchief_list, handkerchief)
	end

	self.fx_magic_circle = self.get_fx_magic_circle():Instantiate(
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_magic_circle_pos'))

	-- 먹을 손수건은 따로 세팅
	self.getting_handkerchief = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.get_handkerchief_pos(self.handkerchief_count)
	, itemid = 20018, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	-- 손수건 위치에 상호작용 가능하게
	local fo = self.get_handkerchief_obj()
	fo.Position = self.get_handkerchief_pos(self.handkerchief_count)
	fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.opening_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.fx_magic_circle ~= nil then
		self.fx_magic_circle:Dispose()
		self.fx_magic_circle = nil
	end

	if self.handkerchief_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.handkerchief_list do
			self.handkerchief_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.handkerchief_list = nil
	end

	if self.getting_handkerchief ~= nil then
		self.getting_handkerchief:ConsumeComplete()
		self.getting_handkerchief = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local handkerchief = self.get_handkerchief_obj()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, handkerchief)
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.ending then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_fallen_queen_meal_zone')
			and self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.none then
		-- 마빈 추격 시작
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_queen_room
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_queen_room, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's10_event_zone_1')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.enter_queen_room then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.search_handkerchief_1
		start_coroutine(self.enter_handkerchief_zone_1, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's10_event_zone_2')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.search_handkerchief_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.search_handkerchief_2
		start_coroutine(self.enter_handkerchief_zone_2, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's10_event_zone_3')
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_fairy_1 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_fairy_1
		start_coroutine(self.fly_fairy_1, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's10_event_zone_4')
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_fairy_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_fairy_2
		start_coroutine(self.fly_fairy_2, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's10_event_zone_5')
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_last_handkerchief then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.show_last_handkerchief
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
		local handkerchief = self.get_handkerchief_obj()
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(handkerchief)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 's10_event_grid')
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_last_handkerchief then
		quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name
		, field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_magic_circle_pos'), true)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 's10_event_grid')
			and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.show_last_handkerchief then
		quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name
		, get_field_object('secret_stair_1'), true)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:opening_scene()
	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()
	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()

	local target_pos = self.get_s5_start_pos()

	-- 기사
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(leader, target_pos)

	-- 마리안
	character_util.set_direction(teatan_hero, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(teatan_hero, target_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0.5))

	-- 마빈
	character_util.set_direction(desert_slave, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(desert_slave, target_pos + vector(-1, 0, -0.5))

	-- 크레이그
	character_util.set_direction(tanker, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(tanker, target_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0.5))

	-- 코코
	character_util.set_direction(innuit, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(innuit, target_pos + vector(-2, 0, -0.5))

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	-- 가디언 일행 (마리안, 마빈, 크레이그, 코코) 위 그림으로 설정 (right, idle, idle)
	-- 가디언 일행 속도 2로 우측으로 6칸 이동 (대기 x)
	local wp_key = 'party_move'
	wp_util.move(teatan_hero, teatan_hero.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(desert_slave, desert_slave.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(tanker, tanker.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), 2, nil)
	wp_util.move(innuit, innuit.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), 2, nil)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(leader, leader.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), 2, nil, self, wp_key)

	-- 화면 1초 간 circular 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	-- 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	-- 가디언 (left, idle, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

	-- 마빈 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 드디어 부유성 위까지 올라왔군.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(desert_slave, self, nil, 'cross_arm'
	, nil, self.string_key .. 1)

	-- 마리안 (right, attack, shoot), 점프 (0.5, 0.3) : 그 망할 군단장은 어디로 간 거야?
	character_util.normal_jump(teatan_hero, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_hero, self, nil, 'shoot'
	, 'attack', self.string_key .. 2)

	-- 크레이그 (right, idle, question(loop x)) : 명령을 받고 아래로 내려간 뒤, 그녀의 행방을 알 수가 없어졌어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(tanker, self, nil, 'question'
	, nil, self.string_key .. 3)

	-- 코코 (right, attack, release) : 일단 군단장을 마지막으로 봤던 방으로 가 보자.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(innuit, self, nil, 'release'
	, 'attack', self.string_key .. 4)

	-- 가디언 (left, idle, nod x 2)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, 'nod')

	-- 가디언 (right, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	sp_util.exit_scene({ reset_party = false }, get_party_leader())

	-- 가디언 스테이지 입장 연출
	music_player:PlayStageIntroMusic()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 마커는 카밀라 식탁 있던 방 중앙으로 설정
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	local queen_chair = get_field_object('s4_queen_chair')
	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, queen_chair, true)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:enter_queen_room()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()
	local desert_slave = self.get_desert_slave()
	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	local queen_chair = get_field_object('s4_queen_chair')

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 가디언, 마리안, 마빈, 크레이그, 코코 1초 간 위 위치로 이동 (대기)
	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s10_align_point_1')
	wp_util.move(teatan_hero, target_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, -0.75), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move(desert_slave, target_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.25), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move(tanker, target_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -1.25), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move(innuit, target_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -0.75), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move_async(leader, target_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'up' })

	-- 마리안 (up, idle, idle), 점프 (0.5, 0.3) : 저길 봐!
	character_util.normal_jump(teatan_hero, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(teatan_hero, self.string_key .. 5)

	-- 카메라 1.5초 간 카밀라가 앉아 있었던 의자로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(queen_chair.Position, 1.5)

	-- 카메라 상에서 챔피언들의 대략적인 말풍선 위치 (참고 바랍니다)
	local viewport_pos_list = {
		vector(0.3, 0.55), vector(0.4, 0.3), vector(0.6, 0.3), vector(0.75, 0.45)
	}

	-- 마빈 : 사라졌군.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(desert_slave, self.string_key .. 6, true, {
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos_list[2] })

	-- 마리안 : 어디로 간 거지?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(teatan_hero, self.string_key .. 7, true, {
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos_list[1] })

	-- 크레이그 : 저 위에도 뭔가 보이는 것 같은데…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(tanker, self.string_key .. 8, true, {
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos_list[3] })

	-- 카메라 1.5초 간 위 손수건 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(self.get_handkerchief_pos(1), 1.5)

	-- 코코 : 손수건…같은데.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(innuit, self.string_key .. 9, true, {
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos_list[4] })

	-- 크레이그 : 저런 게 왜 여기에…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(tanker, self.string_key .. 10, true, {
		viewport_pos = viewport_pos_list[3] })

	-- 카메라 2초 간 가디언에게 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(2)

	-- 퀘스트 마커는 리리 석상 우측의 손수건 위치에 설정
	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_handkerchief_pos(2), true)

	-- 컨트롤 복구
end

function local_class:enter_handkerchief_zone_1()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()

	-- 마리안 : 손수건이 벽에 붙어 있어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(teatan_hero, { key = self.string_key .. 16 })
	if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.search_handkerchief_2 then
		return
	end

	--코코 : 벽 너머로 들어가기라도 한 걸까…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(innuit, { key = self.string_key .. 17 })
	if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.search_handkerchief_2 then
		return
	end

	-- 이후 플레이어가 10초 간 존 2에 들어가지 않으면 퀘스트 마커 좌측 계단에 설정
	wait_for_sec(10)
	if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.search_handkerchief_2 then
		return
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, get_field_object('secret_stair_1'), true)
end

function local_class:enter_handkerchief_zone_2()
	local tanker = self.get_tanker()

	local teatan_hero = self.get_teatan_hero()
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(teatan_hero)
	local innuit = self.get_innuit()
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(innuit)

	-- 크레이그 : 벽 너머에 공간이 있었다니…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tanker, { key = self.string_key .. 18 })
end

function local_class:fly_fairy_1()
	local fairy = self.get_fairy(1)

	-- 요정 - fairy_b (left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(fairy, 'left')
	character_util.set_active_state(fairy, 'enabled')

	-- SpineController SortingGroup의 sortingOrder 1로 설정
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(fairy, 'Top Effects', 1)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(fairy, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- 스파인 scale 1.3배
	character_util.spine_scale(fairy, unity_class.vector3.one * 1.3, 0)

	-- 그림자 비활성화
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fairy, false)

	-- 카메라의 자식으로 붙이고 위치 (12, 4, 0)으로 설정
	fairy.Transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform
	fairy.Position = vector(12, 6, 0)

	-- 회전 값 (-45, 0, 0)

	-- 요정 4초 간 (-12, -4, 0)으로 이동
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fairy_02')
	wp_util.move_async(fairy, vector(-15, -6, 0), nil, 4)
	character_util.set_active_state(fairy, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:fly_fairy_2()
	local fairy = self.get_fairy(2)

	-- 요정 - fairy_b (left, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_direction(fairy, 'left')
	character_util.set_active_state(fairy, 'enabled')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(fairy, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- SpineController SortingGroup의 sortingOrder 1로 설정
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(fairy, 'Top Effects', 1)

	-- 스파인 scale 1.3배
	character_util.spine_scale(fairy, unity_class.vector3.one * 1.3, 0)

	-- 그림자 비활성화
	character_util.set_active_shadow(fairy, false)

	-- 카메라의 자식으로 붙이고 위치 (-6, 5, 0)으로 설정
	fairy.Transform.parent = stage_camera.Transform
